The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Check with captain or supervisor before leaving at end of shift. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Stock ice, glassware, and paper supplies. Remove soiled wares from bar top and tables. Maintain cleanliness and condition of work areas, bar, bar unit, tables, and other tools, following all set-up guidelines.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, and support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Looking for highly motivated and results-driven Sales Professional to join our dynamic team. Will be responsible for achieving sales targets, new sales opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and demonstrating exceptional communication and problem-solving skills. Successful candidate will be goal-oriented, proactive, and possess a strong ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. About Axis Max Life Insurance
Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, formerly known as Max Life Insurance Company Ltd., is a Joint Venture between Max Financial Services Limited (“MFSL”) and Axis Bank Limited. Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive protection and long-term savings life insurance solutions through its multi-channel distribution, including agency and third-party distribution partners. It has built its operations over two decades through a need-based sales process, a customer-centric approach to engagement and service delivery and trained human capital. As per the annual audited financials for FY2023-24, Axis Max Life Insurance has achieved a gross written premium of INR 29,529 Cr. For more information, please visit the company website at www.maxlifeinsurance.com.
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. Builds a work environment that promotes enthusiasm, innovation, and long-term engagement.
Analytical and Strategic Decision-Making

Leverages data-driven insights to adapt strategies and enhance efficiency.
Continuously refines processes to align with evolving industry trends and business needs.
Fostering a Positive and Supportive Workplace
Cultivates a respectful, inclusive, and values-driven organizational culture.
Champions employee well-being and career growth by providing support and resources.
Actively participates in industry, social, and community engagements to reinforce corporate values.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be responsible for ensuring that the health club is clean, welcoming, and well-maintained for guests. You will greet and assist guests with information about the facilities, handle check-ins, and ensure the smooth flow of guests through the fitness and wellness areas. You will ensure that the health club is equipped with fresh towels, properly maintained equipment, and all amenities are in working order. As a Health Club Associate, you re not just fulfilling the daily health club operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in customer service, preferably in fitness or hospitality
Basic knowledge of fitness equipment and safety protocols
Excellent communication skills and a guest-focused attitude
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays
Team-oriented with a proactive and professional approach
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Guest Service Excellence: Provide a warm welcome, assist with inquiries, and ensure guest satisfaction across all health club touchpoints.
Operational Support: Maintain cleanliness and organization of fitness areas, locker rooms, and wellness spaces; replenish amenities and supplies.
Reception & Administration: Manage guest check-ins, bookings for classes and services, and respond to inquiries at the reception desk.
Team Support: Assist the Health Club Manager in supervising operations and stepping into staff roles as needed to maintain service continuity.
Training & Supervision: Help train and schedule team members across fitness, spa, and guest service roles.
Compliance & Safety: Ensure adherence to health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations; report equipment issues or safety concerns.
Business Support: Assist with marketing, merchandising, programming, inventory, and tracking performance to drive engagement and efficiency.

Job Title: AIOps Strategy & Implementation Engineer - Senior
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Senior AIOps Strategy & Implementation Engineer with up to 8 years of experience in observability platforms, automation workflows, cloud/infrastructure operations, and AI-driven operational analytics. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience implementing AIOps capabilities, integrating monitoring/telemetry systems, building automation pipelines, and supporting AI/ML model deployment focused on IT operations-not traditional ML development.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and integrate AIOps solutions across cloud and on-prem environments to enhance incident detection, correlation, and automated remediation.
Configure, manage, and optimize observability platforms (logs, metrics, traces) including ingestion pipelines, dashboards, alerting rules, and topology views.
Build automation workflows for operational tasks such as event triage, remediation actions, resource optimization, and predictive maintenance.
Collaborate with platform, cloud, and operations teams to onboard new services, data sources, and operational signals into the AIOps ecosystem.
Support deployment, integration, and operationalization of AI/ML models used for anomaly detection, event correlation, forecasting, and noise reduction (not model training).
Develop and implement playbooks, runbooks, and automated actions in line with SRE, DevOps, and cloud operations practices.
Troubleshoot issues related to observability ingestion, integration connectors, pipeline performance, and automation workflows.
Participate in architectural discussions, tool evaluations, and AIOps capability uplift initiatives.
Ensure compliance with security, governance, IAM, and data handling guidelines in the AIOps and observability ecosystem.
Document configurations, workflows, integrations, and operational guidelines for AIOps platform usage.
Qualifications:
Up to 8 years of experience in cloud/infrastructure operations, SRE, observability engineering, or automation engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with observability tools (e.g., ELK/Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, or equivalent).
Experience building workflows using automation frameworks or orchestration tools (e.g., Ansible, ServiceNow, Rundeck, Azure Automation, Lambda/Functions).
Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment concepts for IT operations (consumption of models, not development).
Understanding of event management, correlation engines, topology mapping, and CMDB integrations.
Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automations and integrations.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), their monitoring services, and operational data flows.
Bachelor s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with SRE practices, auto-remediation frameworks, and service health modeling.
Understanding of log pipelines, telemetry routing, data normalization, and enrichment.
Exposure to ITSM platforms and integrations (ServiceNow preferred).
Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting observability and automation issues.
Ability to work across multiple teams, communicate technical concepts clearly, and support platform adoption.

Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations
Your Role
As a Dynatrace Observability Engineer at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, onboarding, configuring, and managing end-to-end observability solutions using the Dynatrace platform across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work closely with application, infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams to enable proactive monitoring, performance optimization, reliability engineering, and automated incident management. You will leverage modern Dynatrace capabilities including Grail, Open Pipelines, DQL, Workflows, and AIOps to deliver scalable and cloud-aligned observability solutions.
Design and implement Dynatrace onboarding for applications, platforms, cloud services, and infrastructure components.
Configure and manage metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, KPIs, and intelligent alerting to provide actionable operational insights.
Build end-to-end observability views by integrating multiple technology stacks, platforms, and business services.
Develop automation workflows and AIOps-driven monitoring solutions to support proactive incident detection and resolution.
Collaborate with architecture, security, cloud, and operations teams to ensure observability standards, governance, and lifecycle management are maintained.

Your Profile
Hands-on expertise with Dynatrace SaaS and/or Managed environments, including platform administration and onboarding.
Strong experience with Dynatrace Grail, data ingestion, data management, and Open Pipelines implementation.
Advanced knowledge of DQL, Workflows, Guardians, Automation, AIOps features, OpenTelemetry, and OpenLLMetry.
Experience monitoring and optimizing observability for Azure and/or AWS cloud environments and distributed architectures.
Strong automation and integration skills using Monaco, Terraform, JavaScript, REST APIs, and observability-as-code practices.

What will you love working at Capgemini
You will have the opportunity to learn on one of the industry's largest digital learning platforms, with access to 250,000+ courses and numerous certifications.
We're committed to ensure that people of all backgrounds feel encouraged and have a sense of belonging at Capgemini.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Audit Fixed Term Hire
 Position Summary
 As a Fixed Term hire you will oversee daily audit operations for clients worldwide. You will work closely with onshore and offshore teams to deliver high-quality results.

 Work You'll Do
 • Plan and execute assigned tasks within the project scope and deadlines. Identify and use best practices. Apply Deloitte Audit methods and tools.
 • Demonstrate professional conduct and ethical standards. Complete tasks within project scope and deadlines with the team.
 • Participate in training to enhance your knowledge of accounting, audit tools, auditing, and industry dynamics.
 • Demonstrate maturity, poise, and confidence while proactively reporting availability and seeking new opportunities to contribute.
 • Ensure work meets the firms quality standards and adheres to the international regulatory accounting framework.
 The Team
 The team will actively participate in all phases of the audit process. This includes planning, execution, and reporting. The professional will supervise and guide junior staff members during their audit engagements.
 Required Qualifications
 • Graduation degree, i.e., BCom
 • Inter CA is mandatory with articleship completed.
 Preferred Qualifications
 • Strong technical knowledge of accounting and auditing principles.
 • Prior experience in auditing with exposure to US clients or understanding of US GAAP/GAAS/IFRS preferred.

This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. Learn more about our inclusive culture.
 Our purpose

At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte's purpose, commitments, and impact.

From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

Job Summary
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive
We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment
About the Role
Experience with Python scripting/CAPL for test automation.
Knowledge of Robot Framework or other automation frameworks.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test suites.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and automated validation pipelines.
Experience with lua scripting Added advantage
What You Will Do
Validate software update for vehicle ECUs and connected vehicle systems.
Perform vehicle-level testing in test benches, HIL environments, and real vehicles.
Plan, design, and execute test cases for OTA (Over-The-Air) and workshop-based software updates.
Support automation of software update validation using test frameworks and scripting tools.
Conduct functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing before software release.
Monitor update processes and analyze logs to identify defects, failures, and performance issues.
Collaborate with development, system integration, cybersecurity, and vehicle testing teams to resolve issues.
Create and maintain test specifications, test reports, defect records, and validation documentation.
Verify diagnostic functionality and data consistency before and after software updates.
Support root cause analysis of software update failures observed during testing or field trials.
Takes ownership of deliverables and holds accountability
Positive attitude, approachable personality, and strong collaboration skills
Effective communication and stakeholder interaction abilities
Self-motivated with a continuous learning mindset
What You Need to Be Successful
Strong understanding of software update and release validation processes in automotive systems.
Knowledge of OTA (Over-The-Air) software update technologies
Experience with automotive communication protocols: CAN CAN FD LIN Automotive Ethernet
Experience in UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services) - ISO 14229
Hands-on experience with Vector tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer etc.
Experience in test planning, test execution, defect tracking, and reporting.
Experience with version control and configuration management tools (Git, DNG etc.)
Ability to analyze logs(dlt, wireshark), traces, and software update failure reports.
Bonus Points if You Have
Strong knowledge on software update and release validation processes in automotive systems.
UDS ISO 14229
Ethernet
Python
What Makes You Eligible
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Experience working with large-scale data systems

Description:
Meet the Team
The DSE Platform Independent Common (PI-Common) group develops high-performance, platform-independent system software that runs across Cisco s flagship routers and switches. We design and deliver core routing protocols and infrastructure components that power Cisco s Mass Scale Infrastructure, Cloud Networking, and Network Experience portfolios.
Our team works on key control-plane technologies including IGP routing protocols such as OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP and RIP, BGP-LS, First Hop Redundancy Protocols such as HSRP, VRRP and GLBP, and routing infrastructure components such as route-policy frameworks, prefix handling, filtering, and control-plane scalability mechanisms.
These components form the foundation of networking deployments across enterprise, service provider, cloud, and AI infrastructure environments, where scale, resiliency, security, programmability, and operational debuggability are critical.
Your impact
As a Software Engineer in PI-Common, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of routing protocol and routing infrastructure software used across Cisco platforms. You will work with senior engineers to build reliable, scalable, and debuggable control-plane software. Key responsibilities include:
Developing features, enhancements, and defect fixes for IGP protocols, BGP-LS, FHRP technologies, and routing infrastructure components.
Writing clean, efficient, maintainable code in C/C++ for multi-threaded, system-level software environments.
Contributing to routing infrastructure components such as route-policy handling, filtering, prefix processing, and control-plane integration modules.
Debugging software issues using logs, traces, core files, protocol state, and platform-level diagnostics.
Participating in root cause analysis for defects and customer-found issues, with guidance from senior engineers.
Building unit, functional, regression, and scale validation coverage for protocol and infrastructure changes.
Working closely with platform, hardware, and test teams to validate software behavior across Cisco operating systems and platforms.
Learning protocol behavior, implementation details, and operational aspects of production routing systems.
Participating in design discussions, code reviews, and technical reviews to build strong engineering judgment.
Contributing to team quality, automation, debuggability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Minimum qualifications required
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related technical field.
0-3 years of relevant software development experience.
Strong understanding of data structures, operating systems, and computer networking fundamentals.
Programming experience in C or C++.
Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Perl.
Familiarity with Unix/Linux development environments.
Good problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
Preferred qualifications (good to have)
Exposure to routing protocols such as OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP, RIP, BGP, or BGP-LS.
Understanding of multi-threaded programming, IPC, memory management, or system-level software concepts.
Familiarity with debugging tools such as gdb, logs, packet captures, traces, or core-file analysis.
Exposure to networking software, embedded systems, distributed systems, or large-scale infrastructure software.
Ability to learn complex technical areas quickly and work well in a team environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Are you ready to be at the forefront of digital payment innovation Join our Payments Operations team and make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless financial transactions. This is your opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced environment, where your contributions will be valued and your skills will be honed.

As a Payment Lifecycle Specialist IV within Payments Operations, you will play a crucial role in the smooth transfer of funds between various parties. Working under regular supervision, you will help maintain our reputation for excellent service and secure financial transactions. Your responsibilities will include payment processing across various products, such as the transfer of funds between financial institutions, cardholders, merchants, corporate and retail clients, and the reconciliation of purchase and sales options, futures, or securities. This may involve sanctions screening, payment investigations, funds control, exception processing, resolving reconciliation breaks, and invoicing or cash management activities.

Job responsibilities
Execute high-volume payment processing tasks, including validating global currency fund transfers to ensure accurate and timely transactions, following established procedures.
Process payments for cash, trade, merchant, or commercial card transactions as well as customer accounts and verification, performing basic research, reviewing sanctions, fraud, fund controls, and client investigation.
Identify, resolve, or escalate either procedural issues or operational errors that may arise during payments processing including upholding compliance and risk standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-locational teams and clients, maintaining productive relationships to drive mutually beneficial outcomes in line with team objectives.
Detect and escalate potential fraudulent threats and help prevent financial and reputational damage to the institution.
Contribute to process optimization initiatives including projects to identify inefficiencies, improve quality, and enhance the customer experience.
Coach, train, or mentor team members to deliver to our high service standards for productivity, quality, and customer experience.
Interface with other operations departments to research and resolve inquiries, including escalated matters.
Learn and apply skills in innovation, market product knowledge, and artificial intelligence to identify opportunities to improve or optimize payment lifecycle processes.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Intermediate knowledge of global payment processing operations or similar operations, including understanding of standard operating procedures and customer-specific instructions.
Skilled in effective execution and task management, with strong time management abilities to ensure timely and accurate completion of work.
Proven ability in decision making and problem solving, utilizing critical and analytical thinking to ensure accuracy and effective solutions in moderately complex situations.
Proficiency in data analysis techniques, with the ability to interpret and communicate data effectively to inform decision-making processes.
Demonstrated communication skills and emotional intelligence, including a growth mindset and personal resiliency, to collaborate productively with management, teams, and other stakeholders in diverse and dynamic environments.
Ability to collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, influence outcomes, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in payment processing.
Intermediate computer, software, and technical skills, including alpha/numeric data entry and typing skills.
Foundational understanding of cybersecurity controls and anti-fraud strategies to assist in identifying and addressing potential threats to protect information and systems.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Knowledge of ISO or Swift message processing or management.
Exposure to AI-enabled tools and willingness to adopt emerging technologies that support process improvement and operational excellence

Analyst - Level: Early Talent (On Campus)

Effective time management skills

Role: Candidate Manager / Senior Candidate Manager

Job Summary
Do you enjoy working with people and are looking for a career that is constantly evolving and highly
rewarding?
If you are passionate about being the best you can be and prepared to go above and beyond for your
colleagues, candidates, and clients this is the role for you!
Join us to become a part of our high-achieving, dynamic and supportive team and learn from the best
in the talent industry.

What do we offer you?
We believe in cultivating an environment that breeds opportunity and encourages people to be the
best version of themselves. Our team members see work as more than just a jobit’s a career built
on passion, grit, and ambition. We help people achieve their goals and make them successful
professionals. Our culture is centred around making an impact. Whatever direction you’re headed,
you’ll find talented, driven, and passionate members of the TEKsystems family creating meaningful
work. Our comprehensive recruiter training program allows you to learn terminology, job functions,
and applicable practices within the information technology industry. And our supportive, feedback-rich
environment provides for a structured and transparent career progression.

Responsibilities:
Being a subject matter expert in the technology domain to help people reach their career
goals
Aligning your candidates’ career aspirations with our client’s hiring needs. This entails
sourcing and screening candidates, coordinating the interview process, and facilitating offers
and employment negotiations, all while ensuring a pleasant candidate experience.
Proactively building relationships with people in the market through face-to-face, phone, and
video call meetings
Pro-actively introducing candidates to clients to help uncover new opportunities for them.
Staying abreast of recruiting trends and best practices in the IT space
Working with your team members to build a collaborative, supportive and friendly culture.
Identifying opportunities to increase efficiencies and results for the team.

Requirements:
Strong entrepreneurial work style
A positive learning attitude and driven mindset
Love the thrill of sales and building new candidate/client relationships
Passionate about wanting a career and learning to be the best in your field
A team player who enjoys helping others around them

Education Qualification
Bachelor’s degree in any stream can apply

Experienced candidates
1 –8 years’ experience in recruitment industry with hands on experience into understanding
the job profile of client, sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, interview co-ordination,
post offer follow ups and onboarding.
Work on a set of specialized skills from a sourcing, presenting a shortlist of verified
candidates aligned to qualified roles. Build high quality candidate networks by developing
solid relationships with these individuals and creating regular touchpoints with them.
Proactively build relationships with people in the market through face-to-face, phone, and
video call meetings. Pro-actively introducing candidates to clients to help uncover new
opportunities for them. Staying abreast of recruiting trends and best practices in the IT space.

Are you a people-first individual who enjoys helping customers and solving problems? Join our team at NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be the trusted voice that helps our customers through their property journey!

Position Type: Full-time

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities
Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long-term engagement.
Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 34 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer service process.
Understand customer needs and assist in resolving queries and finding the right tenant or property, with a strong focus on customer experience rather than hard sales targets.
Provide regular, proactive updates on account/service progress and utilize internal tools while adhering to company guidelines for high-quality service delivery.

Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer satisfaction; performance is monitored though the role is not heavily target-based.
Perks & Value Proposition
Performance incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of up to 15,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.

Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers
Education: Graduation, HSC (12th) or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.

Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.

Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: 6-day working week — Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.

Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Role: Devops and Cloud L3 & Architect
Exp: 7yrs to 18yrs
Location Flex: Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Shift: Rotational
Mode of Working: Hybrid

Mandatory Skill to Apply: Devops + Multi Cloud( Any 2- AWS/Azure/GCP) + CI/CD or Jenkins + Git + IAC (Terraform or Automation or Ansible)

Core / Must-Have Skills:-

Strong CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
Strong hands-on Terraform
Docker & Kubernetes
At least one managed Kubernetes platform: EKS / AKS / GKE
Helm and/or Argo CD
Python and/or Shell/Bash scripting
Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts

Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management

Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation

Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field

Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Exp- 5-10 years
Required Skills
Migration project experience (critical)

You have experience partnering with data analysts, data scientists, and engineering stakeholders.
You have a background in data engineering, computer science, software development or another engineering field
You can communicate with a team and articulate ideas to both team members and non-technical stakeholders
You have a drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
Bachelor's degree or relevant experience can substitute for formal education

Python/ Airflow for data pipeline and automation.

dbt for data transformation

Position Requirements:
Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members to design and deliver efficient Financial Close, Consolidation and/or FP&A processes. You will lead key aspects of OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, build, testing, training, change management, go-live and post-go-live support. This position may require you to work directly with clients from an offshore location and at client sites.
Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.
Experience implementing planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial close, consolidation and management reporting solutions.
Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.
For consolidation-focused candidates, good understanding of intercompany eliminations, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting, currency translation and group reporting.
For FP&A-focused candidates, good understanding of integrated planning, driver-based forecasting, allocations, scenario modelling and management reporting.
Experience developing Cube Views, dashboards, reports and Excel Add-In solutions, and using/configuring relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
Good understanding of data integration, data validation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.
Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.
Minimum 6 years of hands-on OneStream experience, with at least two end-to-end implementation projects.
Strong functional expertise in FP&A or Financial Close and Consolidation; experience across at least one or both areas is preferred.
Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable OneStream solutions.
Experience designing and configuring metadata, workflows, security, business rules, integrations, reports and dashboards, including relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
Ability to identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend standardized, automated and scalable solutions.
Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, cutover, deployment and hypercare activities.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate activities across business, functional, technical and integration teams.
Experience managing project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication.
Ability to lead teams involving multiple territories in Onshore-Offshore Model
Demonstrated people-management skills, including leading and mentoring team members, allocating work effectively, providing regular coaching and performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
Ability to review solution designs and project deliverables for quality, consistency and alignment with OneStream best practices.
Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
Experience leading and mentoring project team me

Job description
Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) -FDI Manager (10-16Years of Experience)
As an OAC Senior Developer, you will work with technical and project teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade data integration solutions for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new ELT/ETL pipelines; migrating on-premise integration workloads to the cloud; modernizing legacy Data Warehouse feeds; and integrating Oracle Data Integrator with GoldenGate, OCI Data Integration, and other Oracle data platform services. Our teams have a diverse range of skills, and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. The primary focus of this role is to design, develop, and support enterprise data integration solutions using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Integration/Data
Role & responsibilities
As OAC developer you will have multiple responsibilities depending on the project type. One type of project may involve migrating existing reporting applications to Oracle cloud infrastructure.Another might involve building new reporting solutions directly within Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) .The key responsibilities may involve some or all the areas listed below:
Role & responsibilities
10-16 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) , including KM development and topology configuration.
Experience with Oracle Data Integrator 11g/12c/ODI Marketplace Edition.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with experience on one or more relational databases on Oracle.
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling.
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for real-time replication and Change Data Capture (CDC).
Exposure to OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms and cloud-native, serverless integration patterns.
Experience migrating on-premise ETL workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Working knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service as integration targets.
Exposure to Big Data connectivity (Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka) within ODI or GoldenGate for Big Data.
Experience with job scheduling, load plans, and ODI agent (Standalone/JEE/Colocated) administration.
Preferred
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate 21c/23ai.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as downstream consumers of ODI pipelines.
Experience in Oracle BI Apps (OBIA).
Exposure to one or more of the following: Python, R, or UNIX shell scripting.
Expertise in analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale, high-volume data integration jobs.
Systematic problem-solving approach.
Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
Exposure to ODI SDK and Groovy scripting for automation.Role & responsibilities

As an Azure Databricks + AI Manager you will lead data engineering work that brings together cloud data platforms, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions within our Data & Analytics practice. As a Manager you will guide teams through planning, delivery, and review of client work, using sound judgment, mentoring junior colleagues, and helping drive clear priorities across multiple workstreams. In this role at PwC, you will contribute to data modernization efforts, work through complex data platform challenges, and help shape scalable solutions across Azure Databricks and AI use cases.
As a Manager you will coach team members, oversee deliverables, and support client service accounts while maintaining a practical focus on timelines, quality, and stakeholder communication. In this role at PwC, you will collaborate across Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics and Data, Analytics & AI to translate technical needs into actionable work, identify opportunities for process improvement, and bring structure to delivery in a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
- Leading Azure Databricks data engineering workstreams for cloud-based analytics and AI initiatives
- Managing project plans, priorities, and deliverables across multiple client engagements and internal teams
- Designing and implementing data pipelines, data transformations, and data quality checks within Azure Databricks
- Developing data architecture, data models, and lakehouse solutions that support scalable analytics use cases
- Applying Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, and related orchestration tools to automate batch and streaming workflows
- Optimizing performance across data pipelines, query processing, and warehouse structures to improve processing efficiency
- Reviewing technical deliverables for accuracy, data integrity, and alignment with client requirements
- Coaching team members on data engineering methods, cloud tooling, and delivery approaches
- Identifying opportunities to apply AI fluency, digital tooling, and modern data modernization methods to client challenges
- Validating security, privacy, and data governance considerations across engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 9+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Azure Databricks implementation across enterprise data platforms
- Utilizing Data Engineering, Data Integration, and Data Quality skills in delivery
- Managing client workstreams within Data Modernisation initiatives
- Coaching teams through analytics, AI, and cloud transformation efforts

Description:
Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloittes clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
Work you'll do
As a Consultant on the Internal Audit team, you will be responsible for:
* Plan and execute internal audit assurance activities, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements No. 18 (SSAE 18), and EQARs; conduct client walkthroughs, controls testing, stakeholder communication, and follow-up.
* Assess financial, operational, compliance, strategic, business-cycle, and information technology risks; identify control deficiencies; evaluate risk implications; and recommend control improvements.
* Develop audit approaches, scopes, programs, and procedures; perform selected audit tests; and apply internal audit standards, professional skepticism, and the code of ethics through engagement completion.
* Prepare internal control documentation, including narratives, process and data flows, workpapers, audit findings, reporting, and action plans; present outcomes to clients and stakeholders.
* Use technology-enabled tools and methods to analyze data, support reviews of business-cycle, general computer, and enterprise resource planning controls, and deliver risk-centric solutions.
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore
Shift Timings: 12 PM to 9 PM / 1 PM to 10 PM
Qualifications
Required:
* Up to 4 years of experience conducting Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance reviews, internal audits, Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements No. 18 (SSAE 18) reviews, or internal controls testing.
* Experience performing risk assessments and audits of financial, operational, and information technology processes.
* Experience supporting investment management or asset management operations audits.
* Experience testing business-cycle, general computer, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) controls using Oracle or SAP.
* Experience preparing audit documentation, including narratives, process and data flows, workpapers, findings, and action plans.
* Experience applying the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) Internal Control—Integrated Framework, U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (US GAAP), and guidance issued by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA), Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB), and American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA).
* Chartered Accountant, MBA in Finance, or certification as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
Preferred:
* Experience in Asset wealth management or investment management.
* Experience at a Big Four professional services firm
