Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
SAP Fiori Consultant -Senior
GDS Tax Technology
Position
EY s GDS Tax Technology team s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY s core Tax practice, you ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding ERP, database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EYs GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firms partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking a Senior to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
Key Responsibilities
Assists project teams in estimating the architecture design effort and develop/ review/ approve architecture designs.
Be subject matter expert to program/project teams in the plan, design, and delivery of technical solutions.
Involve in solution design and development of Tax tools and technology solutions.
Lead the solution design and development of Tax tools and technology solutions.
Qualification & Experience Required
Bachelor s / Master s degree in Software Engineering / Information Technology / MBA / MCA.
An overall 4-10 years experience Sap Fiori Project Implementation.
Scrum and Project management.
Experience and understanding of technology tools.
SAP S/4 Hana implementation
Methodology
Migration
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and how digital transformation can be applied to address problems and opportunities.
Team handling skills, analytical skills, presentation skills, ability to work under pressure
Should be capable of supporting architecture and design and guide team as required to prepare and present weekly reports to all stakeholders
Identify and manage Risks and Issues keep leadership informed
Must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills Professional Attributes
Knowledge/Experience on BTP technologies such as SAP Build, CAP, Gen AI will be an added advantage.
Good knowledge on integrations with other technology will be an added advantage.
SAP Fiori/UI5 & ABAP experience required:
Experience in working as a full stack Fiori developer.
Technologies preferred: SAP ABAP, OOABAP, Ui5, JavaScript
Design and develop Fiori applications.
Prepare technical specification documents.
Convert functional requirement to technical design
Develop SAPUI5 application on VS Code, WebIDE or SAP BAS
Should have knowledge of developing OData service using SAP Gateway
Knowledge/Experience on SAP RAP would be an added advantage.
Consume On-Premise OData services in Cloud using destinations and OData Provisioning.
Enhance SAP Fiori applications.
Perform technical reviews and SAPUI5 code reviews.
SAP Fiori App Prototyping
Should have sound knowledge of GIT.
Should have knowledge on FLP Configurations and Customizations.
Should have sound knowledge on Unit and Integration testing.
Having knowledge of SAP Fiori element framework and extensions will be added advantage
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Hands-on SAP Security experience in SAP S/4HANA (including Fiori and HANA security), along with experience in SAP ECC.
2 to 5 years of SAP Security consulting experience.
SAP GRC experience is a must.
Strong experience in implementation and production support for SAP applications, including SAP S/4HANA, ECC, HR, BPC, CRM, Solution Manager and NetWeaver Java applications.
At least 2 end-to-end implementation/rollout/upgrade experiences on SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BI or GRC is preferred.
Should have worked on pre-installation and post-installation steps, syncs, connectors, rule building and MSMP workflows in GRC.
Experience in defining HANA security and restricting access to HANA modeling/DB objects through various privileges and custom roles.
Ability to build roles for Fiori, BPC, BOBJ and OpenText.
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Fiori security: business catalogs, groups, spaces and pages, and role mapping to Fiori apps.
Good knowledge of role maintenance in PFCG, SU24 maintenance and troubleshooting with SU53 and authorization traces (ST01 / STAUTHTRACE).
Experience with user administration, including mass user changes, user locks and password policies.
Experience with GRC Emergency Access Management (Firefighter) and Access Request Management.
Experience in SAP BW and Business Objects security setup, including the definition of BW analysis authorizations, reporting-level security and Business Objects RLS (Row Level Security).
Strong experience with authorizations at InfoObject, hierarchy and key figure level.
Strong knowledge of SAP Security concepts, landscape, Transport Management System and version compatibilities.
Exposure to job-based and task-based security design concepts.
Understanding of business processes, controls frameworks, compliance and regulations, and Segregation of Duties concepts in an SAP ERP environment.
Responsible for application security support, maintenance and enhancements for the entire SAP landscape.
Strong experience in resolving authorization issues and GRC-related issues.
Documentation knowledge of various security processes, procedures and auditing.

Preferred candidate profile:
ITIL certification.
Exposure to BOBJ and Data Services.
SAP certification in SAP S/4HANA Security or SAP Access Control (GRC).
Exposure to SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG), SAP BTP security or SAP Cloud Identity Services.
Exposure to security redesign as part of an SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA conversion.
Exposure to SAP Activate methodology or an SAP S/4HANA conversion / upgrade project.
Exposure to automation or AI-assisted support tools (for example bots, monitoring automation or auto-ticket routing).
AboutCompany:
At PwC, our purpose is to build trust in society and solve important problems. We help organizations and individuals create the value they are looking for, by delivering  quality in Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. Our global strategy The New Equation reflects how  we solve important problems facing the world—today and tomorrow.
In India, we operate as PwC India and PwC Acceleration Centers. PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs),  formerly Service Delivery Centers, include two entities in India – Acceleration Center Kolkata and  Acceleration Center Bangalore. The Acceleration Centers in India are diverse, global talent hubs  focused on delivering value to our clients – providing virtual client engagement support around the  world and across all PwC’s services and capabilities.

Dear Pankaj,
Greetings from Axtria! (Axtria is a global provider of cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences & Healthcare industry).
As discussed,  please find below the generic job specifications for your reference.
Location Hyd | Bangalore | Noida | GGN | Pune
About The Role
We are looking for a Data Governance Consultant to drive core data governance engagements for our clients. This role combines hands-on governance program design with client-facing consulting and pre-sales responsibilities, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to stand up sustainable governance operating models.
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance Program Delivery
Define and own the data governance charter, including scope, guiding principles, roles & responsibilities, and success metrics
Partner with business and IT teams to design and implement escalation matrices for data issues, policy exceptions, and change requests
Establish and facilitate the Data Governance Council, including cadence, decision rights, and reporting structures
Formulate, document, and maintain SOPs covering data quality, stewardship, issue resolution, and data ownership processes
Define data ownership and stewardship models (data owners, stewards, custodians) across business domains
Design and roll out data policies, standards, and metrics/KPIs to track governance maturity and adoption
Tools & Technical Fluency
Demonstrate working proficiency in leading data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Atlan, and Alation
Support tool evaluation, configuration recommendations, and policy/workflow design within these platforms
Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to align governance policies with underlying data platforms
Client Engagement & Business Development
Lead or support client discovery sessions, workshops, and governance maturity assessments
Own or contribute to RFP/RFI responses, including solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal narrative
Build client-facing deliverables (decks, SOPs, charters, maturity frameworks) and present to senior stakeholders
Act as a trusted advisor to client governance leads, balancing pragmatic delivery with long-term governance maturity
Stakeholder & Project Management
Drive cross-functional alignment between business, IT, compliance, and data teams
Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies for governance workstreams within larger data management programs
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to CoE assets and reusable governance frameworks
Required Qualifications
12+ years of experience in data governance or related consulting roles
Proven experience defining data governance charters, councils, and operating models in a real client/enterprise setting
Hands-on exposure to at least one major data governance/catalog tool (Collibra, Atlan, or Alation); familiarity with multiple is a plus
Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and supporting pre-sales or proposal development
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and concepts such as data lineage, data quality, and stewardship
Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with experience engaging both business and IT audiences
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience building executive-ready presentations
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in life sciences/pharma or other regulated data environments
Prior consulting/CoE experience with both offshore and onshore delivery models
Relevant certifications (DAMA CDMP, Collibra/Alation/Atlan certifications)
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000, Deloitte FAST 500, NJBiz FAST 50, SmartCEO Future 50, Red Herring 100, and several other growth and technology awards.
Axtria is looking for exceptional talent to join our rapidly growing global team
People are our biggest perk! Our transparent and collaborative culture offers a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in the industry
Our data analytics and software platforms support data science, commercial operations, and cloud information management. We enable commercial excellence through our cloud-based sales planning and operations platform
We are leaders in managing data using the latest cloud information management and big data technologies
Axtria Institute, our in-house university, offers the best training in the industry and an opportunity to learn in a structured environment. A customized career progression plan       ensures every associate is setup for success and able to do meaningful work in a fun environment. We want our legacy to be the leaders we produce for the industry
3500+ employees worldwide – growing rapidly & strengthening our product engineering team. We would almost double our India headcount in the coming year
Feel free to reach out in case of any queries

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation

Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
We're Nagarro.
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

Requirements
Experience : 7.5 + years
Strong experience in Salesforce service ownership, production support, and end-to-end service management across multiple Salesforce organizations.
Proven experience leading and managing Salesforce support teams, including workload allocation, capacity planning, performance monitoring, and resource scheduling.
Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, incident management, ticket management, SLA monitoring, and escalation management.
Experience managing production tickets and ensuring compliance with defined service governance models and operational procedures.
Ability to analyze ticket volumes, monitor team capacity, and provide resource utilization and availability reports to project and service managers.
Experience in service reviews, operational reporting, stakeholder management, and presenting service performance metrics to business and IT leadership.
Strong understanding of Salesforce releases, release impact assessments, production readiness, and coordination with development and support teams.
Experience with Salesforce security, access management, authorization concepts, and periodic User Access Reviews.
Knowledge of application security practices, including SAST, Fortify scans, vulnerability remediation, and security compliance.
Experience with IT change management, audit requirements, compliance processes, and service documentation.
Ability to prepare and maintain operational and technical documentation, including authorization concepts, logging concepts, and support procedures.
Experience collaborating with Salesforce build teams and participating in sprint planning to identify support team contributions.
Familiarity with backup and archiving solutions, security tool assessments, and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate across technical teams, business stakeholders, security teams, and project managers.
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining service quality and operational continuity.

Responsibilities
Own and manage end-to-end Salesforce service operations across multiple organizations, ensuring service stability, availability, and operational efficiency.
Lead and manage the Salesforce support team, ensuring effective task allocation, team performance, and adherence to service delivery standards.
Monitor production tickets and ensure timely resolution in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and the ITS governance model.
Manage support team capacity, ticket volumes, workload distribution, and resource availability, providing regular capacity reports to ITS Project Managers for planning additional activities.
Coordinate team leave plans and resource schedules to ensure adequate support coverage across all working days.
Review support tickets to ensure accurate information, appropriate categorization, and compliance with defined ticket management guidelines.
Identify service improvement opportunities, operational efficiencies, and cost optimization initiatives across Salesforce support operations.
Monitor upcoming Salesforce releases, assess their potential impact on production organizations, and coordinate necessary testing, readiness, and implementation activities.
Maintain and update service documentation, operational procedures, and support knowledge repositories as required.
Prepare and present monthly service review meetings with ITS and business stakeholders, covering organization health, ticket trends, SLA performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.
Conduct User Access Reviews every six months and ensure appropriate access governance across Salesforce organizations.
Ensure adherence to ITS change management processes, audit requirements, security standards, and other compliance obligations.
Prepare, review, and maintain service documentation, including authorization concepts, logging concepts, and other relevant operational and security documents.
Manage end-to-end Salesforce security activities, including coordination and remediation of findings from Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Fortify scans, and related security assessments.
Participate in sprint planning meetings to identify opportunities for the Level 2 Support (L2S) team to support the Salesforce build and development teams.
Lead discussions and coordinate initiatives related to backup and archiving, security tool assessments, proof of concepts (POCs), and other operational improvements.
Support ITS Project Managers with service planning, resource forecasting, operational reporting, risk management, and other delivery-related activities.
Collaborate with Salesforce development teams, business stakeholders, security teams, and IT service management teams to ensure reliable service delivery and continuous improvement.

Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,

Audience

Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
Hands-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights

Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.

Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.

Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.

Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Job Title: Inside Sales Specialist B2C (Individual Contributor)
Location: HSR, Bangalore
Department: B2C Sales
Experience: 15 years
Employment Type: Full-time

About Simplilearn Simplilearn is the world’s #1 online bootcamp for digital economy skills training, helping professionals and enterprises stay ahead in the fast-changing digital world. We offer world-class programs in Data Science, AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing, and more.

Role Summary We are looking for a highly motivated Inside Sales Specialist to join our B2C Sales team. This is an individual contributor role focused on engaging with prospective learners, understanding their career goals, and recommending appropriate Simplilearn programs to help them succeed.

Key Responsibilities
Proactively connect with potential learners via Outbound calls
Understand individual customer needs and provide customized course recommendations.
Convert leads into paying customers by driving consultative and need-based selling.
Achieve monthly revenue targets through high conversion rates and proactive follow-ups.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions using CRM tools.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to provide market feedback.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
1–5 years of experience in B2C inside sales, preferably in EdTech or service-based industries.
Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and persuasion skills.
Self-driven, goal-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
Familiarity with CRM tool - Salesforce is an added advantage.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts/weekends (as required for B2C audiences).

What We Offer
Competitive fixed pay plus interesting performance incentives.
Rapid career growth in a global EdTech leader.
Learning & development support with access to all Simplilearn programs.
Dynamic, high-energy work culture with strong peer support.
AboutCompany:
We are the world€™s largest professional certifications company.

A pioneer in online education for professionals, we create course programs, exams, and lab projects that help professionals across the world successfully prepare for and complete certification exams with ease. Our unique blended model of training brings together the best of self-learning and online training, making for a successful learning experience.

We strive to constantly improve our learning frameworks to make them more user-friendly. Our courses are upgraded continuously to ensure our learners are up-to-date on the latest industry requirements and best practices.

We assist our learners in applying for the certification exam of their choice, and our vibrant community of experts and certified professionals is a powerful resource pool of tips, tricks, and insightful advice.

Description:
Financial management tools should demonstrate the same care and craft as consumer software, designed with contemporary, human-centred practices. Join our Design team supporting Wholesale Lending Services to help reimagine lending journeys and design servicing applications, with a particular focus on applying agentic AI and automation to improve user experiences and streamline servicing workflows.
Job Summary
As a Senior UX Design Associate within the Design team supporting Wholesale Lending Services, based in Bangalore, you will engage in the full design process, from research and insights through ideation, prototyping, testing and delivery of final designs. You will partner with Product, Technology and Operations, as well as Experience Design teams across other operations businesses, to shape lending journeys and servicing application experiences. Working closely with business stakeholders and users, you will apply user-centred design practices to address complex problems. You will bring strengths in interaction design and a desire to continually broaden and improve your skills.
Job Responsibilities
Design and redesign lending journeys and servicing applications across Wholesale Lending Services.
Partner with UX Researchers and Lead Designers to participate in upfront user research, understand user needs and behaviours, and conduct usability testing to evaluate design solutions.
Collaborate with Product, Technology and Operations, as well as Experience Design teams across other operations businesses, advocating for the user s perspective.
Use ideation and prototyping to explore different options, including innovative, practical solutions.
Define product interactions through user flows and wireframes.
Develop detailed designs using our Design System to bring solutions to life.
Present your work and articulate design decisions to Product team leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills
A bachelor s degree in a relevant design discipline, such as Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction or User Experience Design; certification from a credible bootcamp or similar accelerated learning programme; or equivalent work experience.
A minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
Ability to plan and structure your own work, delivering quality outcomes within expected timeframes.
Demonstrated experience applying user-centred design approaches.
Experience collaborating within design teams, including designers, UX researchers and content designers, and cross-functionally with Product Managers and software engineers.
Strong interaction design skills, paired with proficiency in visual/UI design or information architecture, and developing skills in adjacent areas such as user research, UX writing and prototyping.
Ability to demonstrate how an understanding of technical constraints and opportunities has informed your design solutions.
Intermediate communication and presentation skills, including the ability to articulate the rationale behind design decisions within the team.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills
Prior experience designing applications within complex business domains.
Developing understanding of accessibility guidelines and inclusive design practices.
Experience shipping digital products or developing a launch-ready prototype.
Understanding of the basic technical context of your designs, including familiarity with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Foundational understanding of business needs and how design supports them.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology. We're inventing the future of customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, brand engagements and communications.
Joining frog means you'll be joining the "pond," a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table. We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community - and the world at large.
Your Role
The ideal candidate will combine expertise in social listening, consumer and market intelligence, and AI-driven analytics to generate actionable insights from online conversations and digital data. The candidate should understand how AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform social listening workflows, enabling faster, more scalable, and insight-led delivery. Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to translate complex data into strategic business recommendations.
The candidate will be expected (but not limited) to:
Lead social listening and digital intelligence engagements, translating business objectives into research frameworks, listening strategies, and actionable insights.
Leverage AI, LLMs, and automation to streamline social data collection, analysis, sentiment assessment, topic clustering, trend identification, and insight generation.
Explore and implement AI-first approaches to improve the speed, accuracy, scalability, and quality of social listening and consumer intelligence deliverables.
Work with AI platforms, social listening tools, APIs, and data connectors to integrate information from social media, online news, forums, reviews, and other digital sources.

Your Profile
7 - 10 years of proven experience in social listening, consumer insights, digital intelligence, market research, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in AI-led solutions.
Strong understanding of social listening methodologies, digital data sources, sentiment analysis, taxonomy development, trend analysis, and competitive intelligence.
Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to automate or enhance research, analytics, insight generation, or reporting workflows.
Familiarity with social listening platforms such as Meltwater, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, or equivalent tools.
Experience in prompt engineering, workflow automation, and evaluating the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect qualitative and quantitative findings to business outcomes.

What you will love about working here
We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
Equal Opportunities at frog

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Application Development:
Design and develop SAP Fiori applications using SAP UI5 framework, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

Integrate Fiori/UI5 apps with SAP backend systems using OData services and Gateway.

Perform unit testing, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high-quality deliverables.
Collaboration:

Innovation:
Stay updated with SAP Fiori/UI5 best practices and emerging technologies.
Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of SAP UI5, Fiori design principles, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3.
Experience with SAP Gateway and OData services.
Familiarity with MVC architecture and SAP Web IDE or Business Application Studio.
Additional Skills:
Understanding of SAP architecture and integration patterns.
Knowledge of Git, RESTful APIs, and Agile methodologies.
Experience:
35 years of SAP Fiori/UI5 development experience for intermediate roles.
5–8 years for senior roles, including full-cycle implementations.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Description:
Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.
Provide end-user training and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.
Required Skills
6 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced GenAI Lead / Agentic AI Architect with 14+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI and enterprise solution architecture.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in designing and developing enterprise-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using Azure and/or AWS ecosystems. The role involves architecting scalable AI solutions, designing multi-agent systems, implementing advanced RAG architectures, developing Python-based applications, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.
The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure and production-ready AI architectures while guiding customers and stakeholders on GenAI transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
1. GenAI & Agentic AI Architecture
Architect and design end-to-end Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise applications.
Design and implement multi-agent systems supporting planning, reasoning, memory management, tool invocation and complex workflow orchestration.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP and other agent orchestration frameworks.
Design and develop advanced RAG architectures, including:
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
Knowledge Graph RAG
RAG Fusion
Context Augmented Generation (CAG)
Multi-agent RAG and context enrichment pipelines.
Evaluate and select appropriate commercial and open-source LLMs, SLMs and VLMs based on business requirements.

2. Cloud AI Platforms Azure / AWS
Experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem is mandatory.
Microsoft Azure:
Azure OpenAI Service
Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Agents / Agent Service
Microsoft Agent Framework
Azure Machine Learning
Azure AI Search / Cognitive Search
Cosmos DB, Redis, pgvector
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions
Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights
Amazon Web Services (AWS):
Amazon Bedrock
AWS AgentCore
Strands SDK / Multi-Agent Framework
Agents for Amazon Bedrock
Knowledge Bases and Guardrails for Bedrock
Amazon SageMaker
Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS
ECS / EKS, DynamoDB, API Gateway
CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray

3. Python Development & Application Engineering
Strong hands-on Python programming experience is mandatory.
Develop Python-based microservices and GenAI applications using FastAPI / Django.
Build LLM-powered applications, agent orchestration workflows, embeddings pipelines and tool integrations.
Develop reusable components, frameworks and accelerators.
Establish coding standards, review code and mentor development teams.

4. RAG, LLMOps & Data Engineering
Design enterprise-grade RAG pipelines for structured and unstructured data across multiple file formats and data lakes.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, vector indexing and hybrid search.
Implement LLMOps/MLOps pipelines, model evaluation, fine-tuning and deployment workflows.
Experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes, serverless deployments and cloud-native architectures.
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, performance optimization and cost governance.

5. Security, Governance & Responsible AI
Design and implement LLM guardrails, prompt security and content filtering.
Establish agent governance, responsible AI practices and secure model invocation.
Experience with private endpoints, IAM/RBAC, cloud security and enterprise compliance.
Conduct architecture reviews, threat modelling and performance benchmarking.

6. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Lead architecture discussions, solution design and technical assessments with customers.
Translate business requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.
Mentor developers and engineering teams on GenAI, Agentic AI, Python and cloud technologies.
Define architecture blueprints, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices.
Support pre-sales, PoCs, technical demonstrations and enterprise GenAI transformation initiatives.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
14+ years of overall experience in Data Science, AI/ML, NLP and software engineering, with substantial hands-on experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP and enterprise AI architecture.
Expertise in Agentic AI frameworks LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP or equivalent.
Strong experience designing and implementing RAG-based solutions and multi-agent architectures.
Experience with commercial and open-source LLMs, including Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock.
Strong hands-on Python programming experience.
Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud ecosystems.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search and hybrid retrieval.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, LLM evaluation and guardrails.
Experience in Kubernetes, microservices, serverless deployment and observability.
Excellent architecture, technical leadership and customer-facing communication skills.

Preferred Skills
Azure AI Foundry, Azure Agents, Microsoft Agent Framework.
AWS AgentCore, Strands SDK and Agents for Bedrock.
FastAPI, Django, Azure ML and Amazon SageMaker.
Elasticsearch, MarkLogic, NoSQL databases, Redis, Cosmos DB and OpenSearch.
Pharma / Life Sciences / Regulatory domain experience.
Knowledge Graphs, VLMs, SLMs and advanced RAG techniques.
Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional certification.
Research publications, technical presentations and contributions to the AI community.

Job Description:
About the Role
We are looking for Implementation Analysts Products to support the implementation and deployment of a SaaS-based Consent Management solution for Enterprise and Small & Medium-sized Business (SMB) clients.

The role involves working closely with clients, business stakeholders, product teams and technical teams to drive implementation activities from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare.
The deployment location will be Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore, depending on the client's office locations. Each deployment is expected to last approximately 68 months, and candidates may subsequently be deployed on other client projects.
Prior experience in Consent Management, DPDP or Cybersecurity is not mandatory, as product-specific training will be provided.
This is an early-career implementation role suitable for candidates with 1- 3 years of relevant experience.

Roles & Responsibilities
Support end-to-end implementation and deployment of a SaaS/product solution at client locations.
Translate business requirements into configuration and implementation activities.
Support product demonstrations, customer onboarding and configuration activities.
Identify risks proactively, mitigate them and escalate as deemed appropriate.
Coordinate integration discussions involving APIs, data flows, interfaces and technical dependencies.
Manage SMB demo and implementation deals for the Consent Management solution, with a primary focus and special emphasis on supporting Free Plan users.
Guide SMB customers through self-service setup, configuration and troubleshooting to ensure quick go-live and faster Time to Value.
Gather feedback on product experience throughout the customer lifecycle through targeted surveys.
Gather customer feedback and support continuous improvement of the implementation experience.
Travel to and work from client locations for extended deployment periods, as required.
Mandatory Skills & Eligibility Criteria
1- 3 years of experience in technology products, SaaS or Cloud products, implementation or technology consulting.
Prior exposure to customer onboarding, product demonstrations, technical support or pre-sales is preferred.
Understanding of APIs and basic general technical architecture and components is a must.
Good to have development experience in REST APIs, JavaScript and JSON/XML data structures.
Understanding of Kubernetes, Docker and deployment workflows is preferred.
Understanding of infrastructure components such as databases, queues, API gateways and firewalls is preferred.
Willingness to learn on-premise deployment concepts and assist senior team members on enterprise accounts.
Understanding of BFSI (Banking, Financial Services and Insurance) would be preferred.
Fluency in English is mandatory; fluency in Hindi is preferable.
Ability and willingness to travel to client locations for extended deployment periods.
Willingness to undergo product-specific self-paced training and certification before deployment.
Candidates must be currently based in Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore.

Employment & Engagement Conditions
The position is offered as a fixed-term contractual employment opportunity for a period of 12 months.
The contract is non-extendable and non-renewable.
Candidates selected by the client will be required to complete product-specific training and certification before deployment.
The training will be self-paced, supported by daily one-hour Q&A sessions, and will conclude with an assessment requiring a minimum score of 75%.
The pre-deployment product training period is unpaid. No salary, stipend or other payment will be provided by BDO or the client during this training period.
Upon completion of the initial deployment or assignment, employees may be considered for deployment on another project of the same client, subject to business requirements and applicable contractual terms.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
SAP Full Stack Technical Consultant (ABAP / UI5)
GDS Tax Technology
Position
EY s GDS Tax Technology team s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY s core Tax practice, you ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding ERP, database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EYs GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firms partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking a Senior to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
Key Responsibilities
Assists project teams in estimating the architecture design effort/ develop/ review/ approve architecture designs.
Ideate, design, build, test, document and delivery of technology solutions.
Ability to effectively communicate with other senior leaders of IT on program strategies and plans and negotiate quality solutions
Qualification & Experience Required
Bachelor s / Master s degree in Software Engineering / Information Technology / MBA / MCA.
4 to 8 years experience in SAP ABAP, UI5 Fiori development. Preferred with hands-on experience in SAP BTP, BAS, CAPM and Hana Cloud Project Implementations.
Independently developed new Fiori apps alongwith backend ABAP/RAP/CDS/OData development, adhering to SAP Fiori design principles.
Should have experience in minimum of one SAP S/4 Hana end to end implementation, involved in all phases.
Good knowledge in developing Interfaces between SAP & non-SAP systems and Application development using BTP framework.
Knowledge in Scrum and Project methodologies.
Experience and understanding of technology tools:
Expertise in SAP ABAP, UI5 Fiori, RAP, BTP framework and HANA Cloud.
Knowledge in Front end UI application development using CAPM, Node.JS, is preferred.
Migration of SAP ECC to latest S4 systems.
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how the SAP S/4 HANA solution can be applied to address business problems and opportunities.
Must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, working in team, analytical skills, problem-solving skills, ability to work & drive independently.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
