Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center is looking for an experienced Technical Lead - Software to lead software development activities, from requirements definition and software architecture design to coding, testing and deployment.

In this role, you will work closely with Business Lines (B/L) and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver robust, high-quality software solutions that meet functional and technical requirements, while ensuring the expected levels of quality and maturity within agreed timelines and budgets.

Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
8-10 years of relevant software development experience.

Key Skills and Competencies
We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:
Strong passion for software development, technology and delivering innovative solutions.
Proven experience in leading software design, development and deployment activities.
Expertise in software requirements management and engineering.
Strong programming skills in C/C++ and scripting languages such as Python and Bash .
Solid knowledge of the Linux operating system , embedded RTOS and Yocto distributions.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking , network protocols and low-level networking APIs.
Knowledge of Linux network configuration and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and networking components.
Experience with distributed version control systems.
Hands-on experience with network debugging and testing tools such as Wireshark .
Experience with build automation, CI/CD and test automation frameworks such as Jenkins .
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design and deliver new features.
Strong focus on software quality through code reviews, appropriate testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

Additional / Desirable Skills
Experience or knowledge in the following areas would be an advantage:
Bootloader and Linux Kernel development.
Software packaging using RPM (Red Hat Package Manager).
Linux container technologies such as Docker, LXC, OpenShift or Kubernetes.
Development of complex, multi-threaded application architectures.
SNMP protocol.
Requirements and project management tools such as DOORS and JIRA.
Build automation systems and automated software testing.
Personal Attributes
Strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment.
Proactive approach to challenges, with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Role Details:

Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai

Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

Mandatory Skills: Looking for experienced Senior PeopleSoft Technical Consultants with strong hands-on expertise in PeopleSoft technical development, production support, integration, testing, and automation using PeopleSoft Test Framework.
The consultant will be responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, and supporting PeopleSoft FSCM and/or HCM applications, while also leading automated regression testing initiatives using PeopleSoft Test Framework.
The candidate should have deep technical knowledge of PeopleTools, Application Designer, PeopleCode, Application Engine, Component Interfaces, Integration Broker, SQR, BI Publisher, PS Query, SQL, and PeopleSoft migration tools.

The consultant must have practical experience with: Installing, configuring, and using the PeopleSoft Test Framework client.
Creating and maintaining PTF test scripts.
Recording, editing, parameterizing, and executing automated test cases.
Designing reusable test components and test libraries.
Managing test data and environment-specific variables.
Troubleshooting PTF playback failures. Maintaining automated regression suites after application changes.
Supporting regression testing during PeopleSoft Update Manager cycles.
Coordinating PTF execution with QA, functional, and technical teams. Producing test execution evidence and defect-support documentation.
Identifying automation candidates across FSCM and/or HCM business processes. Required Experience 8+ years of hands-on PeopleSoft technical experience. 2+ years of experience with PeopleSoft Test Framework or have worked on PeopleSoft Test Framework on at least 2 projects.
Strong experience in PeopleSoft FSCM and/or HCM implementation, enhancement, upgrade, or support projects.
Experience working in complex PeopleSoft environments with customizations, integrations, batch processes, and reporting requirements.
Experience working with functional teams to analyze requirements and deliver technical solutions.
Experience with regression testing, automated testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
In summary, the consultant must combine strong PeopleSoft technical development experience with deep PeopleSoft Test Framework expertise to improve automation, testing quality, release confidence, and production stability.

SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.

Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.

Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification

Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills

MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Description:
what does a Learning Experience Leader really do? Think of yourself as the someone who will
create and maintain a positive and professional learning environment, so not just anyone is
qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good
company so we make sure our employees are top notch. Now we need your full concentration because
its time to imagine what it’s like being a Learning Experience Leader.
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: that you will be designing and
expanding training and development programs. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know
that it comes down to one thing: that you will ensure that Foundation Skills Training is aligned with
Product Specific Training methodologies and initiatives.
TaskUs believes in being transparent with our new employees about their job duties and the possible
impact. Some of our campaigns include disturbing content. Examples of these types of material may
include but are not limited to:
Child exploitation and abuse
Animal torture
Gang Violence
Murder
Hate Speech
As a trainer of content moderators it is important for you to know the potential risks related to this
type of work. While TaskUs is focused on employee wellness by having counselors on-site, resiliency
programming, and other wellness initiatives, exposure to graphic and disturbing content is
unavoidable. Some individuals with a sensitivity to viewing graphic or disturbing content may be at risk
for developing distress, mental health symptoms, or, in rare instances, Secondary Traumatic Stress
based on the content they are viewing.
TaskUs reserves the right to reassign trainers in content moderation to other TaskUs projects based on
staffing needs, employee performance, and other considerations.
In order to help create a community that is safe for all employees, the Resiliency and Wellness Team
takes an active role in the primary prevention of mental health concerns through direct practice efforts,
e-learning, skills training, and outreach efforts to the TaskUs community. Our programs seek to raise
awareness about psychological issues, challenge ideas that contribute to social inequity,
disempowerment, and discrimination, as well as the underlying structures that support them. In
addition, our programs empower employees to find and use their voices in a healthy and productive
way.

As a Learning Experience Leader, think of yourself as a leader that sets the standards and expectations
through your conduct, work ethic, integrity and character. You can also think of yourself as a creator in
a way that you must create and deliver end-user, partner, and distributor training which includes
curriculum, training, and exams, for all general preparatory courses prior to enterprise endorsement.
You will also need to deliver preparatory training that is sufficiently technical, covering the basic skill
requirements as identified by enterprise needs. You will also need to be able to deliver projects and
motivate trainees through effective trainings. Think of yourself as a manager in terms of design,
delivery, and you want to always continuously improve the training programs and the other learning
opportunities across the organization. You will also amend and revise programs as necessary, in order
to adapt to the changes occuring in the work environment. You will also act as the content expert and
maintain relevant training documents and training materials for training conducted. You’re also a
developer because you need to create effective induction programs. You will also need to monitor and
review the progress of the trainees through questionnaires and discuss with the managers. You have to
ensure that statutory training requirements are met and you must have an understanding of E-learning
techniques, and where relevant, being involved in the creation and/or delivery of e- learning packages.
You will also be researching new technologies and methodologies in workplace learning and presenting
this research. You will also be a cop in a way that you’ll ensure that all trainees adhere to the company’s
Code of Conduct.

So, do you have what it takes to become a Learning Experience Leader?

Requirements:
So, what is it we’re looking for? Well, since this is a Learning Experience Leader post, we’d need
someone who already has the experience to even call themselves one. So if you have at least 1-2 years
of working experience in the related field (training or teaching experience) then you’re qualified! Are
you someone who is proficient in the use of Microsoft and Google applications? Can you communicate
yourself well both orally and in written? Do you presentation and class facilitation skills? If yes, then
you’re what we need!
We need out of the box thinkers and we need someone who is creative enough to have the ability to
engage an audience. As a trainer, we also need you to have strong interpersonal, conflict management
and mentoring skills.

We need someone who is able to work in a flexible schedule including weekends, holidays and longer
hours. So we also need someone with high energy, enthusiastic, motivational training style. We also
need someone who has strong organizational, planning, project management, problem resolution,
communication, presentation, facilitation, influencing skills.

Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation

Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Job Description: Disconnect Lead
Operational leadership across Order Entry, Design, ASR/LSR and disconnect execution
Location-Bangalore / Noida

Qualification-Any Graduation (technical field preferred)

Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-2:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; aligned to U.S. core hours 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST
The Disconnect Lead provides day-to-day operational leadership for customer disconnect activities, including Order Entry, circuit and design validation, inventory removal, Access Service Requests (ASRs), Local Service Requests (LSRs), circuit implementation and disconnect cost optimization. The role oversees automated and manual workflows, manages workload and priorities, ensures milestones and SLAs are achieved, maintains quality and data accuracy, and guides the team through complex issues and fallout.
The role works across Order Entry, Transport, IP, Planning, Order Management, Finance, Implementation Coordinators, Operations, carriers, off-net vendors and automation platforms to ensure disconnect orders are completed cleanly, accurately and within committed timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the disconnect workstream, including Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR/LSR submission, inventory removal and circuit implementation.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders, critical due dates and shift coverage; balance urgent restorals, supplements/cancels and production commitments.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, aging, fallout and delivery performance; take corrective action when performance or committed dates are at risk.
Review and guide disconnect design validation, including disconnect scope, ECCKT, circuit history, CFA/PON details, prior order activity and inventory records.
Ensure ASRs/LSRs comply with ASOG and vendor-specific ordering requirements, using automated workflows and manual fallback processes when required.
Oversee the end-to-end disconnect lifecycle across data, notifications, vendor maintenance, fallout, reports, escalations, documentation and closure.
Drive disconnect cost optimization by working with internal teams to eliminate avoidable or unhealthy vendor costs to Lumen.
Review and troubleshoot complex disconnect, provisioning and automation-workflow issues; determine when escalation or specialist support is required.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, Order Entry, Transport, IP, Operations, Finance, implementation teams, carriers and off-net vendors.
Recognize competing priorities and operational risks early, taking action or escalating before customer or business commitments are affected.
Ensure process adherence, accurate account notes, logs, communications, inventory updates and compliance with company, regulatory and customer requirements.
Coach team members, provide telecom/process/tool guidance, support knowledge transfer and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Identify process gaps, recurring issues and data-integrity risks; drive standard work, quality assurance, process improvement and automation.
Provide clear operational updates to stakeholders and leadership, including status, risks, dependencies, decisions and recovery actions.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning, circuits, carrier provisioning, disconnect workflows and network operations.
Experience creating or managing ASRs/LSRs in a telecom or network-operations environment.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASOG, vendor ordering requirements and/or network implementation.
Ability to interpret circuit designs, ECCKTs, CFA/PON data, order history and disconnect documentation.
Proven experience leading or coordinating an operational team, including workload, priorities, coaching and delivery controls.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging, operational KPI, quality and productivity management.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making; ability to pivot quickly and expedite resolution in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to manage multiple orders, critical deliverables and competing priorities without losing ownership or accuracy.
Strong stakeholder and vendor coordination, with clear written and verbal communication and confidence leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership, adaptability and willingness to learn and improve processes.
Good to Have
Experience supporting customer disconnects, service terminations or disconnect cost optimization.
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Familiarity with FlightDeck automation and manual fallback processes; knowledge of Swift, SAM/Razor, PRIME, PRO/XLR or ASRI.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals, telecom OSS/BSS and Lumen provisioning/disconnect/inventory systems.
Advanced Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.
Performance Measures
Performance Area

Measures
Delivery

SLA/TAT attainment, milestone adherence, aging reduction and due-date performance.
Quality

Order, ASR/LSR, inventory and documentation accuracy; minimal fallout and rework.
Operational Control

Work allocation, backlog/WIP health, risk identification and timely corrective action.
People Leadership

Team readiness, coaching effectiveness, knowledge transfer and capability development.
Continuous Improvement

Process-gap closure, automation adoption and disconnect cost optimization.
Work Environment
Shift-based schedule as noted above; flexibility and extended hours may be required based on business and customer needs.
Frequent interaction with technicians, coordinators, managers, vendors and customer-service teams using Microsoft Teams and email.
Desk-based role requiring sustained concentration, accuracy and review of detailed information across multiple applications.

Job Description: Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist

Location-Bangalore / Noida


Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-3:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; coverage aligned to 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with on-call/tier support


Job Summary
The Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist owns the end-to-end lifecycle of disconnect escalations and network restorals, including intake, triage, prioritization, escalation to the right team at the right time, coordinated resolution, stakeholder communication and closure. The role combines real-time escalation ownership with data-driven visibility into aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies and recurring issues.
The role protects disconnect production teams from ad-hoc interruption by enforcing a single approved intake path, applying defined engagement criteria and using a tiered support model. The specialist works across provisioning teams, Operations, IP/Transport, internal stakeholders, carriers and vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Coverage and Operating Model
Coverage aligns to Lumen Disconnect core hours of 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with after-hours/on-call support based on the approved tier model.
Assignment to the Restoral & Escalation pod is time-bound, with a recommended minimum rotation of 90 days to build proficiency and consistent ownership.
Primary intake is through Salesforce email-to-case/ticketing and approved escalation channels; ad-hoc technician requests are redirected to the approved intake path.
Priority order: (1) restoration of services, (2) supplement/cancel requests, (3) Salesforce tickets and disconnect tasking by priority, and (4) backlog/WIP.
Tiered support: Tier 1 Restoral & Escalation pod, Tier 2 identified SMEs/leads and Tier 3 leadership escalation based on formal thresholds.
Key Responsibilities
Own real-time restoral and Salesforce escalation intake; triage and assign work using defined engagement criteria such as outage/restoral impact, PON/off-net impact, executive escalation, supplements/cancels, aging, customer impact and due date.
Determine the priority, required owner and escalation path; move issues to the right team at the right time when SLA, priority or risk thresholds are met.
Own escalation tickets and associated tasks through resolution and closure, ensuring clear handoffs, actions, owners and time-bound follow-through.
Coordinate restoration and disconnect execution across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations, Transport, IP, SMEs/leads, carriers, LECs and vendors.
Provide proactive stakeholder updates covering status, ETA, dependencies, next action and next update time; prepare executive-ready risk and status reporting.
Monitor operational data and validate order, milestone and disconnect information for accuracy and completeness; identify and correct discrepancies with the responsible team.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, exceptions, repeated follow-ups and delivery risks; prioritize according to service/customer impact and business urgency.
Analyze recurring issues and trends, support root-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions that reduce aging, exceptions and repeat escalations.
Apply guardrails to protect disconnect production teams from unnecessary context switching; engage non-pod technicians only when approved outage/escalation criteria are met.
Document actions, decisions, outcomes and lessons learned; contribute to standard work, operational controls and continuous improvement.
Support reporting, dashboards and automation for escalations, aging, response times, throughput, update cadence and operational trade-offs.
Participate in the Restoral & Escalation rotation, on-call/tier model and outage bridges; mentor others toward steady-state proficiency.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Experience in telecom/network operations, restoration, incident/escalation management or disconnect/provisioning workflows such as Order Entry, Design/ASR or IP/Transport.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning, disconnect or order escalations through closure.
Working knowledge of ticketing/intake processes such as Salesforce and disciplined case-management practices.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies, dependencies and business/customer impact.
Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams without losing ownership, documentation quality or communication cadence.
Strong analytical and data-validation skills, with the ability to identify trends, exceptions, discrepancies and operational risks.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis capability.
Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams, carriers and vendors and to work effectively within a tiered escalation model.
Strong written and verbal communication, including executive-ready updates and confidence to raise risks and request decisions.
Ability to apply engagement criteria and operating guardrails while balancing production protection with restoration urgency.
Strong ownership and follow-through; comfort working in a rotation/on-call model and supporting outage bridges or major incidents.
Good to Have
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience and knowledge of off-net or multi-vendor disconnect scenarios.
Experience with Granite/XNG, Salesforce or similar telecom provisioning, ticketing and inventory systems.
Advanced Excel capability, including PivotTables, lookups and formulas; Power BI/dashboard development and SQL for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience and experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.
Performance Measures
Performance Area

Measures
Restoration

Mean time to restore and adherence to priority/restoration thresholds.
Escalation Responsiveness

Response time, update cadence compliance and time to engage the correct support tier.
Triage Quality

Correct priority and resource selection, complete intake, minimal rework and effective handoffs.
Operational Health

Aging reduction, backlog/WIP visibility, closure rate and repeat-escalation reduction.
Stakeholder Experience

Clear ownership, fewer repeated follow-ups and useful executive-ready updates.
Sustainability

After-hours load visibility and adherence to rotation/coverage guardrails.
Work Environment
May require participation in on-call/tiered escalation schedules, after-hours support and rapid response during outages.
Frequent coordination through Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, email, outage bridges and operational dashboards.
Role success depends on disciplined intake, accurate documentation, clear ownership, consistent communication and follow-through.

The Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist owns the end-to-end lifecycle of disconnect escalations and network restorals, including intake, triage, prioritization, escalation to the right team at the right time, coordinated resolution, stakeholder communication and closure. The role combines real-time escalation ownership with data-driven visibility into aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies and recurring issues.
The role protects disconnect production teams from ad-hoc interruption by enforcing a single approved intake path, applying defined engagement criteria and using a tiered support model. The specialist works across provisioning teams, Operations, IP/Transport, internal stakeholders, carriers and vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Coverage and Operating Model
Coverage aligns to Lumen Disconnect core hours of 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with after-hours/on-call support based on the approved tier model.
Assignment to the Restoral & Escalation pod is time-bound, with a recommended minimum rotation of 90 days to build proficiency and consistent ownership.
Primary intake is through Salesforce email-to-case/ticketing and approved escalation channels; ad-hoc technician requests are redirected to the approved intake path.
Priority order: (1) restoration of services, (2) supplement/cancel requests, (3) Salesforce tickets and disconnect tasking by priority, and (4) backlog/WIP.
Tiered support: Tier 1 Restoral & Escalation pod, Tier 2 identified SMEs/leads and Tier 3 leadership escalation based on formal thresholds.
Key Responsibilities
Own real-time restoral and Salesforce escalation intake; triage and assign work using defined engagement criteria such as outage/restoral impact, PON/off-net impact, executive escalation, supplements/cancels, aging, customer impact and due date.
Determine the priority, required owner and escalation path; move issues to the right team at the right time when SLA, priority or risk thresholds are met.
Own escalation tickets and associated tasks through resolution and closure, ensuring clear handoffs, actions, owners and time-bound follow-through.
Coordinate restoration and disconnect execution across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations, Transport, IP, SMEs/leads, carriers, LECs and vendors.
Provide proactive stakeholder updates covering status, ETA, dependencies, next action and next update time; prepare executive-ready risk and status reporting.
Monitor operational data and validate order, milestone and disconnect information for accuracy and completeness; identify and correct discrepancies with the responsible team.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, exceptions, repeated follow-ups and delivery risks; prioritize according to service/customer impact and business urgency.
Analyze recurring issues and trends, support root-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions that reduce aging, exceptions and repeat escalations.
Apply guardrails to protect disconnect production teams from unnecessary context switching; engage non-pod technicians only when approved outage/escalation criteria are met.
Document actions, decisions, outcomes and lessons learned; contribute to standard work, operational controls and continuous improvement.
Support reporting, dashboards and automation for escalations, aging, response times, throughput, update cadence and operational trade-offs.
Participate in the Restoral & Escalation rotation, on-call/tier model and outage bridges; mentor others toward steady-state proficiency.

Experience in telecom/network operations, restoration, incident/escalation management or disconnect/provisioning workflows such as Order Entry, Design/ASR or IP/Transport.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning, disconnect or order escalations through closure.
Working knowledge of ticketing/intake processes such as Salesforce and disciplined case-management practices.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies, dependencies and business/customer impact.

Strong analytical and data-validation skills, with the ability to identify trends, exceptions, discrepancies and operational risks.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis capability.
Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams, carriers and vendors and to work effectively within a tiered escalation model.
Strong written and verbal communication, including executive-ready updates and confidence to raise risks and request decisions.
Ability to apply engagement criteria and operating guardrails while balancing production protection with restoration urgency.
Strong ownership and follow-through; comfort working in a rotation/on-call model and supporting outage bridges or major incidents.

Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience and knowledge of off-net or multi-vendor disconnect scenarios.
Experience with Granite/XNG, Salesforce or similar telecom provisioning, ticketing and inventory systems.

Power Automate, VBA or Python experience and experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Ability to interpret circuit designs, ECCKTs, CFA/PON data, order history and disconnect documentation.
Proven experience leading or coordinating an operational team, including workload, priorities, coaching and delivery controls.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging, operational KPI, quality and productivity management.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making; ability to pivot quickly and expedite resolution in a fast-paced environment.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Title: Senior React.js Front-End Developer
Location: Remote
Experience: 4 - 8 Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners
About the Role:
We are looking for a talented and experienced React.js Front-End Developer to join our dynamic web development team. You will be responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and performant web applications using React.js, working closely with cross-functional teams including UX/UI designers, backend developers, and product managers.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications using React.js and related front-end technologies.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect, user-friendly interfaces.
Optimize components for maximum performance across a wide range of devices and browsers.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
Integrate RESTful APIs and manage state using Redux or Context API.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration.
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications as needed.
Mentor junior developers and help improve front-end development processes.
Required Skills Qualifications:
4 - 8 years of professional experience in front-end development using React.js .
Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and modern front-end build tools (Webpack, Babel, etc.).
Experience with state management libraries like Redux , Context API , or similar.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, asynchronous programming, and handling API integrations.
Knowledge of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards.
Experience with version control tools such as Git .
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team.
Good communication skills to coordinate with remote and on-site teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with TypeScript is a plus.
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or server-side rendering frameworks like Next.js.
Work Environment:
Hybrid working model with a combination of in-office (Mumbai/Bangalore) and remote work.
Collaborative and fast-paced environment focused on innovation and continuous learning.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Description:
Position: Physiotherapist
Location: Kolaghat, West Bengal
Reporting To: State Programme Manager
Project Duration: As per project period (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
The position will lead the physiotherapy services project across Kolaghat, West Bengal. The role will ensure timely achievement of project objectives, provide technical guidance to state teams, oversee quality implementation of physiotherapy interventions, and ensure compliance with donor and organisational requirements while documenting key learnings and best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct outreach physiotherapy services for elderly persons at the physiotherapy center at Anekal, Bangalore, Old age homes and community.
Coordinate with the Physiotherapist Consultant and project team to ensure continuity of care, referrals where required, regular follow-up and all other project deliverables as per MoU with donor
Undertake basic assessment and provide physiotherapy interventions for elderly persons experiencing mobility difficulties, chronic pain, post-injury conditions and other functional limitations, as appropriate.
Provide guidance on mobility and assistive devices, including safe use of walkers, wheelchairs, walking sticks and other devices, and follow up on their appropriate utilisation.
Maintain regular records and data entry and generate monthly reports for old age homes and physiotherapy center
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies & Experience
Bachelor of Physiotherapy Therapy
1-3 years of relevant experience with relevant state / IAP registration.
Key Competencies
Good planning, coordination and implementation skills.
Strong communication, analytical, reporting and documentation abilities.
Familiarity with MIS is desirable.
Ability to coordinate with teams and undertake regular field visits.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Report to Chief Operating Officer

Roles and Responsibilities:
Planning: -
- Assist in formulating the company's direction and supporting tactical initiatives

- Maintain appropriate insurance coverage
- Ensure that the company complies with all legal and regulatory requirements
- Ensure that record keeping meets the requirements of auditors and government agencies
- Report risk issues to the audit committee
- Maintain relations with external auditors and investigate their findings and recommendations

Funding: -
- Monitor cash balances and cash forecasts
- Invest funds

Description:
About the Role
Lords Mobility is looking for highly motivated and result-oriented sales professionals to drive business expansion in assigned territories across India.
The candidate will be responsible for developing dealer networks, appointing new channel partners, driving sales, establishing NBFC and finance partner tie-ups, and achieving business targets.
We are looking for business-oriented professionals with strong knowledge of the automobile/EV market, particularly the 3-wheeler segment, who can independently develop and grow their assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
1. Territory Management & Business Development
Take complete ownership of assigned territory and achieve sales targets.
Identify potential markets and opportunities for business expansion.
Develop and execute territory-wise sales and expansion strategies.
Build Lords Mobility's market presence.
2. Dealer Network Development
Identify, appoint and onboard new dealers and distributors.
Develop a strong and active dealer network.
Maintain relationships with existing dealers and drive business growth.
Ensure dealer activation and consistent sales performance.
3. Sales & Revenue Generation
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Drive primary and secondary sales through dealer networks.
Monitor dealer-wise sales performance and improve conversions.
Develop new business opportunities and increase market penetration.
4. NBFC & Finance Partner Tie-ups
Identify and onboard NBFCs, banks and financial institutions.
Establish finance partnerships to support vehicle sales.
Develop relationships with finance partners and ensure smooth financing support for dealers and customers.
5. Market Research & Reporting
Monitor competitor activities, pricing and market trends.
Identify new dealer locations and business opportunities.
Prepare sales forecasts, territory plans and dealer development reports.
Conduct regular market visits and provide business updates to management.

Candidate Requirements
Bachelor's degree preferred.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Automobile or Electric Vehicle sales.
Candidates with experience in 3-wheeler sales (Electric or Conventional) will be strongly preferred.
Experience in dealer appointment, dealer onboarding and channel sales.
Experience in achieving sales targets and developing new markets.
Knowledge of NBFC tie-ups, vehicle financing and finance partner onboarding.
Strong negotiation, communication and relationship management skills.
Ability to independently manage the assigned territory.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
AboutCompany:
Lords Mark Tech Next Pvt. Ltd., operating under the brand name Lords Mobility, is an emerging electric vehicle manufacturer committed to transforming India's mobility landscape through innovative, reliable and sustainable transportation solutions.
Established in February 2020 and headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra, the company is engaged in manufacturing a wide range of electric vehicles, including electric two-wheelers, passenger and cargo three-wheelers, e-rickshaws, electric loaders and specialized electric vehicles for commercial applications.
With manufacturing facilities in Manesar, Haryana, and Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, Lords Mobility is expanding its presence across India through a growing dealer network and strategic business partnerships.
The company aims to deliver affordable, efficient and sustainable mobility solutions while creating business opportunities for dealers, channel partners and customers across the country.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a customer-oriented female CRM cum Tele caller Executive to handle customer interactions, lead management, follow-ups, and maintain customer relationships. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to coordinate effectively with the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers and handle incoming inquiries.
Follow up with prospects, and maintain customer relationships.
Maintain and update customer databases and records in CRM software.
Handle customer queries, provide relevant information, and ensure timely follow-ups.
Schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, and support the sales team.
Track leads, customer interactions, and follow-up activities.
Prepare daily calling reports and achieve assigned targets.


Required Skills:
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Office.
Good convincing, customer-handling, and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a team and manage multiple tasks.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and target-oriented approach.


Candidates with 0-3 years of experience are welcome. Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany:
At Shine Enterprise, we believe that uninterrupted power is the foundation of every successful business. With 16+ years of experience in the power generation industry, we are committed to providing reliable, efficient, and dependable power solutions that keep businesses running with confidence.
Based in Guwahati, Assam, Shine Enterprise is an Authorised Dealer of Kirloskar Diesel Generators (KOEL DG Sets), serving customers across Northeast India. We cater to the diverse power requirements of industries, builders, contractors, electrical consultants, hotels, hospitals, commercial establishments, infrastructure projects, and government organizations

AboutCompany:
We are the second largest franchisee in the world (outside US) of carbonated soft drinks (CSDs) and non-carbonated beverages (NCBs) sold under trademarks owned by PepsiCo and a key player in the beverage industry. In addition, we have set up backward integration facilities for production of preforms, crowns, corrugated boxes, plastic crates and shrink-wrap films in certain of our production facilities to ensure operational efficiencies and quality standards.

We are hiring at ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company

Title :- Unit Sales Manager - Health Agency

#HealthVertical - Agency channel

#Benefits : Fixed CTC + Monthly Incentive + conveyance allowance

#Location : Silchar (Assam)

#Minimum Experience: 1-7 years

Type of position: Full Time

Industry preferred :- SAHI, LI, GI, Banking, Mutual Funds

Roles and Responsibilities will be :
1) Sales of Health Insurance Products through Agency Channel.
2) Recruit and Train leaders who can develop a distribution channel of Agents and Generate business through them in the assigned territory.
3) Responsible for sourcing of agents and tracking their agent base and business regularly.
4) To support these leaders in meeting agents, lead providers, intermediaries on a regular basis and maintaining records of the same in a planned manner.

Preferred candidate profile :
1) At least 6 months of on field sales experience in Agency/any Insurance product.
2) Graduation is mandatory, candidates holding Diploma or Part Time degree certificates will not fit in criteria.
3) Need to work on 100% on-field for sale of health policies.

Perks and benefits : (Benefits you will receive from our organization)
1) 5 Days working (Saturday & Sunday off)
2) Travelling/Petrol Reimbursement.
3) Mediclaim and term-life insurance.
4) Candidates will be on the payroll of the organization.

Interested candidates can mail us your updated resume on the given mail id : monika.n@ext.icicilombard

Kindly mention on mail :
Current CTC
Expected CTC
Notice Period

Regards
Monika Nainway

Job Location : Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Pune (PCMC Area), Nagpur, Indore, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ludhiana

Products Segment - Vascular, Aneasthesia, Neonates, Vascular, Hemodynamics , Critical Care,
Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities -
Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers, including hospitals, nursing homes, healthcare institutions, and distributors.
Promote and demonstrate company products to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.
Generate product demand through regular field visits and customer engagement activities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to territory revenue growth.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, surgeons, nursing staff, purchase managers, biomedical teams, OT technicians, and other key stakeholders.
Provide product-related training, demonstrations, and support to customers.
Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business
Ensure timely secondary sales generation and coordinate with internal teams for efficient order processing and product delivery.
Monitor inventory availability and support demand forecasting activities.
Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections in line with company policies.
Maintain accurate sales records and submit periodic sales and market reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile -
Minimum 4 years experience in sales of Medical Devices / Pharma industry.
Experience working with specialists such as Anesthesiologists, Pediatricians, Neonatologists, Oncologists, and Surgeons will be preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
AboutCompany: Vygon ,Founded in 1962 in couen, has gradually expanded across all five continents. After building strong foundations in Europe, the group extended its presence to North and South America, and later to the Middle East and Asia. Today, Vygon relies on 26 subsidiaries, 11 production sites including 8 in Europe and the dedication of more than 2750 team members, who provide nearly 210 million medical devices each year for 4,000 customers. Vygon designs, manufactures and markets high-tech single-use medical devices for healthcare professionals.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and SEA. OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points

Job Details
Job Title: Loan Officer-Micro Banking
Grade: DM-I
Department: Micro Banking
Location: Branch
Type of Position: Full-time
Reports To: CRM
Reporting Into: NA
Job Summary
Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivan's products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
Financial size: 5-7 Cr. loan portfolio
Non-financial size: NA

Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for Unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre and post-loan activities related to Unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.
