Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Job Summary
Function Summary: The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience, especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in a) resolving policy service needs; b) renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs; cross-sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referrals for new agent hiring.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Agent Recruitment - Follow agent hiring mechanism and other hiring norms.
Agent Development - Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Agent Development - Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Agent Development - Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Agent Development - Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets - Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Meet Business Targets - Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Meet Business Targets - Ensure company's product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Meet Business Targets - Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador, a customer champion.
Customer Centricity - Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success - Achievement of business plan GPA.
Measures of Success - Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Measures of Success - Number MTD Active; Persistency as per grid; Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria: 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Job Title - VTEX Commerce Architect - Manager - ACS Song
Management Level: Level 7-Manager
Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai
Must have skills: VTEX, VTEX IO, FastStore, Store Framework, Headless Commerce, GraphQL, React/Next.js, Commerce Architecture
Good to have skills: Enterprise Integration, Cloud-Native Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, DevSecOps, Agile Delivery
Experience: 13 - 15 years of experience is required, including strong enterprise commerce architecture experience
Educational Qualification: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced VTEX Commerce Architect with 13-15 years of overall technology experience and proven expertise in architecting enterprise-scale digital commerce solutions using VTEX. The candidate will own end-to-end solution architecture across VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, headless storefronts, GraphQL APIs, integrations, security, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
The ideal candidate should combine hands-on VTEX platform knowledge with strong architectural thinking. The role requires translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, evaluating native VTEX capabilities versus custom extensions, leading architecture governance, and guiding distributed engineering teams through design and delivery.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own and drive the end-to-end architecture of enterprise digital commerce solutions built on the VTEX Commerce Platform.
Define solution architecture covering catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, payments, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and VTEX Master Data.
Design modern storefront solutions using VTEX Store Framework, VTEX IO, FastStore, React, Next.js, and GraphQL.
Lead the design of headless and composable commerce architectures, including presentation, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), commerce services, CMS, search, identity, and enterprise integration layers.
Evaluate business requirements and determine when to use native VTEX capabilities, VTEX IO applications, custom services, middleware, or third-party products.
Define GraphQL and REST API contracts, schema design, API aggregation, versioning, caching, rate limiting, security, and error-handling standards.
Design integrations between VTEX and ERP, PIM/MDM, OMS, WMS, CRM, payment gateways, tax services, identity providers, search platforms, and marketplaces.
Define synchronous, asynchronous, webhook, and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate retry, idempotency, dead-letter, reconciliation, and observability mechanisms.
Establish non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, reliability, accessibility, SEO, maintainability, security, privacy, and disaster recovery.
Design storefront performance strategies using SSR, SSG/ISR, CDN, edge caching, browser caching, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals principles.
Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical risk assessments, production issue reviews, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation planning.
Create and maintain HLDs, LLDs, C4 diagrams, sequence diagrams, integration specifications, API specifications, data-flow diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records.
Guide engineering teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architecture principles, coding standards, security controls, and operational requirements.
Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, client architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, and delivery leadership to align architecture with business objectives.
Mentor technical leads, senior developers, and architects, while promoting engineering excellence and continuous learning.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Deep architectural and implementation knowledge of VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, and VTEX APIs.
Strong understanding of VTEX commerce domains including catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and Master Data.
Proven experience designing headless and composable commerce solutions using API-first and MACH-aligned principles.
Strong expertise in GraphQL, including schema design, queries, mutations, fragments, resolvers, federation/aggregation considerations, caching, and performance optimization.
Strong understanding of React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, SSR, SSG/ISR, frontend state management, web accessibility, SEO, and storefront performance.
Experience defining BFF patterns and clear boundaries between storefront, VTEX, middleware, and backend services.
Deep knowledge of microservices, domain-driven design concepts, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, API management, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SSO, secrets management, secure API design, OWASP practices, and PCI considerations.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, CDN, observability, autoscaling, and resilient deployment patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated quality gates, environment strategy, release governance, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Understanding of observability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting tools.
Ability to assess architecture trade-offs, document technical decisions, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven experience leading architecture governance and technical delivery across multiple workstreams and distributed teams.
Strong architectural thinking, structured problem solving, and the ability to work effectively with ambiguous requirements.
Ability to make, explain, and defend technical decisions using evidence, constraints, risks, and trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for business and client stakeholders.
Confidence in leading architecture discussions, discovery sessions, design workshops, and technical governance forums.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration across product, engineering, security, infrastructure, and third-party teams.
Proactive ownership of risks, dependencies, assumptions, and technical gaps, with clear mitigation and escalation.
Ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leads while providing constructive design and code-review guidance.
Comfort working with geographically distributed teams and balancing strategic architecture with delivery priorities.
Strong accountability, decision-making maturity, negotiation skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Experience with Kafka or other messaging/event-streaming technologies and enterprise API gateways. Knowledge of Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, enterprise IAM platforms, payment orchestration, fraud services, and tax engines. Experience delivering high-volume B2C, B2B, marketplace, or omnichannel commerce programs across multiple regions. Familiarity with Agile delivery, multi-team program governance, estimation, and technical planning. VTEX certifications, relevant cloud certifications, or documented participation in commerce architecture communities. (do not remove the hyperlink)

Experience

Domain

ASIC / SoC Turnkey Silicon

Full-time

The Role
Define micro-architecture and lead RTL design and SoC/subsystem integration for complex silicon, owning PPA and design quality through tape-out.

Define micro-architecture, block partitioning and interface specifications from system requirements.
Own PPA trade-offs and RTL quality: lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis and constraints (SDC, UPF).
Lead subsystem and SoC integration, and drive design and code reviews.
Partner with DV, DFT and PD to close verification, testability, timing and power.

15+ years in RTL design and integration, with multiple tape-outs in a lead or architect role.
Expert Verilog / SystemVerilog and strong micro-architecture skills.
Deep experience with AMBA (AXI/AHB/APB), NoC and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB.
Solid grasp of low-power design (UPF), clocking, CDC/RDC and timing-driven RTL.
Proficiency with front-end tools: lint, CDC, synthesis, STA; scripting in Python, Perl or Tcl.
Clear technical communication with customers and cross-functional teams.

Good to Have
ARM or RISC-V subsystem integration
Die-to-die / UCIe and chiplet architectures
Post-silicon debug experience

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for increasing the penetration of Tata Genuine Parts in authorised workshops by driving the availability of parts throughout the assigned territory. It involve working closely with distributer to ensure the availability and consumption of parts by executing sales and demand fulfilment strategy leading to increase sales and market share. It also involves ensuring parts availability of NPI models.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning and Execution:
Drive effective stock planning by monitoring stock levels, supply constraints and demand levels and also ensure that fast moving parts are replenished through auto ordering system
Ensure the availability of parts for newly launched vehicles
Drive adherence to sales process guidelines set by the organization
Drive primary part sales and ensure targets are achieved within respective territory and drive secondary sales through consumption demand
Ensure demand fulfilment by coordinate with workshop, distributers and internal team to ensure that product is available when required:
Drive sales targets in the respective territory by execute various demand generating activities like schemes, holding mechanic meets, Customer meets
Coordinate and ensure the proper movement and supply of parts with PHQ
Improve turnaround time TAT by ensuring the availably of parts availability and improve the following scores: DSI, CSI, TSI, NPS, CEI
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives
Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition in assigned area and use insights on competition pricing and distribution strategies to help improve organizations own strategies and tactics
2. Financial Management:
Monitor and ensure channel partners financial health by helping secure availability of financial options, conducting stock analysis and receivable management
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
3. Relationship Management:
Work collaboratively with channel partners to understand their issues and be an integral part in providing solutions at various levels
Collaborate and maintain channel partner communication and share best practices
4. People Management:
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping, timely ordering of parts, DPM, TPM, new products and new initiative

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Warehouse
Servicing of Orders, providing e-permits.
Central Logistics team
Tracking shipments
Tech Cell
Tech Cell

Distributors
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
Dealers
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
TASS
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
Key account Customer
Create the awareness about TGP benefit and resolve the parts availability issue
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments

Desired Candidate Profile
Education B E (Mechanical / Automobile Engg) : Optional MBA from renowned B school
Relevant Experience: 3-4 years
Experience in Automobile Industry
Experience in B2B or Channel Sales or Auto Component Sales
Knowledge of English , Hindi & Regional Language is a Must
Technical Knowledge of Spare Parts
Knowledge SAP, CRM
Knowledge of Channel Management and Supply Management

Analytical Skills

Interpersonal Skills
Relationship Building skills
Negotiation Skills
Selling Skills
Time Management Skills
Problem Solving Skills
Service Orientation
Business Acumen

Description:
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager (ASM) will be responsible for driving B2B sales growth within the assigned territory by managing and mentoring a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs). The role focuses on retailer acquisition, retention, order growth, relationship management, and execution excellence on the Superstore by Nykaa platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Drive territory-wise revenue targets and ensure achievement of monthly/quarterly sales goals.
Increase retailer onboarding and active buyer base on the Superstore platform.
Improve order frequency and average order value (AOV).
Identify high-potential markets and expansion opportunities.
2. Team Management & Development
Manage, train, and mentor the team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) within the assigned territory.
Set clear KPIs and performance expectations for BDEs.
Conduct regular field visits and joint sales calls to guide the team.
Motivate BDEs to meet and exceed targets.
3. Retailer Acquisition & Relationship Management
Travel within the assigned territory to onboard new retailers.
Support BDEs in acquiring and activating new retailers.
Build long-term relationships with key retailers to ensure retention and repeat business.
Address retailer concerns and coordinate with internal teams for resolution.
Collect market intelligence and competitor insights.
4. Sales Execution & Process Implementation
Implement structured sales processes to help BDEs identify and prioritize key accounts and prospects.
Monitor team performance metrics (coverage, productivity, conversion rates).
Ensure proper usage and adoption of the Superstore app among retailers.
Drive promotional campaigns and new product launches in the territory.
5. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Provide regular sales performance reports to senior management.
Share customer feedback, demand trends, and improvement suggestions.
Maintain accurate sales data and territory records.

Description:
Purpose of the Admission Officer role:
Admission officer is responsible for lead generation through variety of marketing activities resulting in counselling and enrolling the students.
As an Admission officer, you are expected to:
Generate admissions by maintaining a continuous influx of data by conducting Above The Line (ATL) & Below The Line (BTL) marketing activities such as- seminars in schools, open seminars in town & residential spots within a specified territory.
Contribute towards set targets by doing school visits for meeting principals, coordinators and management personals for business development.
Ensure a delightful customer experience while going for home visits to counsel students and parents and close admissions resulting in enrolling the students.
Capitalize on business opportunities by liaising with local tuition teachers.
Ensure adherence to internal processes and compliances.
To be successful in the Admission Officer role you are required to have:
Ability to handle customers in a calm, empathic & patient manner, along with strong sales persuasion skills.
Excellent networking and presentation skills to conduct seminars.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and writing emails, & comfortable while working on software related to Sales & Services.
Fluency in communication of English and Regional Language.
Comfortable for traveling and public speaking.

Qualification:
Must have bachelors degree.
Preferred BTech / MBA /Masters in Psychology, Education etc.
Experience:
Previous experience in counselling in education or careers counselling.
Previous experience of Business to Customer (B2C) Sales across industries.

About Us
Aakash Educational Services Ltd. (AESL) is one of Indias most trusted names in test preparation, known for providing students with a competitive edge through classroom, digital, hybrid and distance learning programs. We specialize in coaching for major medical and engineering entrance exams such as NEET and JEE (Main & Advanced), as well as school/board examinations, scholarship tests, and Olympiads.
Our philosophy of “Student First” drives everything we do. With highly qualified and passionate faculty, we focus on understanding each student’s unique learning needs and guiding them to achieve their goals. AESL is committed to expanding its reach nationwide, delivering high-quality education to students in every corner of the country, including regions where access to physical classrooms is limited.
We are proud to be certified a Great Place to Work ® for five consecutive years.
Aakash Advantage
As a leader in competitive exam preparation, AESL offers a workplace where passionate individuals can make a lasting difference. What sets Aakash apart:
Nationwide Presence and Growth: With more than 400 branches across India, AESL provides employees ample opportunities to grow within a leading educational brand.
Student-Centric Culture: Over 10,000 employees collaborate with expert faculty members, united in their commitment to mentoring and building the success of students.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Aakash’s fully digitized classrooms and hybrid learning models combine traditional teaching with advanced digital methods, keeping employees at the forefront of educational innovation.
Proven Impact: Aakash’s results speak for themselves, with 9 Lakh+ NEET and JEE qualifiers over the years, including All India Rank 1 in NEET and JEE (Advanced).

Job description:The FSE will be responsible for acquiring new clients, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and drive revenue growth for advertising space in print media. Sales & Revenue Growth:
Achieve sales targets as defined by the organization. Motivate clients to choose bigger ads and run them more often to increase revenue.
Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:
Identify and visit prospective clients through internal database or internal references. Offer print advertisement solutions that match the clients business goals. Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships. Win repeat business from Clients by giving steady, reliable service.
Solution-Oriented Pitching:
Understand the clients business needs and develop customized marketing proposal. Use data insights, wherever possible, to help clients reach more customers in new areas. Coordinate with internal departments (Billing, RO Generation, Scheduling) to ensure smooth ad execution. Follow up for payments and ensure timely collections.

Brief About company:

A pioneering brand in the radio space, 94.3 MY FM is the radio business of DB Corp Ltd. Launched in 2006, MY FM took a bottom-up approach and set up its network across 30 Tier II & III cities across 7 states, building on the strong local understanding that Bhaskar Group had in these markets. True to its brand name which signifies the emotional ownership and personalized approach of the station, MY FM has successfully established a network of 30 highly localized stations focusing on individual market preferences. Constantly evolving and innovating its offerings, MY FM draws a keen focus on its brand philosophy of 'Jiyo Dil Se', forging an emotional connect with its listeners while continually creating offerings to suit local tastes. Capitalizing on the strengths of the medium, MY FM has become India's leading Local FM Network backed by in-depth market understating and high audience engagement. The brand philosophy is extended into every aspect of MY FM, encouraging listeners to live their life to the fullest while giving the brand a young and vibrant feel. SUMMARY
Project Manager
About the Role

This position serves as a pivotal leadership role dedicated to steering complex initiatives from inception to successful delivery. The primary objective is to orchestrate comprehensive planning, resource allocation, and execution strategies that align with organizational goals and client expectations. By bridging the gap between technical architecture and business needs, the incumbent ensures that project scope is clearly defined, risks are proactively managed, and high-quality deliverables are produced on schedule. This role is essential for maintaining operational excellence and fostering strong collaboration across all project stakeholders.

Location: Raipur

Experience: 12-17 years
Key Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth analysis of project requirements to clearly define scope, objectives, and success criteria.
Develop robust Project Management Plans, including detailed budget forecasts and cost projections that adhere to corporate standards and deadlines.
Partner closely with Solution Architects to design technical frameworks and define the overall system architecture.
Lead high-level design initiatives derived from analysis documents and create prototypes to validate design choices.
Facilitate clear and timely communication regarding project status, changes, and milestones with all stakeholders.
Author and maintain essential documentation, such as System and Integration Test Plans, User and Operations Manuals, Installation Guides, and Development Standards using approved templates.
Oversee the completion of internal quality reviews for all project deliverables to ensure compliance with standards.
Evaluate and monitor test cases to guarantee their comprehensiveness and the overall quality of the testing process.
Support the Project Manager in organizing external reviews and securing necessary approvals and sign-offs.
Execute risk assessment and management strategies to identify, evaluate, and mitigate potential project threats.
Review change requests to estimate effort requirements and assess their impact on timelines and deliverables.



Requirements
Demonstrated experience managing projects involving government clients.
Proven track record of leading large-scale web application development initiatives.
Possesses strong analytical abilities, coordination skills, and effective communication capabilities.
Extensive background in project planning, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement.
A proactive approach to identifying potential challenges and implementing data-driven solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills capable of engaging with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
Professional proficiency in English or Hindi.

Meet group coordinator/host(ess) prior to functions, make introductions, and ensure that all arrangements are agreeable. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for the quality, consistency and production of the restaurant kitchen. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Coordinates menus, purchasing, staffing and food preparation for the propertys restaurant. Works with team to improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Develops and trains team to improve results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met for Restaurant
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions for restaurant.
- Supervises restaurant kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Maintains food preparation handling and correct storage standards.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Plans and manages food quantities and plating requirements for the restaurant.
- Communications production needs to key personnel.
- Assists in developing daily and seasonal menu items for the restaurant.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Estimates daily restaurant production needs.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Leading Kitchen Team
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Leads shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Supervises and manages restaurant kitchen employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensuring and maintaining the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Establishing and Maintaining Restaurant Kitchen Goals
- Sets and supports achievement of kitchen goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Developing specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations work.
- Understands the impact of kitchen operation on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Effectively investigates, reports and follows-up on employee accidents.
- Knows and implements company safety standards.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Participates in training restaurant staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

1. Sales Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage a team of Field Sales Executives (FSEs) and sales professionals.
Set monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the team.
Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and coaching sessions.
Drive accountability through daily activity tracking and sales monitoring.
Develop team capabilities through mentoring and field accompaniment.
2. Revenue Generation & Business Development
Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
Build and manage a robust 90-day sales pipeline.
Identify and acquire new advertisers across categories.
Drive client retention, renewal, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure strong conversion rates from prospecting to closure.
3. Client Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, and decision-makers.
Understand client business objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Conduct effective sales presentations and proposal discussions.
Handle negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract closures professionally.
Maintain long-term advertiser relationships and enhance client satisfaction.

Develop strong understanding of key categories such as: Education / Real Estate / Automobile / Retail / FMCG / BFSI
Track market trends, competitor activities, launches, and promotional opportunities.
Identify category-wise revenue opportunities and develop growth strategies, Prepare category acquisition and retention plans.

Promote print advertising solutions and integrated media offerings.
Understand ad inventory, pricing structures, packages, and campaign planning.
Guide clients on campaign execution, visibility, reach, and impact.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders for seamless campaign delivery.
6. Communication & Presentation
Prepare client-specific proposals and sales presentations.
Conduct effective client meetings, pitches, and business reviews.
Communicate professionally in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
Deliver regular sales updates and business reports.
7. Planning & Business Analytics
Track sales performance using Excel, CRM, and reporting tools.
Analyse category trends, revenue performance, client retention, and market opportunities.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business plans.
Develop action plans to improve productivity and revenue realization.

Graduate in any discipline / MBA in Marketing / Sales / Business Development preferred.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Post Details
Post: Associate Professor of Practice
Qualification: Minimum qualification as per regular Associate Professor; Ph.D. desirable, not essential
Experience: Minimum 20 years in industry or government
Pay Scale / Level: Overall compensation equivalent to that of regular Associate Professor
Entry Pay: Not specified in the notice
Professor (Level 14A, - 2,20,200), Associate Professor (Level 13A2, - 2,11,300), Professor of Practice, Associate Professor of Practice and Senior Consultant (consolidated ) positions are open at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Jammu.
IIM Jammu Recruitment Overview
Organisation: Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Jammu
Department(s): Business Communication; Business Policy & Strategy & Entrepreneurship; Economics & Business Environment; Finance and Accounting; Indian Knowledge System; IT Systems & Analytics; Marketing Management; OB/HRM; Operations and Supply Chain
Posts: Professor; Associate Professor; Professor of Practice; Associate Professor of Practice; Senior Consultants
Pay: Professor - 2,20,200 (Level 14A); Associate Professor - 2,11,300 (Level 13A2); Senior Consultants consolidated
Contract Term: Regular posts: 2 years probation. Contractual offer: one/two years. Professor/Associate Professor of Practice and Senior Consultants: initially one/two years
The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.
About the Institute
Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Jammu is an Institute of National Importance established by the Government of India, Ministry of Education in 2016 at Jammu. The Institute says it is looking for dedicated and committed faculty members who believe in institution building and have passion for excellence.
Candidates should have a demonstrated ability to make a relevant intellectual contribution to experienced and potential managers through teaching, training, research and published work. They should also have a strong academic background and understanding of current developments in the related field.
Areas of Faculty Positions
Business Communication - Specialisations: Brain and Language: Mind, Machine and Communication; Corporate Communication: Strategies and Execution; Data Storytelling for Business; Digital Culture; English for Specific Purposes (ESP); English Language Teaching (ELT)
Business Policy & Strategy & Entrepreneurship - Specialisations: Business Strategy; Business Law; Corporate Governance: An International Perspective; Competitive Strategy; Corporate Entrepreneurship; Creativity and Innovation; Entrepreneurship and New Venture Planning; Healthcare Strategy; Indian Polity; International Business Management; Mergers & Acquisitions; Strategic data Management; Strategic Innovation & Design Thinking
Economics & Business Environment - Specialisations: Applied Econometrics; Behavioral Economics and Finance; Business Development and Policy; Business Sustainability; Development Economics; Economics of Banking: Application in R; Financial Time Series Analysis; Game Theory for Managers; Global Trade and Finance
Finance and Accounting - Specialisations: Alternative Investment Markets; Business Valuation; Behavioral Finance; Commercial Bank Management and Taxation; Computational Finance; Corporate Financial Modelling; Financial Accounting / Derivatives; Financial Management / Markets; Financial Risk Management; Forensic Accounting and Fraud Detection; Infrastructure Project Finance; Investment Analysis and Portfolio Management; Management Control Systems; Wealth Management
Indian Knowledge System - Specialisations: Ancient History; Art and Culture; Happiness and Mental Wellness; Health Wellness and Psychology; Sociology and Anthropology; Yoga and Jeevan Darshan
IT Systems & Analytics - Specialisations: Advanced Data Science and AI; AI for Business Leaders; Big Data, Cloud and IOT Analytics; Blockchain Strategy; Cyber Security; Data modelling using IT tools; Digital Governance and Policy; Digital Innovations / Transformation; Fintech; Green IT Strategies; Industry 5.0; Quantum Computing
Marketing Management - Specialisations: Advance Marketing Research; AI in Marketing; B2B Marketing; Branding and Advertising; Consumer Behavior; Digital Marketing; Emerging Trends in Marketing; International Marketing; Marketing Analytics; Product and Brand Management; Sales & Distribution Management; Service Marketing; Sustainability Marketing
OB/HRM - Specialisations: Emerging Trends in Human Resource; Industrial Relations and Labour Law; Performance Management Systems; Talent Acquisition; Industrial Psychology; Conflict Management & Negotiation; Learning and Development; Data Enable HR Strategies (HR Analytics); Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
Operations and Supply Chain - Specialisations: Business Mathematics / Research Methods; Operations Strategy; Supply Chain Management / Analytics; Project Management; Advance Statistics; Lean Enterprises; Decision Sciences; Total Quality Management; Warehouse and Logistics; Advanced Operations Research
Qualification and Experience
For academic positions, the qualification, experience and other requirements are governed by the Ministry of Education guidelines. The age limit for Professor, Associate Professor, Professor of Practice and Associate Professor of Practice is not specified in the notice.
Professor
Experience: the 4 years at Associate Professor level should be in IITs, IIMs, IISc Bangalore, NITIE Mumbai and IISERs, or at an equivalent level in any such other Indian or foreign institution/institutions of comparable standards.
The candidate should have high research, training and consulting credentials.
Marks: first-class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's and Graduation Degrees, and in Class XII or Class X.
Relaxation: 5% for SC/ST/DAP and 3% for OBC in X, XII, Bachelor's and Master's degree.
Publications: minimum two papers in A*/A** category journals, or four research papers in "A - Category Journals", or eight in "B - Category Journals" in the relevant area of specialisation.
Preference for FPM/Ph.D. guidance.

Job Introduction:
Job Title: Security Supervisor
Location: Pune, Maharashtra
Job Type: Full-time (Rotational Shifts)
Experience Level: 1 year of experience in corporate, industrial, or residential security
Job Purpose
The Security Supervisor will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment across the premises. This role focuses on executing daily security protocols, monitoring surveillance systems, and handling gate management. It is an individual contributor role with no direct team leadership responsibilities, reporting directly to the Security Manager/Head.
Key Responsibilities
Access Gate Control: Manage entry and exit points for employees, visitors, vendors, and vehicles. Ensure thorough checking and logging of all materials and assets entering or leaving the premises.
Surveillance Monitoring: Actively monitor CCTV cameras, fire alarm panels, and biometric access control systems to detect any unauthorized activity or safety hazards.
Patrolling: Conduct regular physical rounds of the assigned facility (buildings, parking areas, and perimeters) to ensure doors are locked, hazards are cleared, and the area is secure.
Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate physical and digital logs (Visitor Registers, Material Inward/Outward, Shift Handover logs). Report any unusual incidents or maintenance issues immediately to the management.
Emergency Support: Assist senior management during emergencies (fire drills, medical situations, or breaches) by following established evacuation and safety protocols.
Requirements Qualifications
Education: Minimum 10th or 12th pass (Higher Secondary).
Experience: Exactly 1 year of experience working as a security guard, gate keeper, or security assistant in a structured corporate or industrial environment.
Language Skills: Ability to speak and understand Marathi and Hindi to communicate with local staff. Basic reading and writing skills in English are required for register entry and system logging.
Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of operating computers or smartphone-based visitor management apps (e.g., MyGate, GatePass). Knowledge of operating basic CCTV monitors is a plus.
Physical Fitness: Excellent physical health and stamina, as the role requires standing for long periods and active patrolling.
Key Competencies
Highly alert, observant, and detail-oriented.
Punctual, disciplined, and able to follow strict rules and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Polite yet firm communication skills for handling visitors and staff at the gates.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases

Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation end to end process.

Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Baramula
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
HR Executive/Asst. Manager/HR Manager

Job Description
Position: HR Assistant Manager / HR Manager


Role Objective
To manage end-to-end HR operations at the plant/HO level, ensuring smooth manpower planning, statutory compliance, employee engagement, and alignment of HR practices with Manufacturing industry standards.

Key Responsibilities
1. HR Operations & Administration
Oversee employee onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, and exits.
Maintain employee records, HRMIS, attendance, leave, and shift rosters.
Handle HR documentation, policies, and SOP implementation.
2. Payroll & Compensation
Coordinate payroll processing with accounts/third-party vendors.
Ensure timely salary disbursement, overtime calculation, incentives, and deductions.
Handle PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, and wage revisions.
3. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws
Ensure compliance with Factory Act, CLRA, Shops & Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages, Bonus Act, etc.
Handle inspections, audits, and liaison with labour authorities.
Manage contractor labour compliance and documentation.
4. Industrial Relations (IR)
Maintain cordial employee relations at plant level.
Handle grievances, disciplinary actions, domestic enquiries, and counseling.
Support union/worker interactions (if applicable).
5. Training & Development
Identify training needs for shop-floor and staff employees.
Coordinate skill development, safety training, hygiene & GMP training (Food Industry specific).
Support performance appraisal and competency development initiatives.
6. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive employee engagement activities, celebrations, and welfare programs.
Monitor absenteeism, attrition, and productivity indicators.
Support CSR and statutory welfare initiatives.
7. Health, Safety & Food Compliance Support
Support EHS, food safety, hygiene, and statutory health check programs.
Ensure HR alignment with FSSAI, GMP, and audit requirements.
Educational Qualification
MBA / MSW / PGDM in HR / Personnel Management.
Certification in Labour Laws or Industrial Relations is an added advantage.
Experience
Asst. Manager HR: 5-8 years
HR Manager: 8-15 years
Mandatory experience in Any Manufacturing Industry.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of labour laws & factory HR
Payroll & compliance management
Industrial relations handling
Good communication & negotiation skills
Exposure to food industry audits & hygiene practices
HRMIS / Excel proficiency

Description:
Location Head Jammu
Function: Operations head & Location Management
Location: Jammu
Reporting to: MFG Head
Key Interfaces: Internal Business Stakeholders at Jammu, Functional Heads at Jammu, PPC, Purchase and other corporate functions at Noida.
1. Role Purpose
The Location Head will be responsible for driving the overall business performance, operational excellence, safety and growth of the Jammu manufacturing location.
The business has an ambitious growth objective of increasing turnover from approximately 300 crore to 600 crore over the next three years. The Location Head will play a pivotal role in translating this ambition into actionable business plans and ensuring effective execution through coordination and collaboration across all functions.
The role requires strong business orientation, stakeholder management, execution capabilities and the ability to bring different functional teams together towards common organisational objectives.
The Location Head will be the single-point accountable leader for overall location performance.
A. Business Performance & Growth
Drive the overall business performance of the Jammu location, with accountability for achieving the three-year growth target of 600 crore.
Work closely with key internal customers and business stakeholders at Jammu to understand their business requirements, growth plans, product needs and operational challenges.
B. Manufacturing Capacity & Operational Excellence
Ensure that the Jammu location is geared up to support the planned increase in business volumes.
Drive capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and optimum utilisation of available manufacturing infrastructure.
C. Safety, Compliance & Site Management
Ensure that the Jammu premises remain a safe and secure workplace for all employees, contractors and visitors.
Establish a strong safety culture with visible leadership involvement and accountability at every level.
D. Coordination with Noida PPC, Purchase & Corporate Functions
Establish strong coordination with the PPC team at Noida to ensure effective production planning, material availability and timely fulfilment of business requirements.
Work closely with the Purchase team at Noida to ensure timely procurement of raw materials, consumables, spares and other critical requirements.
F. Infrastructure, Projects & Future Readiness
Identify infrastructure and capacity requirements to support the business doubling plan.
Coordinate with Engineering, Projects, Purchase and corporate management for timely execution of capacity expansion and capital expenditure projects.
CompanyAddress: A-108, Sector-4, NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh, India
