Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
A Gold Loan Appraiser (or Valuation Officer) is a specialized role responsible for verifying the purity, weight, and value of gold jewelry pledged as collateral, primarily in NBFCs and banks. Key duties include testing gold purity using acid tests or electronic meters to ensure it meets lending norms.
Key Aspects of the Role & Training:
Job Responsibilities: Appraisers test gold to determine its authenticity and market value , which directly informs the loan-to-value (LTV) ratio (often around 75%-90%). They are critical in preventing fraud and ensuring proper documentation.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

AboutCompany:
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

JOB ROLE: Engineer/Senior Product Development
REPORTING TO : Team Lead – Product Development
LOCATION Mumbai / Delhi/ Baddi

JOB PURPOSE
Assist in execution technical development parts and products of assigned project by closely collaborating with supply partners/plants.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Components development*
Assist in development of components and subassemblies as per Milestone process meeting specifications and quality requirements (Except Mold and Press Tools).
Follow through with engineering designs for closure of actions identified through DFM
Identify areas of improvement in parts developed from inspection reports by QA and share observations to engineering design teams • Assist in process flow finalization for new products to ensured consistent product quality, Review Process documents deployment at manufacturing locations
Assist in identifying and executing actions to meet intended fit and finish of parts and assemblies

Prototype Development*
Assist seniors' teams in engaging in tasks related to development of rapid prototypes or conventional prototypes. • Help teams to identify right prototyping process for quicker turnaround time.
Follow through with prototype agencies to get the prototype developed within time. • Inspect the proto and report observations

Participate in NPD (New Product Development) process*
Participate in NPD process from concept to product realization by helping teams with various inputs and executing tasks relevant to product development
Assist in creating documents and updating them for identified actions and actions closure during development process
Interact with suppliers and help them understand design intent and important CTQs to be ensured.
Assist development engineers in closure of actions identified with manufacturing plant and supply partners and provide technical support for successful project industrialization.
Engage with manufacturing plants for readiness of of Jigs & Fixtures, SPM required for new concept products/processes, participate in commissioning, and provide inputs to ED team for cost elements/ Also identify opportunities for design changes.
Participate in N10, participate in N100 & mass production for new concept projects. Help development teams in closing required actions.
Assist teams in process documents creation and communication to Manufacturing engineer at manufacturing locations

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS : BE / B.Tech Mechanical Preferred

WORK EXPERIENCE 8+ Years

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES :

Think Beyond
Put Customers first
Collaborate to Win
Develop Talent
Be the Best
Be Agile

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Networking with internal and external stake holders

SAI Junior Engineer at a Glance
Organisation: Sports Authority of India (SAI), Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
File No.: 01-04001(02)/2/2026-66
Post Name: Junior Engineer (retired persons only)
Vacancies: 01
Tenure: 01 year or till the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier
Pay: Last Pay Drawn Minus Pension (Pay Matrix Level 06, 7th CPC) plus Transport Allowance of
Age Limit: Not exceeding 64 years as on the opening date for receipt of applications
Application Mode: Online only
The official notification does not specify the application fee.
Who Can Apply
The notice invites applications for the engagement of services of retired persons, and only from Indian citizens who meet the essential educational qualification and the essential work experience given in Table-I of the notice.
Service Eligibility
Applicants must be officers who worked under the Central Government, State Government or Union Territory Administrations and who:
were holding the post of Junior Engineer or equivalent in their parent cadre/department; OR
were holding at least 5 years of regular service in Level-5 in an engineering cadre (PHONE_NUMBER0) (PB-1, PHONE_NUMBER0 + GP 2800/-).
Essential Qualification
Diploma in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR
Diploma in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR
Degree in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE; OR
Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE.
Desired Qualification
Masters' Degree in Civil Engineering from recognized University/Institute/AICTE; OR
Masters' Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE.
Desired Experience
Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of maintenance and constructions of civil infrastructure, preferably sports infrastructure works; OR
Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of electrical works, preferably with electrical works in sports infrastructure.
Age Limit
The age must be not exceeding 64 years as on the opening date for receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.
Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Junior Engineer post.
Pay and Tenure
a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. The pension deducted is the pension fixed at retirement; if the employee has commuted part of the pension, the commuted portion is also deducted.
The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract. No annual increment, percentage increase or Dearness Allowance is allowed during the contract.
Transport Allowance: during the contract, unchanged during the term of appointment.
No TA/DA for joining the assignment or on its completion. No DA, accommodation, residential phone, personal staff, medical reimbursement, HRA, LTC or similar facilities are admissible.
On official tour away from the place of posting, TA/DA is admissible under the rules for officers of equivalent level in SAI (Pay Grade Level 06).
Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source, and SAI will issue TDS/Service Tax Certificates as applicable.
Leave: 1.5 days per month on a pro-rata basis in a calendar year; no remuneration for absence beyond 18 days in a year; unused leave lapses and is not carried forward.
Tenure: 01 year or till the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, based on the performance review/requirement of SAI. The engagement is purely on contract and gives no right to claim regular employment in SAI or as a government employee.
SAI Junior Engineer Job Description
Supervise, monitor and coordinate civil and electrical works related to construction, renovation, maintenance and upgradation of sports infrastructure and allied facilities.
Prepare and scrutinize estimates, technical specifications, drawings and tender documents.
Inspect works for quality control and compliance with prescribed standards.
Verify measurements and bills.
Coordinate with contractors, consultants and executing agencies.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of works.
Perform any other duties related to civil and electrical engineering works assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

Description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Associate Agency Development Manager to join our team at Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in agency development and management, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement effective agency development strategies to drive business growth.
Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, brokers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to agents to enhance their sales skills.
Identify new business opportunities and develop plans to capitalize on them.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to stay ahead of the competition.


Job Requirements
Minimum 2 years of experience in agency development or a related field.
Strong knowledge of the insurance industry and its regulations.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with financial products and services is an added advantage.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by managing a team of sales executives, building strong relationships with clients, and ensuring exceptional customer service. Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of sales executives to achieve sales objectives and targets.
- Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the customer base.
- Cultivate and maintain relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Conduct training and mentoring sessions for team members to enhance their sales skills and product knowledge.
- Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth.
- Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance for upper management.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistency in service delivery.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Sales-oriented mindset with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services.
- Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
- Relevant certifications in insurance sales would be an added advantage.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, innovation, and professional growth.

Role & responsibilities

About Branch Banking:
The branches act as the face of Axis Bank for millions of retail customers and is, hence, an integral part of the Banks strategy. Branches play a major role in deposit mobilization from New-To-Bank (NTB) customers, and are also core drivers of the Banks customer engagement strategy across products and services.
About the Role:
As a part of the branch banking team, Branch Relationship Officers (BROs) are responsible for providing financial solutions to customer by offering bank’s products, providing service to existing and New To bank customers in the branch and adding new customers through referral generation activities and customer visits.
They will be required to use their communication skills to add new customers and Cross Sell of Bank products.
As part of daily cadence, BROs are required to engage with existing customers of Bank which are mapped to their portfolio for offering additional products of the bank as per the need of the customer.
BROs are expected to process customer transactions and Service requests within defined turnaround time (TAT) and ensure end to end closure.
BROs may also be posted as teller as per organization’s requirements for processing cash transactions of customers.
BROs shall introduce customers to alternate channels of banking such as Internet Banking, mobile banking, Whatsapp banking wherever possible
Key Skills:
Customer Service Skills – Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with customers
Regulatory Knowledge – Familiarity with KYC (Know Your Customer), AML (Anti-Money Laundering), and other compliance requirements
Sales and negotiation - Ability to sell financial products and services
Attention to detail – High level of accuracy in handling cash transactions and financial documents
Key Responsibilities:
Offering solutions and Cross selling Bank’s retail banking and third party products as per assigned budgets. (Eg. Life insurance, General insurance, Mutual Funds, Loans etc.)
Achieve Business budgets as assigned by the organization on a monthly basis consistently.
Generating referrals and leads of new customers for sale of bank’s products.
Promoting bank’s products by taking part in marketing activities and customer visits outside the branch.
Contact existing customers for bringing in more deposits and cross selling of bank’s products.
Timely and accurate processing of customer transactions and requests.
Handle customer queries and provide correct solutions to ensure there are no customer complaints.
Follow all compliance guidelines (regulatory and legislative) for each activity released from time to time.
Ensure that all audit requirements of the bank are met optimum audit rating.
Complete all mandatory certifications required for the role (EUIN, SP Certification etc.)
Complete all learning activities/ trainings conducted by the bank from time to time.
Daily entry of interaction with customers in bank’s CRM system.
Participate and follow all initiatives/ Campaigns/ Drives that are undertaken by the bank from time to time
Qualifications:
Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
Graduation/ Post-Graduation from a recognized institute

Role Proficiencies:
For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
Knowledge of banking regulations and norms
Maintain a high level of knowledge of banking products and services
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.

Skill Set: Retail Point of Sale (PoS), .NET Full Stack

Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Point of Sale (PoS) System professionals with strong expertise in Retail PoS applications and .NET Full Stack development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise-scale retail PoS solutions, ensuring seamless integration with retail, inventory, payment, and backend systems.

Strong experience in Retail Point of Sale (PoS) systems.
Expertise in .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, C#, Web API.
Experience in Frontend technologies such as Angular, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS.
Good understanding of retail operations, billing, promotions, pricing, inventory, and store management.
Experience integrating payment gateways, card processing systems, and third-party retail applications.
Knowledge of SQL Server, database design, and performance optimization.
Experience with Azure/AWS cloud platforms is preferred.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
Hands-on experience in troubleshooting and production support environments.

Develop and maintain PoS applications for retail businesses.
Design scalable and secure full-stack solutions.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to gather requirements.
Integrate PoS applications with inventory, CRM, ERP, and payment systems.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards.
Support deployment, testing, and production issue resolution.

Description:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle,
collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural
mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to
architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI,
distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional
methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive
briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in
education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical
success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful
adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential
enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual
solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective
enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation
to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed
Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with
client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and
operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI
mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions
remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated
architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech,
publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business
challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to
agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and
safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure
requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable
deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational
costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements
(SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM,
ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure
optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision
records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing,
capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to
demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's
unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype
reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees,
and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based
responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with
technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business
stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.

Description:
Job Description: Senior Oracle DBA / Exadata & Multi-Cloud DBA

Experience
815+ years of Oracle Database Administration experience, with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise, high-availability, mission-critical database environments.
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) with deep expertise in Oracle Exadata, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, GoldenGate, Performance Tuning, Backup & Recovery, Patching and Database Cloning.
The candidate should also have hands-on experience managing Oracle database workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, performance optimization skills, high-availability and disaster-recovery expertise, automation mindset, and experience supporting large-scale production database environments.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Database Administration
Install, configure, upgrade, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle Database 11g/12c/18c/19c/23ai environments.
Manage both single-instance and RAC databases across production and non-production environments.
Perform database provisioning, refreshes, migrations, upgrades, and cloning.
Manage tablespaces, datafiles, redo logs, archive logs, control files, undo, temporary tablespaces, and database storage.
Perform proactive database health checks, capacity planning, and availability monitoring.
Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Oracle Exadata
Strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Oracle Exadata Database Machine.
Experience supporting Exadata database nodes, storage cells, ASM, RAC, and high-availability configurations.
Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, cell metrics and Exadata-specific statistics.
Understand Exadata technologies including:
Smart Scan
Storage Indexes
Smart Flash Cache
I/O Resource Management
Cell Offload Processing
Hybrid Columnar Compression
Experience with Exadata patching and maintenance activities.
Oracle RAC & Clusterware
Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle RAC and Grid Infrastructure.
Troubleshoot RAC node eviction, CRS failures, interconnect issues, voting disk/OCR issues, and cluster resource failures.
Manage services, listeners, SCAN listeners, VIPs, and RAC database services.
Perform RAC rolling maintenance and patching with minimum business disruption.
ASM & Storage
Install, configure, and administer Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
Manage ASM disk groups, failure groups, rebalance operations, disk additions/removals, and storage capacity.
Troubleshoot ASM, multipathing, storage latency, and database I/O issues.
RMAN, Backup & Recovery
Design, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot RMAN backup and recovery strategies.
Strong experience with:
Full and incremental backups
Archive log backups
Control file and SPFILE recovery
Database restore and recovery
Point-in-Time Recovery
Tablespace recovery
Block Media Recovery
Disaster recovery scenarios
Perform regular recovery validation and ensure compliance with defined RPO/RTO requirements.
Oracle Data Guard
Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle Data Guard / Active Data Guard.
Manage physical standby databases and Data Guard Broker.
Perform and troubleshoot switchover and failover operations.
Monitor redo transport and apply lag.
Troubleshoot archive gaps, redo transport failures, standby synchronization, and recovery issues.
Experience with disaster recovery testing and DR drills.
Oracle GoldenGate
Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle GoldenGate replication.
Configure and manage:
Extract
Data Pump
Replicat
Integrated Extract
Integrated Replicat
Trail files
Checkpoints
Troubleshoot replication lag, abends, missing transactions, mapping issues, and data inconsistencies.
Experience with zero/minimal-downtime database migrations using GoldenGate is highly desirable.
Performance Tuning
Strong expertise in Oracle database and SQL performance tuning.
Analyze AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, wait events and system statistics.
Troubleshoot:
High CPU utilization
I/O bottlenecks
Memory pressure
Blocking/locking
RAC contention
SQL performance degradation
Database hangs
Connection storms
Tune SQL statements, optimizer statistics, indexing strategies, SGA/PGA parameters, and database configuration.
Patching & Upgrades
Perform Oracle Database and Grid Infrastructure patching.
Experience with RU/RUR/one-off patches and OPatch/OPatchAuto.
Perform pre-patch validation, rollback planning, post-patch validation, and troubleshooting.
Experience performing Oracle database upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Database Cloning & Refresh
Perform database cloning and environment refresh using:
RMAN Duplicate
Backup-based cloning
Active Duplicate
Data Pump
Snapshot/Storage-based techniques
Experience with large production-to-non-production database refreshes.
Implement appropriate security and masking processes where production data is copied to lower environments.
Cloud DBA Experience
AWS
Hands-on experience managing Oracle databases on Amazon Web Services (AWS), preferably:
Amazon RDS for Oracle
Oracle on EC2
EBS storage
S3
AWS Backup
CloudWatch
IAM
Multi-AZ/DR architecture
Database migration using AWS DMS
Ability to troubleshoot database performance, storage, connectivity, backup, recovery, and availability issues in AWS environments.
Microsoft Azure
Experience managing Oracle database workloads hosted on Microsoft Azure, including:
Oracle databases on Azure Virtual Machines
Azure Storage
Managed Disks

1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Job Summary

3 to 5 years of experience in technical sales, service engineering, or customer support.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Opportunity to work with a leading pharmaceutical equipment manufacturer.
Exposure to reputed pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies.
Career growth in sales and technical service functions.
Competitive compensation and benefits.

Key Responsibilities
Image Interpretation & Reporting: Analyze X-rays, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and nuclear/PET scans to detect abnormalities and prepare clear diagnostic reports.
Clinical Consultation: Advise referring physicians and specialists on choosing the right imaging study, correlating results with patient history, and managing critical or urgent findings.
Image-Guided & Interventional Procedures: Perform or assist with minimally invasive procedures (such as biopsies, drainages, or vascular interventions) and evaluate contrast safety or patient risks.
Supervision, Safety & Quality: Guide radiologic technologists, enforce radiation safety and infection control protocols, and maintain image quality standards.
Teaching & Administration (Setting-Dependent): Train residents/technologists, participate in clinical audits or research, or support remote teleradiology reporting.

Qualifications & Core Skills
Education & Licensure: Medical degree (such as MBBS) plus postgraduate MD in Radiology (3 years in India) and active medical registration/licensure; optional 12 year sub-specialty fellowships are common.
Technical & Analytical Skills: Strong cross-sectional and anatomical knowledge, visual pattern recognition, attention to detail, and familiarity with PACS/imaging workflows.
Workplace & Soft Skills: Clear communication with clinicians and patients, sound clinical judgment, and adaptability in hospitals, diagnostic centers, or teleradiology settings.

Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Job Title Prahri Manager- Defence

A. Position Summary:

Achieving business results in the Defence Retail business through worksite sales process through effective distribution of Insurance products in the target affinity. Responsible for Agent/ Officer Prahri recruitment, Agent/Officer Prahri development and meeting the business targets month on month according to the plan.

B. Key Responsibilities:
Agent/Officer Prahri Recruitment:
Conduct and execute recruitment drives from various sources in the defence segment for agent/Officer Prahri hiring & build a team of agent/Officer Prahri.
Maintain a pipeline of agent/Officer Prahri to execute at least 1 recruitment per quarter of each profile of distributor.
Implement DPLI work processes and adhere to the business norms
Agent/ Officer Prahri Development:
Ensure product knowledge by Companys ways of training
Joint field calls (JFC) and post presentation follow up process in Units/Battalions.
Develop agents/Officer Prahri on Prahri Commando Course platform
Development of agent/Officer Prahri prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits
Work with agent/Officer Prahri on planning and reviewing of activities and goals
Identify the training needs of the agent/Officer Prahri and work with Trainers to improve the same
Business Deliverables and Responsibilities:
Achievement of monthly, quarterly & yearly Goal sheet targets
Build an influencer network in conjunction with agent/Officer Prahri to approach Units/Battalions for Sales Seminar presentations.
Fix Sales seminar presentations in Units/Battalions through influencer network and Office Head support,
Ensure effective follow up process in Units/Battalions post sales seminar presentation.
Maintain a database of customers touched through sales seminar presentations
Ensuring business is done in an ethical and honest manner which is in compliance to the IRDA norms
Maintain agent/Officer Prahri productivity as per business plan
C. Job Specifications:

1. Qualifications
- Graduate/ Post Graduate or Equivalent for Defence ex-servicemen
2. Experience:
2.1 Minimum 1-6 years of work experience in Sales Development role
2.2 Experience in the life insurance industry/ any other industry in sales role is necessary.
2.3 Affiliation with the Armed Forces would be highly preferred.

3. Preference of Industry Background:-
3.1 Preference 1: Insurance/Financial exp + defence Sales experience
3.2 Preference 2: Ins/Fin services +def family + Defence background
3.3 Preference 3: Insurance Sales +history of adaptability to new business avenues.
3.4 Preference 4: Pure defence family background (current serving personnel)
3.5 Preference 5: Defence ex-servicemen

D. Key Core/ Behavioral Competencies
1. Broad understanding of the target segment( Defence)
2. Customer prospecting ability.
3. Communication and negotiation skills

Description:
Job descriptionfor Food and Beverage On Job Trainee - Steward
A Food and Beverage On Job Trainee -Steward is responsible to assist the senior steward inensuring that the kitchen and dining areas are clean and well-organized, servingfood and beverages to guests, and guests' needs and requests are met promptlyand efficiently. On job trainee is responsible for ensuring that all necessarycutlery, crockery, and glassware are available to the guests. It is alsoexpected to learn and follow all health and safety guidelines, includingmaintaining personal hygiene, ensuring food is stored properly, and maintaininga clean and sanitary work environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Welcome the guests by greeting them asper the standards. Respond to customer queries by resolving issues in a timelyand efficient manner to ensure customer satisfaction.
Serving food and drinks: assist in servingfood and drinks to guests. This includes taking orders, delivering food totables, and ensuring that guests have everything they need.
Learning the facilities of the hotel /casino and the daily events and functions in order to satisfy guest enquiries.
Handling guest requests andcomplaints: handle guest requests and complaints. This includes addressing anyissues they may have and providing them with a satisfactory solution.
Learning and following safety andhygiene procedures: required to learn and follow safety and hygiene proceduresto ensure that the kitchen and dining areas are safe and sanitary for guestsand staff.
Learning and following companypolicies: learn and follow the company policies and procedures, including thoserelated to dress code, attendance, and customer service standards.
Attend training sessions to learn new skills and improve existing ones.
Qualifications:
Min HSSC pass, diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in food service or hospitality may be preferred.
Strong knowledge of food service operations, including hygiene and sanitation practices.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem solving skill with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Throughout training period, on job trainee will be supervised byexperienced stewards or captains, who will guide in performing dutieseffectively and efficiently. Hence performance will be evaluated regularly, andwill be provided with feedback and support to help to improve skills andknowledge. Overall, the role of an on-the-job trainee steward in the food andbeverage service department is an important one that requires attention todetail, excellent customer service skills, and a strong commitment to teamworkand collaboration.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Description:
Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.

Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.

Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.
Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.
Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.
Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.
Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.
Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.
Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.
Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.
Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.
Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.
Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.
Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.

Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
