Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.

Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.

Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.

Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Description:
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.
You must be adept at creating reports of your teams performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
Requirements:
So, what are we looking for?
We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 + teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.
If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that’s a plus in your favor. If you’re familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

KDN India_Consultant/Assistant Manager_Financial Modelling
As a member of KDN, youll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. And through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.

Role & responsibilities

Support the specification / design of models and analysis tools.
Develop models (incl. integrated P&L, Cash flow and Balance sheet models) from scratch.
Amend models developed by KPMG staff or by third parties.
Carry out financial analysis of the outputs of models.
Ensure the consistency in client models and create / maintain project documentation and data books.

Review models and feedback findings to clients using KPMG proprietary software.
Review and comment on revised models received from clients to verify whether review comments have been acted upon.
Document the operation of models and the findings from our work.
Document issues in a business model for inclusion in review reports and liaise with the project manager to fully explain the points raised.
Design and execute commercial analysis e.g. market sizing, market driver analysis, competitive benchmarking etc.
Develop business cases and business plans underpinned by robust financial analysis in support of strategic initiatives.

Preferred candidate profile
3-6 years working experience of Financial Analysis, Business Modelling or Financial Modelling;
A good working knowledge of accounting, financial statements, and financial analysis;
Strong analytical and problem solving skills;
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel;
A commercial outlook and a good understanding of the general business and economic environment;
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to build effective networks internally and externally

Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.

Your role
Key Responsibilities
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

Essential

Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.

Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.
The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Prepare Protection Control (PC) deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS/GIS substations
Develop SLDs, KLDs, AC/DC schematics, LVAC/LVDC diagrams, tripping schemes, relay wiring diagrams, panel layouts and cable schedules.
Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.
Develop Control Protection Bay Control Drawings, Relay Panel Drawings, DC Distribution Schemes, AC Auxiliary Schemes, RTU/SCADA Drawings, SCS Drawings, LAN/Fiber Network Drawings, Cable Routing Termination Drawings, As-Built Documentation.
Develop and maintain engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.
Perform self-checks and quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of engineering documentation.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking an experienced Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with:
Proven experience in 132kV to 400kV AIS/GIS Substation Protection Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.
About you
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in AutoCAD Raster Design
Excellent drafting and detailing skills.
Strong understanding of substation protection and control systems.
Strong understanding of CAD/PC standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check PC Interface drawings.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD standards, project procedures, and drawing control requirements
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience in 132 kV, 220 kV, and 400 kV AIS/GIS substation Protection Control design projects.
Experience in greenfield and brownfield substation projects.
Proficiency in AutoCAD; exposure to Raster Design, MicroStation, Revit, or other electrical CAD tools is advantageous.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance.
Ability to work independently and mentor junior designers.
Proactive, accountable, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Collaborative team player with leadership potential.
Responsive to client requirements and project deadlines.
Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
Ability to manage, motivate, and support design teams effectively.

Job Description
Overview
The Technical Manager role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and leading and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.
Your Role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes.
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures.
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow.
Should have strong written verbal communication in English.
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACCApply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS)
About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements.
Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models.
Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models.
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantageQualifications and attributes.
Excellent time management skills.15 to 20 years of relevant experienceExperience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

Job Description


Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Transporation Business is looking to appoint a number of Technical Manager s to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Transporation business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.This key post will be based out of Bangalore/ Gurgaon where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.


Your Role
Responsibilities
Leading the team and Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables.
Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis


About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 10 to 15 years.AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and Attributes
Excellent time management skills.Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivationAbility to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customersHighly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Senior Analyst (5-8 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills

Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.


Additional Info

The selected candidate will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects involving cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the growth and innovation of the company.

AWS Full Stack Developer Manager (Job Description)
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced AWS Full Stack Developer to lead full-stack application development on AWS, driving architecture decisions, CI/CD automation, and team delivery across frontend and backend workloads.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in full-stack application development on AWS, with proven ability to lead development teams, drive architectural decisions across frontend (React/Angular with Amplify) and backend (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB/RDS) layers, and establish CI/CD standards.
Key Responsibilities
Lead full-stack application development using React/Angular (with Amplify and Next.js/Nuxt), Java/Python/Node.js, and AWS serverless services.
Architect end-to-end solutions including frontend (CloudFront CDN distribution), backend (Lambda, Lambda MicroVMs, Lambda Managed Instances), API (API Gateway, AppSync for GraphQL), and database layers (DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache).
Design scalable REST and GraphQL API architectures using API Gateway and AppSync with advanced patterns (caching, WebSocket, request/response transformations).
Lead database design and optimization for DynamoDB (single-table design, GSI/LSI) and RDS/Aurora workloads.
Establish CI/CD pipeline standards using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and Amplify Hosting with managed CI/CD.
Implement AWS security best practices including Cognito, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, and Shield.
Develop IaC using Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
Lead and mentor development teams on modern frameworks, TypeScript full-stack patterns, and AWS best practices.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, QA, and business teams for delivery excellence.
Use CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch Logs Insights for observability and performance optimization.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience in software engineering.
5+ years of hands-on AWS experience.
Deep proficiency in frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) and backend technologies (Java, Python, Node.js/TypeScript).
Extensive experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs with API Gateway, AppSync, and serverless patterns.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda (Functions, MicroVMs), S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, IAM.
Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines at scale using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and Amplify.
Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, Fargate).
Strong understanding of application security (Cognito, IAM, KMS, WAF) and cloud governance.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
Prior experience with microservices architecture and event-driven design.
Nice to Have
AWS Professional or Associate certifications.
Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, Amazon Q Developer) and brought in efficiencies.
DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience with AWS migration tools (DMS, SCT, Migration Hub, AWS Transform).
Experience with GraphQL at scale using AppSync.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Manager, Credit Strategy & Solutioning
Location: Gurgaon / Bangalore / Mumbai
Experience: 5+ years
Job Summary
We are looking for an analytically sharp, driven individual to join our Credit team and take on some of the highest-impact problems in our embedded finance business. This role sits at the intersection of credit, strategy, and product - requiring someone who can take open-ended, ambiguous problems, research them from the ground up, and turn them into well-structured, scalable credit solutions. You will work closely with key ecosystem partners to design and grow embedded credit products, and collaborate deeply with business, policy, and product teams to implement these solutions. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role with direct senior leadership exposure, and the work you do will directly shape the trajectory of our most important growth vertical.
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with existing partners to diagnose what is limiting scale, and design the right credit solution - combining partner ecosystem analysis, customer behavior insights, and market research to identify the right product fit and growth levers.
Build templated, scalable credit solutions for specific industry verticals (e-commerce, FMCG, ERP, travel, and others) - defining the right product structure and strategic positioning that can be replicated across partners in each segment.
Drive end-to-end solutioning for new partner launches in close collaboration with business and policy teams, from problem definition and research through to execution.
Work with the payments team to co-design integrated credit and payments journeys for partners.
Query, explore, and analyze portfolio and partner data to extract meaningful insights - know where to go deep and where to do 80:20, and translate findings into clear decisions and actions.
Drive strategic decision-making across our portfolio with key business partners - LSPs & bureaus.
Manage relationships with external vendors, data providers, and business partners (LSPs); evaluate new data partners for incremental value in credit strategies.
Present structured findings and recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Qualifications
5+ years of relevant experience in credit risk, analytics, strategy, or a generalist problem-solving role (such as a founder's office) at a fintech, bank, consulting firm, or any organization with significant exposure to lending.
Proven track record of high-impact work - strong analytical thinking, first-principles problem solving, and a sharp instinct for where value lies in a problem.
Demonstrated ability to work on open-ended, ambiguous problems and bring structure and clarity to them.
Skills
Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills; experience working cross-functionally across business, product, and risk teams.
Expert-level proficiency in Excel and at least one data querying language (SQL or Python).
Working knowledge of credit products, underwriting, bureau data, and risk models.
Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to diverse audiences, including senior leadership.
Graduate degree in business, engineering, statistics, economics, or other analytical field from a Tier 1 institute.

Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Planning, execution and review.

Job Description
Title: Field Sales Executive
Location:  Ranchi
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry: Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.

Backup Power & Control Networks: Maintain absolute readiness of heavy-capacity Diesel Generators (DG sets) and industrial Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) feeding automated PLC/SCADA control networks. Knowledge in HMI and SCADA.

Ensuring Customer engagement initiatives (Complaint Management, Customer visits, etc.). To lead a team of Engineers, Operators, Technicians / Asst. Technicians etc. To ensure implementation of goals and targets for the department/section in line with the ABP.
Person will be responsible to coordinate with both internal & external customers and to meet the demand time to time. Responsible for trouble shooting and analyzing of problems during course of job execution and site management.
Must possess working knowledge on Computers (MS Office). Knowledge of QMS and TQM principles to establish quality standards & control measures and ensure total quality management of the project.

Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

knowledge of English

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

About SUBHAG HealthTech
SUBHAG HealthTech sells fertility-care solutions to gynecologists, hospitals, IUI clinics, IVF centres, and andrology laboratories. Ranchi & Jharkhand are a core market.
About the Role
We are hiring a Sales Executive for Ranchi to meet doctors, present AndroWash and related solutions, run demos, and close business in the city and surrounding region.
Travel is mandatory. You will be in clinics, hospitals, and labs most days not behind a desk. Local and regional travel within Jharkhand is part of the job every week.
What You Will Do
Meet gynecologists, clinic owners, and laboratory professionals in Bengaluru and your assigned territory.
Travel daily/weekly for in-person meetings, demonstrations, and follow-ups.
Explain product, clinical use, pricing, and implementation.
Manage the pipeline in CRM. If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen.
Coordinate with service and clinical teams for installations and training.
Work to targets on qualified meetings, demos, and closed revenue.
What We Are Looking For
Healthcare, medical-device, pharma, or B2B sales experience preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively is mandatory. A valid driving licence is an advantage.
Confidence speaking with doctors and closing in person.
Comfort with targets, follow-up, and CRM discipline.
Who should not apply
Cannot travel for field meetings
Want a purely inside / work-from-home sales job
Do not want a target-driven healthcare sales role

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

1. CSR Strategy & Program Design

Manage direct reporting team and strengthen internal processes for efficient program execution and reporting.

Prepare high-quality internal and external reports, impact assessments, and case studies.
Support leadership communication through presentations, dashboards, and annual CSR disclosures.

Drive adoption of digital tools and MIS platforms for real-time project monitoring and reporting.
Design dashboards for data visualization, decision-making, and impact tracking.
Ensure data integrity, transparency, and usage compliance across stakeholders.
Apply scientific and TQM methodologies to improve program efficiency and outcomes

Preferred candidate profile
5to11 years of experience in CSR / development sector
Strong experience in public health program design and implementation
Prior experience with NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, or government health programs preferred
Demonstrated exposure to program administration and team/partner management

5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point

Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance.




Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; -Implement a sales management process that guides the teams decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partners) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work -Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work:External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.




a)Qualifications :
-Graduation / Post graduation
-Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
-People Relationship Management skills
-Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b)Work Experience:
-Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales
DIMENSIONS

Financial Dimensions

As a manager, you''ll need to define Business scope. Defining what is needed is the first step. setting Business goals and allocating to Team. the Business scope should have a tangible objective for the organization
-In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
-Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
-Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained



Other Dimensions

Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6
Number of Indirect Reports: 23 (off role)
Number of Outsourced employees: 18 (ASCC)
Number of locations: in the range 5 to 7
Number of products: 2

Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the team:
EDC Retail  is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.
About the role: 
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.   
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market. 
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts. 
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE. 
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap. 
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management. 
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team. 
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role 
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset
Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.
Qualification:-
Graduate/Post Graduate.

About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Position description: Generate fresh Business and service existing clients
;
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets for sales regular collection2. Conduct Marketing activities, leafleting , Canopy etc to identify new sources of business3. Handle customer queries, build up customer relationship and develop brand value in the market 4. Attend customer queries and provide resolution 5. Co-ordinate with Operations Collection department for customer onboarding and servicing 6. Conduct physical verification of customer's residence, business and any other asset crucial from credit point of view and taking photographs. 7. Follow instructions frm seniors, coordinate with internal teams for getting visit reports done. 8. Visit customers for first FI and meeting, and also accompany seniors to customer's place for visit and verification. 9. Conduct physical verification of credit related documents like ITR, Bank statement, receipts, ledger and property documents - doing OSV ( Original Seen and verified) of documents. 10. Portfolio Management - visit delinquent cases, collect EMIs of delinquent cases in collaboration with collections team. 14. Maintain and stop early delinquency , Non-starter cases in portfolio, decide the treatment of such cases wisely. 15. Maintain least OTC / PDD pendency and ensure timely clearance of the same. 16. Maintain non-RPDC portfolio - ensure all cases of portfolio are ACH. 17. Maintain and collect fresh bouncing cases EMI with charges as mentioned in policy, 18. Correct the operational errors and get 100% cases repayment in Non-PDC mode. 19. Collect fresh data from open marketing activities for tele calling and self sourcing.20. Follow leads so generated from data received from telemarketing team 21. Complete documentation, file agreements, formats and other formalities for disbursement of cases 22. Clear queries from credit, Ops, Legal, Valuation etc. 23. Timely submit daily MIS and sourcing data to reporting authority

Description:
Job Purpose
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan - Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage
