Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications & Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.

Description:
Advt. Ref. No. NABCONS/CO-HR/25/PBCS/2026-27 Dated: 13 November, 2026
Requires Experienced Junior Technical Supervisors /Engineers (Civil) for Head Office and Regional Offices/Training Establishments for Ground-level Monitoring for Premises related Projects of National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

Location: Itanagar,Pune,Chennai,Dehradun,Mumbai

Primary Duties and Key Responsibilities:
i. Implementation, monitoring, co-ordination and supervision of civil construction/renovation/redevelopment works of building related infrastructural system and other related jobs in office buildings and residential colonies of Bank.
ii. Identification of civil/interior repair/ maintenance works required in the office buildings/residential colonies and preparation of concept, detailed estimates, preparation of tenders/quotation document, preparation of financial estimate/BOQ as per Bank's approved/market rates for these works to receive necessary approval.
iii. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance work of office buildings. NABARD has its office buildings in all state capitals of the country, either owned or rented.
iv. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance works ongoing in staff quarters to ensure the quality standards and timely completion of works. They will have responsibility to undertake regular maintenance, repair and renovation of staff quarters located in various cities of the country, as per Bank's guidelines.
v. Repair and maintenance of Visiting Officers flats (VoFs), Single Room Accommodations (SRAs) located at various premises all over the country, as per Banks guidelines.
vi. Supervision and monitoring of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) works such as housekeeping, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, pest control, gardening, VOF management, deadstock maintenance etc.
vii. Taking measurements of completed works related to construction/ renovation/redevelopment/repair/maintenance and ensuring the proper completion of works.
viii. Certification of bills as per onsite measurement and recommendations for payment by competent authority.
ix. Conducting visual structural audit and implementation of recommendations of detailed audit done by expert, in NABARD official and residential buildings.
x. Regular liaison with engineers and officers of state or municipal bodies for local level approvals regarding maintenance, repair, renovation or property related matters.
xi. Verification of dead stock articles provided in office and colonies to ensure that these are in good working condition. To recommend for repair, replacement etc. in case of non-functional items.xii. Ensuring quality, timely completion and compliance in all the works.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute or University with minimum60% marks
Required Experience:
Minimum 03 years experience of working in residential/ office buildings/ commercial buildings projects (maintenance/construction)
Other skills and competencies:
Good knowledge of MS office, Google tools, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day operations. Experience in Zoho projects or any other project management software shall be preferred. Knowledge of relevant Engineering Software will be preferred.Excellent written & oral communication and presentation skills in English and local languageThe ability to coordinate and prepare technical and financial proposals in response to EOIs and bids will be preferred.
Age: Maximum Age as on date of application: 35 Years
Contract Period
The Junior Technical Supervisors (PBCS) would be hired on contract for a period of 11 months with further periodic extensions based on the performance and NABARD discretion.
Termination
NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason thereof. However, in normal course, NABCONS may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period.
How to Apply
Interested candidates may apply online in the prescribed format within 07 days from 13 November 2026 to 19 November 2026 by clicking links and filling the details therein:
Link to apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/gkPpaeWiCa
Instructions
Before applying, candidates should read all the instructions carefully and ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria for the post. NABCONS would admit candidates on the basis of the information furnished in the ON-LINE application and shall verify their eligibility at the stage of interview/ joining. If, at any stage it is found that any information furnished in the ON-LINE application is false/incorrect or if according to the NABCONS, the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria for the post, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will not be allowed to appear for the interview/joining not allowed to continue, if joined.
Candidates are requested to apply only ON-ONLINE through NABCONS website (www.nabcons.com). No other mode of submission of application will be accepted.
Important Dates/ Timelines
Last date for submission of online applications: 19 November 2026 (Midnight)
NABCONS reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Manage daily site store operations and maintain proper inventory records.

Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
Ensure proper storage, identification and safety of materials.
Maintain records of tools, equipment, consumables and construction materials.
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly stock reports.
Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, vendors and the accounts department.
Ensure proper documentation of material receipts, transfers and returns.

Required Skills

2 to 3 years of experience in site store management, preferably in construction / infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of inventory management and stock maintenance.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and computer operations.
Experience in maintaining GRN, MRN, material inward/outward registers and stock reports.
Good coordination and communication skills.
Ability to independently manage site store operations.

Candidate Requirements

Candidates must be willing to work at project locations across Pan India.
Must be flexible to relocate or travel based on project requirements.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.
Candidates with construction or infrastructure project experience will be given preference.

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. About the team: QR & Soundbox is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team3. Must Be a Graduate4. Growth Mindset
Why join us : We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate.
Compensation:-If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

PROJECT MANAGER - PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl (EPC Project)

Company: Mayasheel Ventures Limited
Location: Aizawl, Mizoram (site-based)
Industry: Construction / EPC - Commercial Retail

About the Project:
Mayasheel Ventures Limited is the EPC contractor for PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl, a commercial mall project being executed for HITES (HLL Infra Tech Services, a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited). The project covers full civil and MEP execution - including electrical, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing, lifts and allied services - delivered under detailed technical specifications, approved-makes and a consultant/client approval regime.

Role and Responsibilities:
- Lead overall site execution of the project: plan, coordinate and monitor civil and MEP works to meet project schedule, quality standards and contract specifications.
- Act as the primary point of contact with the client (HITES) and consultants: obtain approvals on shop drawings, materials/makes, deviations, and technical submissions in line with the contract's approved-makes and specification regime.
- Manage procurement and vendor coordination: float enquiries against BOQ, evaluate vendor quotations, follow up on material deliveries, and ensure ordered items match approved makes and specifications.
- Maintain drawing and BOQ discipline on site: work from the latest approved drawings and BOQs, flag mismatches between drawings, BOQ quantities and site conditions, and escalate variations for client approval before execution.
- Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor running bills and measurements; maintain documentation for billing, approvals and correspondence.
- Manage and mentor the site team (engineers, supervisors, surveyor/billing staff); allocate work, review daily progress and resolve site-level technical issues.
- Track project schedule, prepare progress reports, and coordinate sequencing between civil, electrical, HVAC, firefighting and other services to avoid rework.
- Ensure quality checks and safety practices on site in accordance with contract specifications and statutory requirements.
- Handle site logistics and planning in the Aizawl context, including material movement on hill roads, monsoon-impacted scheduling and remote-site resource planning.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
- B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institute.
- 10+ years of experience in execution of commercial building projects (malls, hotels, hospitals or institutional buildings), with at least 3-5 years in a Project Manager or senior site leadership role on EPC projects.
- Strong working knowledge of both civil and MEP execution: electrical distribution, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing and building services coordination.
- Experience working under client/consultant approval systems - shop drawings, material approvals, approved-makes compliance, deviation approvals and specification-driven execution.
- Good command over BOQs, rate analysis, measurement/billing certification and vendor/sub-contractor management.
- Proficient in reading drawings (civil and services), MS Office/Excel; exposure to project scheduling tools preferred.
- Strong communication and coordination skills for client, consultant, vendor and team management.
- Willingness to be based full-time at the Aizawl site; prior experience of working in remote or difficult-terrain project locations will be an advantage.

Perks and Benefits:
- Accommodation provided by the company.
- Fooding (meals) provided by the company.
- Other benefits as per company policy.
AboutCompany: Mayasheel Ventures Limited is an established engineering and construction company with a presence in the infrastructure sector since 2008. The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

Description:
Title Counsellor - Opioid Substitution Therapy (OST)
Location: YRG MERF Integrated Care Clinic, Aizawl, Mizoram
Organisation: YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)


Job Summary

Key Responsibilities
A. OST counselling (as per NACO OST guidelines) - Pre-induction counselling: assess readiness, explain OST, its benefits and limits, and obtain informed consent for treatment.
Ongoing counselling on adherence, dose-related concerns, craving, relapse prevention and lifestyle change.
Counselling on take-home doses, safe storage and responsible use, where applicable.
Risk-reduction counselling on HIV, hepatitis B and C, STIs and TB; promote safe injecting practices and overdose prevention.
Referral and follow-up for HIV testing (ICTC), ART, hepatitis care, TB (NTEP), mental health and de-addiction services; confirm that referrals are completed.
Family and partner counselling, and support groups for clients and caregivers, with the clients consent.
Use the monthly irregular / pre-LFU list to follow up clients by phone and through the linked IDU Targeted Intervention; document tracking outcomes.
Maintain counselling records and update registers and SOCH/MIS entries on time.
Uphold confidentiality and the rights of clients under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017.
Young people on OST - Offer youth-friendly, non-judgemental counselling suited to young adults who are new to treatment.
Address issues common to this group - family conflict, peer pressure, education and livelihood, relationships, sexual health and mental health.
Work with outreach staff and peer educators to bring in and retain young clients.
Open trial functions - Complete Good Clinical Practice (GCP) / Human Subjects Protection training before taking up any study task.
Explain the study to eligible clients in plain Mizo or English and support the informed consent process as set out in the protocol.
Deliver counselling sessions exactly as specified in the study manual; record each session on the fidelity checklist.
Administer study questionnaires and complete case report forms accurately and on schedule.
Support participant retention - appointment reminders, tracing of missed visits and follow-up as per the protocol.
Report adverse events, protocol deviations and client distress to the Medical Officer and Study Coordinator without delay.
Keep study participants data confidential and stored as per the studys data management plan.
Protecting study integrity (no contamination) - Use study materials, messages and tools only with enrolled study participants and only as the protocol allows.
Do not share study content with non-study clients, other staff, peer workers or outside organisations.
Keep study counselling and routine OST counselling clearly separate in records and in practice.
Raise any doubt about what may or may not be shared with the Study Coordinator before acting.
Team and reporting - Take part in daily clinic huddles, weekly case reviews and study team meetings.
Submit monthly counselling and study activity reports.
Carry out any other task assigned by the clinic in-charge in line with the programme.


Requirements
Essential (in line with NACO norms for NACP counsellors) - Either: Postgraduate degree in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Human Development or Nursing, with at least 1 year of counselling experience in the health sector; Or: Graduate degree in the same disciplines, with at least 3 years of counselling experience in the health sector.
Fluency in Mizo (spoken and written) and working knowledge of English.
Basic computer skills - MS Office, email and data entry.
Desirable - Experience of counselling at an OST centre, IDU Targeted Intervention, de-addiction or harm reduction setting.
Experience of working with young people. Prior experience in a research study; GCP certification. NACO / SACS counsellor training.
Candidates from the community of people who use drugs or people living with HIV who meet the criteria are encouraged to apply.


Personal Attributes
Non-judgemental, empathetic and comfortable working with people who use drugs.
Disciplined in following protocols and keeping accurate records.
Trustworthy with confidential information.
Able to work in a team and with flexible hours when the clinic needs it.

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.
Key Responsibilities
Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Mayasheel Ventures Limited is an established engineering and construction company with a presence in the infrastructure sector since 2008. The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

Description:
Academic Counsellor
Locations - Indore / Bangalore / Pune - Wakad / Pune - Kothrud)

About the Role
As an Academic Counsellor, you will play a key role in guiding potential learners, helping them identify the right career path, and showcasing how upGrads programs can accelerate their journey. You will be responsible for driving enrollments and revenue by nurturing leads, providing consultative counselling, and closing sales in a highly competitive environment.

5 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1.Performance Incentives: Target monthly incentive of INR 30,000, with potential to earn 1.5X/2X of that based on performance.
2.Career Growth: Promotion opportunities in 1 year or lateral movement across other Business Units at upGrad.
3.Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount for your family.
4.Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
5.Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.

Key Responsibilities
Engage with potential learners through calls, video sessions, and in-centre meetings to understand their career goals and recommend suitable programs.
Drive weekly & monthly enrollment and revenue targets by effectively converting leads into admissions.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle from first interaction to enrollment and post-sales support.
Track and improve key performance metrics such as counselling sessions, conversion rates, and revenue.
Maintain accurate learner records on CRM and share feedback with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.
Work closely with centre teams to ensure a smooth learner journey and high satisfaction levels.

Skills & Experience
Graduate with 25 years of experience in consultative or B2C sales (education industry exposure preferred).
Strong communication, persuasion and relationship-building skills.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Empathetic listener with ability to build trust and focus on learner success.
Comfortable with CRM tools and basic MS Office proficiency.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.

Description:
So what does a Senior Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as one of the leaders
of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs, we make sure
we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our
employees are top notch. Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to imagine
what it’s like being a Senior Operations Manager.
TaskUs is the fastest growing tech-enabled business services company in the world. We exist to
provide ridiculously innovative customer support, AI operations, and content security to the
world’s most disruptive companies
We believe our Frontline employees come first, always. At TaskUs, leaders eat last––in other
words, we expect you to put your line of direct reports before yourself. We think in terms of
#FrontlineFirst because we know good ideas can come from anyone at anytime. That’s probably
why we’re ranked 40th on Glassdoor’s 2019 “100 Best Places to Work” list.
A special place requires special people. Qualified candidates have a sense of humility, an
adventurous spirit, and a relentless work ethic. If you are looking for more than the standard 9 to
5, you’ve found it.
We exist to make the world’s best companies better. We aim to have fun while doing it.
So what does a Senior Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as one of the leaders
of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs, we make sure
we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our
employees are top notch. Come on now, we need your full attention because it’s time to imagine
what it’s like being a Senior Operations Manager.
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: in a company like TaskUs, it’s
more than just the KPIs if you want to solve business problems through innovation. As
you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will all lead to one thing that your
department believes in: to provide the best possible customer experience to your clients.
As a Senior Operations Manager, you will oversee and direct the activities of a number of
campaigns along with all Operations Managers, Team Leaders and Staff assigned to his
campaigns. You will also be responsible for a wide spectrum of responsibilities and must be able
to multitask with ease and proficiency. Along with this, you are also responsible for the regular
and often daily interactions with all the company departments/ campaign team leaders and the
whole management team. Maintain an open line of communication between staff and senior
management. You will manage and staff the operations assigned. You will also be responsible
for all aspects of operations which include but not limited to monitoring operations staffing,
provide temporary coverage and training; provision of excellent clientele service, problem
resolution and the like. What else? Well, you will also develop individual & team goals and
implement a plan to carry out objectives. You will guide Operations Managers in a meeting of all
team & individual goals. Along with this, you must ensure compliance with all established

policies and procedures. You also need to also Assist the Operations Director in crafting
operations procedures.
So, do you have what it takes to become a Senior Operations Manager?
Requirements:
So, what is it we’re looking for? Well, since this is a Senior Operations Manager post, we need
someone who already has the skills to even call themselves a Senior Operations Manager! In
other words, someone who has at least 3 years of related working experience, preferably
someone who has experience in being a Senior Manager/Director specializing in BPO
Operations and Management or equivalent.
We need someone who has handled at least 600 FTEs. Someone with strong computer
skills, especially in using MS Office applications and Google applications. We need someone
who’s responsible and has a good track record of meeting and delivering targets. Someone
who can articulate him/herself well enough with others, like teammates and clients. So
definitely someone with excellent verbal and written communication and customer service
skills.
We need someone who can multitask and work in a fast-paced high-stress environment.
Someone who can lead and is great in analyzing situations and data. Someone who has the
ability to build productive business relationships with clients. Someone who has strong
organizational, analytical and managerial skills. Lastly, we need someone who possesses a
professional, courteous, and resilient attitude.
TaskUs is the fastest growing tech-enabled business services company in the world, delivering
the customer support, AI operations and content security services that power the world’s most
innovative companies. Listed as one of Glassdoor‘s “100 Best Places to Work”, USA Today’s
“Best Company Cultures” and “Best Companies for Women” by Comparably, TaskUs is a
Frontline-First company that puts its people at the heart of everything they do.
TaskUs has been recognized as one of the Inc. “500 Fastest Growing Private Companies in
America” for the past seven years consecutively. Founded in 2008 by Bryce Maddock and
Jaspar Weir, the company raised over $250mm in 2018 from the world’s largest private equity
firm, Blackstone.
TaskUs currently has over 15,000 employees and offices across the U.S., Philippines, India,
Taiwan, and Mexico.
TaskUs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

Digitalization. Simply delivered.

#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #JobLocations #Indore #Chennai # Bangalore

Grow together.
We operate in an agile/DevSecOps manner, with product-oriented teams holding end-to-end responsibility for product success. Our work follows Scrum practices, including stand-ups, reviews, and iterative deployment. While not strictly by the book, we embrace agile principles, learning from failures and getting better every day.

About the IoT team
We are a supportive, quality-driven group of tech enthusiasts who strive to improve daily and are eager to assist you on your journey with us! Our global team includes members from India and Germany, collaborating via Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Confluence. We are aiming to provide a platform that accelerates IoT adoption for operational excellence, customer experience, and employee safety. We built a global platform that processes data from millions of connected devices across DHL and are developing modular use cases for real-time shipment monitoring (e.g. for life science and healthcare shipments) and actionable insights.

Tech stack
Our IoT platform is built on Microsoft Azure, featuring a micro-services architecture and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and delivery, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes. We primarily use .NET Core, C#, and Angular for coding.

Ready to embark on the journey? Heres what we are looking for:
Were looking for a Software Engineer in our IoT team who does both product development (we also do something with AI) where you will have an opportunity to directly impact customer experience in DHL as well as support existing IoT use case implementations.

What do we expect from you?
Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a strong portfolio of projects
Excellent problem-solving skills
Individual with positive energy and can-do attitude
A desire to grow and continuously improve in a fast-paced environment
Strong knowledge in .NET Core and C#
Strong code-reading skills and knack for writing clean, testable, easily maintainable code
Experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud PaaS services
Extensive knowledge in Entity Framework Core
Experience in MS SQL Server
Very good written and spoken English
Willingness to work in the UK shift

Good to have:
Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Kubernetes Service
Thorough understanding of the responsibilities of the platform, database, API, caching layer, proxies, and other web services used in the syste
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai and Indore
An array of benefits for you:
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Assess the nutritional requirements of patients based on their medical condition, age, weight, and clinical history.
Prepare individualized diet charts as per doctors' advice and patients' nutritional needs.
Plan therapeutic diets for patients suffering from diabetes, hypertension, kidney disorders, cardiac diseases, liver disorders, and other medical conditions.
Coordinate with treating doctors and nursing staff regarding patients' dietary requirements.
Monitor patients' nutritional status and modify diet plans as required.
Conduct regular diet counselling for patients and their attendants.
Ensure proper preparation and distribution of patient meals according to prescribed diet charts.
Coordinate with the kitchen and dietary staff to ensure food quality, hygiene, and nutritional standards.
Monitor special diets, including liquid diets, soft diets, diabetic diets, low-salt diets, and high-protein diets.
Ensure timely delivery of meals to patients as per the prescribed schedule.
Maintain daily records of diet assessments, diet charts, counselling, and patient feedback.
Conduct regular kitchen inspections to ensure food safety, cleanliness, and hygiene.
Monitor food storage, handling, and preparation practices.
Coordinate with nursing staff for diet changes, NPO instructions, and special dietary requirements.
Participate in hospital audits, quality improvement activities, and NABH-related documentation.
Conduct nutritional awareness and education sessions for patients and hospital staff.
Report any dietary complaints, food quality issues, or non-compliance to the concerned authority.
AboutCompany:
Welcome To ITM Hospital Gwalior
We, at ITM Hospital & Research Centre, offer comprehensive treatment for various urological conditions. Our state-of-the-art facilities specialize in providing services in the areas of urology, uro-oncology, reconstructive urology, and laparoscopic andrology services, among others. Considered the best urology hospital, we incorporate the latest advancements in the medical field to offer the highest clinical governance standards and patient-centric care.
Some of our exceptional services include laparoscopic urological surgery, ABO-incompatible kidney transplant, renal transplantation, uro-oncology, reconstructive surgery of the urinary tract, and laser urological procedures. In addition to this, we also perform highly complex urological procedures like radical prostatectomy, partial nephrectomy, etc. All urological surgeries are performed laparoscopically to ensure great precision for improved patient outcomes.

Roles & Responsibilities
Maintain and monitor all biomedical equipment installed in the hospital.
Conduct regular preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) of medical equipment.
Ensure proper functioning of ventilators, monitors, ECG machines, infusion pumps, defibrillators, OT equipment, dialysis machines, and other medical devices.
Maintain equipment-wise records, including installation, maintenance, calibration, breakdown, and repair history.
Prepare and update the Biomedical Equipment Master List.
Ensure calibration of medical equipment as per defined schedules and manufacturer recommendations.
Attend equipment breakdown complaints promptly and minimize equipment downtime.
Coordinate with authorized service providers and vendors for repairs and maintenance.
Ensure equipment safety checks before putting any equipment into clinical use.
Conduct user training for nursing staff, doctors, and technicians regarding the safe operation of medical equipment.
Monitor equipment AMC/CMC contracts and warranty periods.
Ensure compliance with NABH standards related to medical equipment management.
Maintain equipment condemnation, condemnation committee, and disposal records.
Ensure proper tagging of equipment, including functional, under maintenance, and out-of-order status.
Submit monthly biomedical maintenance and equipment performance reports to management. Role & responsibilities

Description:
The Relationship Officer will be responsible for supporting the organization's objectives by working closely with customers, prospects, and business clients and ensuring that assigned responsibilities are handled professionally, accurately, and within agreed timelines.

The role involves understanding financial products, account services, lending solutions, and relationship opportunities, coordinating with relevant stakeholders, prioritizing tasks, and contributing to effective execution of activities that support departmental plans and business requirements.

Key responsibilities include managing customer interactions, documentation, portfolio follow-ups, service requests, and business leads, maintaining clear and accurate records, communicating updates, addressing routine challenges, and escalating complex matters appropriately to ensure smooth workflow and dependable outcomes.

The individual will ensure adherence to banking policies, product guidelines, customer verification, and applicable compliance requirements, use relevant tools and systems effectively, maintain professional conduct, and identify practical opportunities to streamline processes, improve service, and strengthen collaboration.

Success in this position will be demonstrated through customer satisfaction, portfolio quality, service efficiency, and sustainable business growth, a proactive approach, sound judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, effective communication, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

Description:
SAM MEDICAL COLLEGE & RESEARCH CENTER, BHOPAL

Recruitment Across All Departments

Regular / Full-Time and Part-Time Opportunities
SAM Medical College & Research Center invites applications from qualified candidates for teaching, clinical, nursing, technical, administrative and support positions.

1. Medical Faculty & Doctors
Applications are invited for the following profiles:
Professors and Heads of Departments
Associate Professors
Assistant Professors
Senior Residents
Junior Residents
Tutors / Demonstrators
Consultants / Visiting Consultants
Medical Officers / Resident Medical Officers
Academic and hospital leadership positions, including Dean / Principal and Medical Superintendent
Departments: Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, Community Medicine, General Medicine, Paediatrics, Respiratory Medicine, Dermatology, Psychiatry, General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, ENT, Ophthalmology, Anaesthesiology, Radiodiagnosis, Emergency Medicine and Dentistry. Applications from other specialties and super-specialties are also welcome, subject to departmental requirements.
Key responsibilities: Teaching and student mentoring; patient care and clinical services appropriate to the specialty; participation in academic activities, research and assessments; maintenance of departmental records; and coordination of departmental operations according to the assigned designation.
2. Nursing
Nursing Superintendent, Deputy / Assistant Nursing Superintendent, Nursing Supervisors, Ward In-charges, Staff Nurses and specialised nursing personnel for wards, emergency, ICU, NICU, PICU, operation theatres and labour room.
Key responsibilities: Deliver nursing care, administer prescribed treatment, monitor patients, maintain nursing records, follow infection-control practices and coordinate with the treating team.
3. Allied Health, Paramedical & Technical Services
Laboratory Technicians / Technologists, Phlebotomists, Radiographers, CT / MRI Technicians, OT and Anaesthesia Technicians, Dialysis Technicians, ECG Technicians, Blood Centre Technicians, Pharmacists, Physiotherapists, Dietitians, Optometrists, Audiology / Speech Therapy professionals, CSSD Technicians and Biomedical Engineers / Technicians.
Key responsibilities: Provide role-specific diagnostic, therapeutic and technical support; operate and maintain equipment within authorised competence; maintain records; and follow quality and safety procedures.
4. Administration, Academic & Hospital Support
Hospital Administration, HR, Accounts, Billing, Front Office, Patient Relations, Medical Records / MRD, Quality, Purchase, Stores, IT / HMIS, Library, Academic Office, Admissions, Examination Cell, Departmental Clerical Staff, Hostel Administration and Wardens.
Key responsibilities: Manage assigned administrative functions, maintain accurate records, support patients and staff, and coordinate college and hospital operations.
5. Facilities & General Support
Maintenance Supervisors, Electricians, Plumbers, HVAC Technicians, Housekeeping Supervisors and Staff, Security Personnel, Drivers, Ambulance Staff, Ward Attendants, Patient Care Assistants, Laundry and Dietary / Kitchen Staff.
Key responsibilities: Support safe, clean and reliable campus and hospital services according to the assigned role and duty schedule.
Eligibility
Relevant recognized qualifications, professional registration wherever required, and experience appropriate to the position. Teaching appointments will be subject to applicable NMC eligibility requirements. Other appointments will follow the requirements of the respective professional council and institution.
Appointment Type
Regular / full-time appointments and part-time / visiting engagements are available for suitable roles, subject to departmental requirements and applicable appointment norms. Applicants should mention their preferred engagement type and availability.
Remuneration
To be discussed based on the position, qualifications, experience and agreed work schedule.
Application Details
Applicants should provide an updated CV mentioning the post, department, qualifications, experience, preferred appointment type, current location and earliest joining date.

For applications and further details, contact: 9239004900

Job Description

HGS has been assisting global customers since 2003 bringing data to life as their Trusted Analytics and Planning partner. At HGS, we have over 20 years of experience implementing analytics and planning solutions. We serve customers across multiple industries including, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Manufacturing, Technology, Higher Education and Public institutions. Majority of our customers are renowned Fortune 500 organizations.
Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.
Interested candidates please share your profile to ___________@teamhgs.com

It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!

AboutCompany:
DB Corp is the largest print media company of India. It publishes newspapers in 3 Indian languages across 12 Indian States with 65 print Editions with 6.6 cr total readerships. Its flagship brand in Hindi language is Dainik Bhaskar, Divya Bhaskar is Gujarati language and Divya Marathi is Marathi language newspaper. In FY 18-19, DB Corp recorded revenue of around USD 350 Million with PAT of around USD 40 Million.

The group employs 2700 journalists throughout the country for its news gathering operations which makes for more than 25% of its total workforce of around 10,000 employees.

DB Corp also has a significant presence in the Radio and Digital Media segment. Our radio brand, 'My FM 94.3', which currently operates from 30 stations in 7 States, is growing rapidly and aggressively. Its digital presence is widespread with 9 portals for rapidly expanding digital audiences and 4 actively downloaded mobile applications.

Promote and sell a wide range of decorative and industrial paints to dealers, contractors, architects, and end-users.

Self-motivated and target-oriented.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager – Business Development (Retail Expansion)
  Department: Retail Business Development
Location: East-(Patna/Kolkatta) / South (Bangalore)
Reporting To: Head – Business Development (Retail)
Salary Budget: - Upto 13 Lacs
  Role Summary
We are looking for a sharp, execution-focused Business Development Professional to spearhead our retail footprint expansion. The ideal candidate will own the end-to-end store rollout pipeline—from identifying high-potential retail locations and negotiating cost-effective lease terms to ensuring rapid store launch turnarounds and optimizing rental overheads across our existing (L2L) store network.
Key Responsibilities
1. Retail Store Expansion & Pipeline Management
Execute the annual retail expansion plan by scouting, evaluating, and securing high-footfall locations (high streets, malls, and emerging retail catchments).
Conduct thorough market mapping, demographic analysis, and catchment feasibility studies to ensure every new outlet aligns with brand positioning and revenue targets.
Build and maintain a strong network of real estate brokers, developers, mall management teams, and property landlords to maintain a healthy pipeline of properties.
2. Lease Negotiation & Rental Cost Optimization (New & L2L Stores)
Drive store-level profitability by negotiating competitive lease terms, fit-out periods, security deposits, and escalation clauses to keep average rental per store strictly within budgeted benchmarks.
Proactively manage lease renewals and rent renegotiations for existing Like-to-Like (L2L) stores to control occupancy costs and protect store margins.
Benchmark prevailing market rentals in target micro-markets to ensure cost leadership without compromising on store visibility.
3. End-to-End Store Launch & TAT Management
Expedite the new store opening process post-location sign-off by the Executive Director (ED), owning the Turnaround Time (TAT) from Letter of Intent (LOI) to store handover.
Coordinate closely with internal cross-functional teams—including Legal (agreement closure), Projects/Fit-out, Finance, and Retail Operations—to eliminate bottlenecks and ensure on-time store launches.
Track and report weekly progress on store pipeline, negotiation stages, and launch timelines to senior leadership.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Expansion Target Achievement: 100% adherence to the annual/quarterly new store opening plan.
New Store Rental Efficiency: Maintaining average rental cost per new store within approved financial thresholds.
Launch Speed: Reduction and strict adherence to New Store Opening TAT post-ED approval.
Portfolio Cost Control: Controlling average rental per store across the existing L2L store network through timely renewals and renegotiations.
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate in any discipline; an MBA in Marketing, Retail Management, or Real Estate is preferred.
Experience: 4–8 years of proven experience in Retail Business Development, Real Estate Expansion, or Leasing (preferably within footwear, apparel, QSR, or organized retail).
Skills & Competencies:
Strong commercial acumen with sharp negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
Deep understanding of local retail real estate markets, catchment potential, and lease documentation.
High sense of urgency, project management discipline, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.
Proficiency in MS Excel for financial feasibility modeling and MIS reporting.

Description:
Purpose of the Admission Officer role:
Admission officer is responsible for lead generation through variety of marketing activities resulting in counselling and enrolling the students.
As an Admission officer, you are expected to:
Generate admissions by maintaining a continuous influx of data by conducting Above The Line (ATL) & Below The Line (BTL) marketing activities such as- seminars in schools, open seminars in town & residential spots within a specified territory.
Contribute towards set targets by doing school visits for meeting principals, coordinators and management personals for business development.
Ensure a delightful customer experience while going for home visits to counsel students and parents and close admissions resulting in enrolling the students.
Capitalize on business opportunities by liaising with local tuition teachers.
Ensure adherence to internal processes and compliances.
To be successful in the Admission Officer role you are required to have:
Ability to handle customers in a calm, empathic & patient manner, along with strong sales persuasion skills.
Excellent networking and presentation skills to conduct seminars.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and writing emails, & comfortable while working on software related to Sales & Services.
Fluency in communication of English and Regional Language.
Comfortable for traveling and public speaking.

Qualification:
Must have bachelors degree.
Preferred BTech / MBA /Masters in Psychology, Education etc.
Experience:
Previous experience in counselling in education or careers counselling.
Previous experience of Business to Customer (B2C) Sales across industries.
AboutCompany:
About Us
Aakash Educational Services Ltd. (AESL) is one of Indias most trusted names in test preparation, known for providing students with a competitive edge through classroom, digital, hybrid and distance learning programs. We specialize in coaching for major medical and engineering entrance exams such as NEET and JEE (Main & Advanced), as well as school/board examinations, scholarship tests, and Olympiads.
Our philosophy of “Student First” drives everything we do. With highly qualified and passionate faculty, we focus on understanding each student’s unique learning needs and guiding them to achieve their goals. AESL is committed to expanding its reach nationwide, delivering high-quality education to students in every corner of the country, including regions where access to physical classrooms is limited.
We are proud to be certified a Great Place to Work ® for five consecutive years.
Aakash Advantage
As a leader in competitive exam preparation, AESL offers a workplace where passionate individuals can make a lasting difference. What sets Aakash apart:
Nationwide Presence and Growth: With more than 400 branches across India, AESL provides employees ample opportunities to grow within a leading educational brand.
Student-Centric Culture: Over 10,000 employees collaborate with expert faculty members, united in their commitment to mentoring and building the success of students.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Aakash’s fully digitized classrooms and hybrid learning models combine traditional teaching with advanced digital methods, keeping employees at the forefront of educational innovation.
Proven Impact: Aakash’s results speak for themselves, with 9 Lakh+ NEET and JEE qualifiers over the years, including All India Rank 1 in NEET and JEE (Advanced).

Operate and maintain plastic processing machines such as extruders, blow molders, and injection molders.

Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure equipment is properly maintained and repaired.

Work closely with the production team to meet daily targets and deadlines.

Minimum 2 years of experience in plastic processing operations or a related field.

Strong knowledge of plastic materials and manufacturing processes.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Familiarity with quality control measures and safety protocols.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

Description:
Trainee - Program Implementation

Location: Nagaland, Haryana

About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs : 1) Career Aware with students of Municipal schools and Low income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of Low income private Junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in. This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY):
Operations and Administration:
Vendor Management:
Communication:
Student Support and Tracking:
If you are excited about the potential of youth in our country and want to be able to contribute to the careers of less privileged youth apply for this role


Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).


Whats in it for you
A young, vibrant work environment where Care forms the bedrock of our culture
Working with a Manager who will help you learn and develop and give autonomy wherever possible
Roles and responsibilities that will help you hone transferable skills relevant to the social impact space and beyond
Last but not the leastthe chance to form some strong bonds and connections!

Description:
Position: Site Engineer
Supervise the construction site activities and ensure all construction work is performed in accordance with project specifications, drawings, and schedules.

Coordinate with contractors, sub-contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

Monitor and manage project timelines to ensure work is completed on schedule.

Conduct regular inspections and audits to ensure the quality and safety of work performed on-site.

Prepare and review site reports, progress reports, and other documentation required for the project.

Review and manage project budgets and costs; track materials, labor, and equipment usage to ensure budget adherence.

Manage and resolve any technical issues or delays that arise during construction.

Ensure all health, safety, and environmental regulations are adhered to, implementing safety protocols on-site.

Provide guidance and support to junior engineers and other site staff, ensuring they understand project requirements and deadlines.

Liaise with the design and planning teams to ensure all design requirements are met during construction.

Ensure effective communication between all team members, including project managers, architects, contractors, and stakeholders.

Coordinate the delivery of materials and equipment to ensure the site is always adequately supplied.

Participate in site meetings, offering input and providing updates on the status of the project.
