Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance in areas of responsibility. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (e.g., greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the financial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We re committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!
Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Verification Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance.
These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces (Audio serial interfaces, I2C, SPI) and other digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Interrupts etc.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, industrial and automotive markets.
Position : Digital Design Verification Engineer
Domain : Consumer Audio Amplifiers and Haptics
Location : Bangalore
What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity
To work with the best experts in the industry.
To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
To innovate on core technology in verification methodologies influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products teams.
To work on cutting edge industry leading products.
To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation quality of the product.
To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product technology execution.
To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts.
To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts.
To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities.
To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner.
To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns.
Primary Responsibilities:
Responsible to develop detailed coverage driven Verification plan working closing with System and Application team and design team.
Owning part of digital verification of the sub-system and full-chip by working closely with other verification team members, leads including outside services.
Develop/Enhance SV/UVM based testbenches and tests and simulations at all phases (RTL, GLS),
Understanding spec and coming up with testplan. Writing TB components, testcases, checkers, assertions, enhancing with randomization and coverage-feedbacks.
RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage functional) goals.
Good interaction with Digital Design team, Firmware developers, Analog Designers, and rest of the team.
Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help DV members Communication of DV status, issues, and concerns.
Innovate drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows.
Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis.
Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
Basic Qualifications: Bachelors/Masters Degree in EE/ECE
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
3 years of Digital design verification experience.
Basic Requirement:
Strong digital design fundamentals basic Electrical engineering
Experience with Verilog, System Verilog languages with UVM methodology.
Experience on randomization and coverage driven digital verification.
Experience in working with VIPs, creating TB components, agents, monitors, scoreboards and other ways to automate verification.
Hand on experience in RTL and Gate level simulations of complex ASIC at block and top level
Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence, Xcelium/Ncsim).
Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill.
Excellent in Coverage driven verification with code coverage, functional coverage
Experience in Formal verification (using Jasper Gold) is good to have
Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork.

Preferred Qualifications:
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders.
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results.
Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams.
Added Advantage :
Experience in silicon debug along with design and silicon validation team.
Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications.
Hands-on exp on I2C, SPI, ASI protocols.
Hand on experience on Cadence tools
Preferred Skills/ Experience
3-5 years of relevant experience

Description:
Kindly Note : We are considering candidates who can relocate to the below mentioned locations
Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai
Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas)
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies - Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures - Inspection Optimization - Piping Circutization/TML development - API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals - In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment - Knowledge of materials and standards - Knowledge of corrosion & welding - Knowledge of NDTs -Thickness inspection management and analysis- Corrosion management and analysis- Inspection plan development/ optimization.- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) - Ability to lead teams - Excellent communication
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Ensuring product availability across all relevant channels.
Planning and achieving monthly and yearly sales targets, including setting targets for each distributor.

Bachelors degree in any discipline
1-5 years of field sales experience in FMCG/FMCD
Strong understanding of channel sales and distribution management
Ability to develop and maintain strong trade and distributor relationships

Good command over communication, analytics and problem-solving
Ability to lead and motivate secondary sales teams in dynamic environments
Local candidates preferred. Fluency in Punjabi is mandatory.

Job Description Vehicle Architecture & Packaging Engineer

Company: Hi-Tech Robotics Systemz Pvt. Ltd.
Client: ITL Sonalika
Position: Vehicle Architecture & Packaging Engineer
Experience: 3 to 5 Years
Job Location: Hoshiarpur, Punjab
Employment: Hi-Tech Robotics Systemz Pvt. Ltd.
Client Location: ITL Sonalika, Hoshiarpur

About the Role

Hi-Tech Robotics Systemz Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled Vehicle Architecture & Packaging Engineer to work on-site at our client location, ITL Sonalika, Hoshiarpur. The candidate will be responsible for vehicle concept development, complete vehicle layout and architecture, packaging, digital mock-up activities, and design evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain concept layouts and complete vehicle architecture.
Perform vehicle-level packaging studies considering space, functionality, manufacturability, serviceability, and integration requirements.
Develop and evaluate 2D/3D vehicle layouts and support various design iterations.
Perform DMU (Digital Mock-Up) activities to check component integration, clearances, interference, and accessibility.
Coordinate with various engineering teams for integration of systems and components within the vehicle package.
Identify and resolve packaging and integration issues during the product development cycle.
Support DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) activities and identify potential design-related risks.
Prepare and review engineering layouts, design concepts, and technical documentation.
Use UG NX for 3D modelling, assembly, packaging, and design/layout activities.
Conduct interference and clearance checks using 3D/DMU environments.
Collaborate with design, engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure design feasibility.
Participate in design reviews and provide technical inputs for improving vehicle architecture and packaging.

Required Skills

Strong understanding of complete vehicle architecture and layout.
Hands-on experience in vehicle packaging and component integration.
Good knowledge of DMU / Digital Mock-Up.
Working knowledge of DFMEA and design risk assessment.
Hands-on experience with UG NX / Siemens NX.
Good understanding of 3D assemblies, clearances, interference checks, and design integration.
Knowledge of automotive/tractor product development processes.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
Good communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

Educational Qualification

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or related discipline.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience in vehicle architecture, packaging, layout, DMU, or automotive/tractor design.

Our Engineering Solutions are being used by more than 50+ OEMs across Automotive, Agriculture, Farm & Construction (Off highway Vehicles) & Industrial Equipments in India and across the globe.

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:
Clean and service assigned rooms or areas according to established standards and procedures including making beds, dusting, vacuuming, cleaning and sanitizing bathrooms, removing trash/rubbish, etc.
Respond to guest complaints, special requests and take action to ensure guest satisfaction
Report, turn in, and/or log all lost and found items according to established procedures
Work as part of a team and communicate with other departments as per hotel procedures to ensure excellent quality and service
What We need from you:
Bachelors Degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in hospitality or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
What you can expect from us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.
Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

The Category Head will be responsible for leading the assigned category in a key market, collaborating closely with the leadership team and cross-functional departments. 1. Sales & Revenue Generation

Data-driven approach with ability to conduct market research and analysis.

Result-oriented with high energy.

Exceptional communication and influencing skills at all organizational levels.

Brief About company:

A pioneering brand in the radio space, 94.3 MY FM is the radio business of DB Corp Ltd. Launched in 2006, MY FM took a bottom-up approach and set up its network across 30 Tier II & III cities across 7 states, building on the strong local understanding that Bhaskar Group had in these markets. True to its brand name which signifies the emotional ownership and personalized approach of the station, MY FM has successfully established a network of 30 highly localized stations focusing on individual market preferences. Constantly evolving and innovating its offerings, MY FM draws a keen focus on its brand philosophy of 'Jiyo Dil Se', forging an emotional connect with its listeners while continually creating offerings to suit local tastes. Capitalizing on the strengths of the medium, MY FM has become India's leading Local FM Network backed by in-depth market understating and high audience engagement. The brand philosophy is extended into every aspect of MY FM, encouraging listeners to live their life to the fullest while giving the brand a young and vibrant feel. Spread across the 7 states of Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, MY FM is available in Jaipur, Jodhpur, Chandigarh, Bhopal, Jalandhar, Ahmedabad, Surat, Udaipur, Gwalior, Indore, Ajmer, Amritsar, Bilaspur, Nagpur, Raipur, Kota, Jabalpur, Rajkot, Hisar, Karnal, Aurangabad, Sangli, Ahmednagar, Nanded. Job Title
Area Sales Head – Standard Division
Level
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location
AMRITSAR Br.
Reporting To
Product head
Supervising
Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities
1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the standard division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.  
  Candidates’ profile -
Education
Preferred MBA B. Tech /B.E or any postgraduate with 60 %
Experience
5-8 Years
Salary
Best in industry
Personal Attributes
Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age
Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified™ Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.

¢ Broadband and network knowledge
¢ Inventory management

Description:
We take our housekeeping standards seriously. So, we re searching for a Room Attendant with an exceptional eye for detail and a passion for perfection to make sure every guest enjoys a truly memorable experience.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Making sure every single room is at its absolute best for our guests
Helping our guests in any way you can - whether they ve forgotten their toothbrush or just need to find the elevator
Keeping your supervisor in the loop by advising them of any progress or problems
Monitoring and controlling supplies to minimise waste
Doing your best to reunite guests with any lost or misplaced items
Regularly assisting with deep clean projects

What We need from you:
It s a physical role and you ll be on your feet most of the day, so fitness is important
Occasional lifting of items up to 50 pounds / 23 kilograms and or push/pulling heavy objects
You may need to bend and kneel to complete some activities
Literacy skills - reading, writing and basic maths skills
Flexible attitude to shifts - you may be required to work nights, weekends and/or holidays

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing
framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Company Description
Heritage Foods Ltd. is one of India's largest and reputable FMCG companies, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu. The company has two divisions - Dairy and Renewable Energy, under its flagship Company Heritage Foods Limited. Heritage's milk and milk products have a market presence in multiple states across PAN India.

Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role for a Trade Marketing Executive located in Bangalore & Vijayawada. Trade Marketing Executive will be responsible for Execute trade marketing strategies to boost brand visibility, drive sales, and enhance retailer engagement. This role involves understanding regional market trends, implementing trade programs, and working with sales and marketing teams to support business growth. market planning, utilizing analytical skills, Sales Promotions, and implementing sales & marketing initiatives on a regional level.

Key Result Areas
Trade Marketing Strategy Execution Implement and drive regional trade marketing plans effectively to support business growth.
Sales Growth Contribution Enhance product visibility and drive promotions to achieve targeted sales growth.
Retailer & Distributor Engagement Strengthen relationships with trade partners to improve brand presence and trade participation.
Merchandising & POSM Deployment Ensure proper placement and utilization of POS materials to maximize impact.
Market Analysis & Competitive Insights Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer preferences to refine strategies.
Budget Utilization & ROI Optimize trade marketing spend and assess the return on investment for promotional activities.
Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with sales, marketing, and distribution teams to align trade initiatives with business goals.
Compliance & Process Adherence – Ensure all trade marketing activities adhere to company policies and regulatory guidelines.

Qualifications
3-8 years of experience in trade marketing, sales, or retail marketing, preferably in the FMCG or dairy industry.
MBA or PGDM in Marketing
28-35 years Old
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned region.

Job Description : Record to Report (R2R) Responsibilities

Journal Entries:

Assist in preparing and posting journal entries during month-end and year-end close.

Ensure all entries are backed by appropriate documentation.

General Ledger (GL) Accounting:

Reconcile GL accounts to ensure accuracy.

Identify and resolve discrepancies.

Month-End / Quarter-End Close Activities:

Support in closing books of accounts on a timely basis.

Assist with accruals, prepayments, and provisions.

Fixed Assets Accounting:

Support the maintenance of the fixed asset register.

Help with capitalization, depreciation, and disposals.

Intercompany Transactions:

Support in reconciling intercompany balances.

Assist in processing intercompany invoices and settlements.

Balance Sheet Reconciliations:

Prepare or assist in preparing reconciliations for assigned accounts.

Investigate and resolve reconciling items.

External Reporting – Responsibilities

Financial Statements:

Assist in the preparation of financial statements in line with applicable reporting standards.

Provide supporting documentation for disclosures.

Audit Support:

Liaise with internal and external auditors.

Provide requested schedules, reconciliations, and documentation.

Compliance Reporting:

Support in preparing statutory reports and regulatory filings.

Ensure timely submission of required reports to authorities.

Variance Analysis:

Help in performing variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts.

Assist in preparing commentary and explanation for deviations.

Data Compilation & Quality Checks:

Extract financial data from ERP systems for reporting.

Perform data integrity checks before finalizing reports.

Job Title: Admission Officer
Division/Department: Sales
Reports To: Branch Head
Desired Work Experience: 2-7 Years
Weekly off: Rotational
About Us
Aakash Educational Services Ltd. (AESL) is one of Indias most trusted names in test preparation, known for providing students with a competitive edge through classroom, digital, hybrid and distance learning programs. We specialize in coaching for major medical and engineering entrance exams such as NEET and JEE (Main & Advanced), as well as school/board examinations, scholarship tests, and Olympiads.
Our philosophy of Student First drives everything we do. With highly qualified and passionate faculty, we focus on understanding each students unique learning needs and guiding them to achieve their goals. AESL is committed to expanding its reach nationwide, delivering high-quality education to students in every corner of the country, including regions where access to physical classrooms is limited.
We are proud to be certified a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years.

Aakash Advantage
As a leader in competitive exam preparation, AESL offers a workplace where passionate individuals can make a lasting difference. What sets Aakash apart:
Nationwide Presence and Growth: With more than 400 branches across India, AESL provides employees ample opportunities to grow within a leading educational brand.
Student-Centric Culture: Over 10,000 employees collaborate with expert faculty members, united in their commitment to mentoring and building the success of students.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Aakashs fully digitized classrooms and hybrid learning models combine traditional teaching with advanced digital methods, keeping employees at the forefront of educational innovation.
Proven Impact: Aakashs results speak for themselves, with 9 Lakh+ NEET and JEE qualifiers over the years, including All India Rank 1 in NEET and JEE (Advanced).
Purpose of the Admission Officer role:
The admission officer advises students-parents for their learning needs through structured Counselling Sessions to improve student outcomes and help students succeed academically.

As an Admission officer, you are expected to:
1. Contribute towards revenue generation by working on the sales targets.
2. Selling/up-selling/cross-selling the company's exclusive range of education courses to existing & prospective students.
3. Responsible for converting new/ qualified leads into successful admissions, in turn achieving the assigned sales target.
4. Update student information in the system for lead management and follow ups.
5. Attend regular training sessions on Product Knowledge and Sales Skills to achieve and exceed growing Sales target(s).
6. Ensure adherence to internal process and compliances.

To be successful in the Admission Officer role you are required to have:
1. Ability to handle students and parents in an empathic & patient manner
2. Must have strong sales persuasion and negotiation skills.
3. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and writing emails & comfortable while working on software related to sales & services.
4. Fluency in English and Regional Language.

Must to have Attitude:
1. Customer Orientation
2. Sense of Ownership and Accountability.
3. Result orientation
4. Emotional intelligence for working in a team.

Qualification:
1. Must have bachelors degree.
2. Preferred BTech / MBA /Masters in Psychology, Education etc.

Experience:
1. Previous experience in counselling in education or careers counselling.
2. Previous experience of Business to Customer (B2C) sales across industries.

Key Interactions:
External
Student, Parents.
Internal
Branch’s Academic & Non-Academic teams.
Regional Student Support Centre.
Regional Sales & Operations Team.

Description:
The Customer Care Executive will be responsible for supporting the organization's objectives by working closely with internal teams, external stakeholders, and business partners and ensuring that assigned responsibilities are handled professionally, accurately, and within agreed timelines.

The role involves understanding departmental objectives, stakeholder requirements, projects, and organizational processes, coordinating with relevant stakeholders, prioritizing tasks, and contributing to effective execution of activities that support departmental plans and business requirements.

Key responsibilities include managing coordination, communication, record management, reporting, follow-ups, and issue resolution, maintaining clear and accurate records, communicating updates, addressing routine challenges, and escalating complex matters appropriately to ensure smooth workflow and dependable outcomes.

The individual will ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, confidentiality requirements, and quality standards, use relevant tools and systems effectively, maintain professional conduct, and identify practical opportunities to streamline processes, improve service, and strengthen collaboration.

Success in this position will be demonstrated through timely execution, stakeholder satisfaction, process consistency, and organizational objectives, a proactive approach, sound judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, effective communication, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

Description:
General Finance Management is responsible for the day-to-day financial activities of the organization including:
Controlling its financial resources and ensuring that all financial transactions, systems and procedures comply with regulations, accounting principles, and standards
Financial analysis and reporting, taxation, insurance, credit control, accounts payable and receivable, inventory and costs control, and budgeting and forecasting
Analyzing the organization''s revenues, liabilities, credit conditions, and other financial indicators to forecast it''s short, medium, and long-term cash flow position
Evaluating and recommending investments and other financial instruments to meet cash flow needs
Advising management on financial matters and the impact of laws and regulations on the organization
Providing expertise and advice to managers to help them develop budgets, understand financial reports, and manage their financial responsibilities
Presenting findings and recommendations to top executives; preparing financial reports that may include auditor and financial analyst reports, profit and loss, balance sheets, and regulatory reports and filings
Ensuring all tax returns, declarations, and other required reports are submitted accurately and on time
Selecting and managing relationships with consultants and advisors to ensure the satisfactory standards of service
Positions on this level requires basic knowledge of job procedures and tools obtained through work experience and may require vocational or basic technical education. Requires moderate supervision. Can solve routine issues independently, with occasional deviations or improvement to standard procedures.

Description:
Customer Support Agent Inbound
Company: Groww
Locations: Bangalore / Jaipur / Mumbai
Experience: 0-5 Years
Salary: 2-3 LPA
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
About Groww
Groww is a financial services platform focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian. It offers a multi-product investment platform that helps customers take control of their financial journey.
The company focuses on customer-centricity, transparency, simplicity, ownership, and making informed financial decisions easier for millions of Indians.
About the Role
We are looking for dynamic and customer-oriented individuals to join Groww's Customer Support Team as Customer Support Agents – Inbound.
The selected candidates will handle inbound customer calls, assist customers with queries related to the Groww platform and its financial products, provide accurate information, and ensure a smooth customer support experience.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, conversational Hindi, basic English proficiency, and a customer-first attitude.
Key Responsibilities
Handle a high volume of inbound customer calls and queries.
Assist customers with questions related to the Groww platform and its financial products.
Provide accurate information and resolve customer concerns effectively.
Offer technical support and guidance to customers using the platform.
Explain product features and functionalities in simple and understandable language.
Educate customers about available product features and possible upgrades.
Understand customer concerns, demonstrate empathy, and provide appropriate solutions.
Maintain excellent service standards and ensure customer satisfaction.
Collect customer feedback and identify recurring issues.
Coordinate with internal teams to help address customer concerns and improve the customer experience.
Required Skills
Strong conversational Hindi communication skills (mandatory).
Basic English communication skills.
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer support and customer-handling abilities.
Active listening and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage inbound voice calls.
Customer query resolution and relationship management.
Positive attitude and willingness to learn basic financial concepts.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
B.Com and BCA graduates preferred.
BBA, BBM, BA, B.Sc and other undergraduate/postgraduate qualifications are also considered as per eligibility.
Minimum 50% marks in 10th, 12th and Graduation.
No academic backlogs.
No education gaps during studies.
Preferred Knowledge
Basic knowledge of the following financial products and concepts will be an added advantage:
Mutual Funds
Systematic Investment Plans (SIP)
Stocks and Equities
NSDL and CDSL
Prior knowledge of financial products is not mandatory. Freshers are welcome to apply.
Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
Must have completed a Bachelor's degree.
Conversational Hindi is mandatory.
Basic English proficiency is required.
No uncleared academic backlogs.
Must meet the minimum 50% academic criteria.
Must be willing to work six days a week.
Ideal Candidate
A customer-focused individual with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to understand customer concerns and provide effective solutions. Candidates should be eager to learn about financial products and deliver a seamless customer support experience.
Freshers are eligible to apply.

The company focuses on customer-centricity, simplicity, transparency, and technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We re committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!
Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Verification Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance.
These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces (Audio serial interfaces, I2C, SPI) and other digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Interrupts etc.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, industrial and automotive markets.
Position : Digital Design Verification Engineer
Domain : Consumer Audio Amplifiers and Haptics
Location : Bangalore
What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity
To work with the best experts in the industry.
To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
To innovate on core technology in verification methodologies influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products teams.
To work on cutting edge industry leading products.
To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation quality of the product.
To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product technology execution.
To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts.
To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts.
To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities.
To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner.
To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns.
Primary Responsibilities:
Responsible to develop detailed coverage driven Verification plan working closing with System and Application team and design team.
Owning part of digital verification of the sub-system and full-chip by working closely with other verification team members, leads including outside services.
Develop/Enhance SV/UVM based testbenches and tests and simulations at all phases (RTL, GLS),
Understanding spec and coming up with testplan. Writing TB components, testcases, checkers, assertions, enhancing with randomization and coverage-feedbacks.
RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage functional) goals.
Good interaction with Digital Design team, Firmware developers, Analog Designers, and rest of the team.
Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help DV members Communication of DV status, issues, and concerns.
Innovate drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows.
Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis.
Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
Basic Qualifications: Bachelors/Masters Degree in EE/ECE
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
3 years of Digital design verification experience.
Basic Requirement:
Strong digital design fundamentals basic Electrical engineering
Experience with Verilog, System Verilog languages with UVM methodology.
Experience on randomization and coverage driven digital verification.
Experience in working with VIPs, creating TB components, agents, monitors, scoreboards and other ways to automate verification.
Hand on experience in RTL and Gate level simulations of complex ASIC at block and top level
Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence, Xcelium/Ncsim).
Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill.
Excellent in Coverage driven verification with code coverage, functional coverage
Experience in Formal verification (using Jasper Gold) is good to have
Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork.

Preferred Qualifications:
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders.
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results.
Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams.
Added Advantage :
Experience in silicon debug along with design and silicon validation team.
Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications.
Hands-on exp on I2C, SPI, ASI protocols.
Hand on experience on Cadence tools
Preferred Skills/ Experience
3-5 years of relevant experience

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Aruba is an HPE Company, and a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the Intelligent Edge - and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us redefine what s next for you.
Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated Engineer 1 - Network Support to join our global technical support team in Bangalore. The role involves providing support for enterprise networking and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, primarily based on ClearPass.
The engineer will support global customers through phone, email, and chat, assisting in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to network connectivity, authentication, and access control.
This is a hybrid working role and an excellent opportunity to build strong expertise in enterprise networking and security technologies.
What you ll do:
Key Responsibilities
Provide technical support for networking and ClearPass-related issues to global customers
Troubleshoot wired and wireless network connectivity and authentication issues
Work on access control problems involving 802.1X, RADIUS, and guest authentication
Analyse logs, configurations, and basic packet captures for troubleshooting
Document issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in ticketing tools
Collaborate with senior engineers for escalations and complex cases
Follow defined processes and SLAs in a 24x7 support environment
Required Skills & Knowledge
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals:
OSI Model and TCP/IP
IP addressing and subnetting
ARP, DHCP, DNS
VLANs and switching basics
Routing fundamentals (basic static routing)
Broadcast, multicast, and unicast traffic
STP and link aggregation basics
Basic understanding of:
Network authentication concepts (AAA, 802.1X, RADIUS)
Network security fundamentals
Wireless networking basics
Basic Active Directory and LDAP awareness
Basic Linux knowledge:
Command-line usage
Log navigation and troubleshooting basics
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in a structured support environment
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
Exposure to Network Access Control (NAC) or ClearPass (internship / project / training)
Certifications such as CCNA / CWNA / RHCSA or equivalent
Basic knowledge of Wireshark or packet capture tools
Basic scripting exposure (optional)
What you need to bring:
Experience
Typically, 2+ years experience.
Education
Bachelor s degree in any discipline (B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.)
Candidates with networking training, certifications, internships, or strong technical aptitude will be preferred
Work Schedule
This is a 24x7 global support role
Requires working in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays
Flexibility to support global customers across US / EMEA / APAC time zones
This is a Hybrid working role based in Bangalore/Chennai
Soft Skills
Strong customer service orientation
Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn
Ability to work in a team environment
Strong attention to detail and documentation quality
Ownership and accountability in resolving issues

Manager Learning and Development (Sales & Manufacturing)
You will lead end-to-end capability building across commercial sales teams and plant/manufacturing operations. The role aligns training strategies with revenue growth, productivity, quality, and safety goals. You will partner with sales leaders and plant heads to diagnose skill gaps, roll out practical learning programs, and measure business impact.
Key Responsibilities
1. Training Needs Analysis (TNA) & Strategy
F Conduct regular TNA across sales channels and manufacturing units using performance data, audit findings, and stakeholder feedback.
F Build and execute an annual L&D calendar, budget, and delivery roadmap aligned with commercial and operational targets.
2. Sales Capability & Commercial Enablement
F Design and deliver onboarding, product/solution knowledge, consultative selling, negotiation, and territory/account management programs for sales teams.
F Partner with sales leadership to reinforce field coaching, CRM adoption, and pitch readiness across regional and channel teams.
3. Manufacturing & Plant Capability Building
F Collaborate with plant heads, technical trainers, and safety leads to develop shop-floor onboarding, standard operating procedure (SOP) training, equipment/process skills, and continuous improvement modules.
F Oversee mandatory statutory, workplace safety, quality, and compliance training (including POSH and code of conduct) with strict completion tracking.
4. Program Delivery, LMS & Vendor Management
F Blend classroom workshops, on-the-job coaching, job shadowing, and digital/e-learning modules suited to field and plant schedules.
F Administer the Learning Management System (LMS) to manage enrollments, completions, assessments, and reporting.
F Select and manage external trainers, content vendors, and internal subject-matter experts (SMEs) within approved budgets.
5. Impact Measurement & Continuous Improvement
F Track training effectiveness using learner feedback, skill assessments, manager observations, and business KPIs (such as ramp-up time, sales conversion, rework/defect rates, and safety incidents).
F Refine programs based on data and evolving business priorities.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Psychology, or a related field; a Master’s/MBA is a plus with 6–10 years] of progressive L&D experience, ideally supporting both sales/commercial teams and manufacturing/industrial environments. Spoken Hindi is a must.
2. Strong instructional design and adult learning knowledge, LMS administration, stakeholder management, budget control, and data-driven evaluation.
3. Familiarity with e-learning platforms and practices
4. Experience in project management and budgeting
5. Proficient in MS Office and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
6. Excellent communication and negotiation skills; sharp business acumen

Description:
The Opportunity:
The role translates applicable regulations, standards, customer requirements, and internal policies into practical controls, repeatable methods, engineering guidance, and auditable evidence. It supports product teams through out the lifecycle-from applicability and risk assessment through secure development, conformity assessment, release, vulnerability handling, and post-market compliance. Coordinating pilot runs on new products or processes. The role provides end-to-end cybersecurity architecture ownership across controllers, embedded devices, industrial networks, HMI/SCADA, engineering workstations, and remote service interfaces, extending to edge platforms, cloud services, applications, and data flows connected to these systems. The architect translates operational risks, customer needs, and applicable security requirements into practical architectures and reusable controls, balancing protection with safety, availability, deterministic performance, maintainability, and long industrial lifecycles. This is an engineering architecture role working closely with product development, system engineering, service, and cybersecurity governance teams.

How you'll make an impact:
Act as the technical authority for cybersecurity architecture of industrial control systems and their connected digital solutions, owning architecture direction and driving implementation alignment.
Partner with control, embedded, software, network, digital platform, service, product security, and enterprise IT teams to align security responsibilities, roadmaps, and engineering execution.
Mentor engineering teams, establish reusable security practices, engage customers and suppliers on architectural topics, and communicate security trade-offs and investment priorities to technical and business stakeholders.

Your Background:
Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Strong grounding in industrial automation, systems and network architecture, cybersecurity engineering, and secure product development. Relevant industrial cybersecurity or security architecture certifications are an advantage.
15+ years of relevant experience across industrial control systems, protection and automation, embedded products, or critical infrastructure, including substantial responsibility for cybersecurity engineering and architecture.
Proven experience defining and delivering security architectures for industrial products or OT system solutions, from risk assessment and requirements through verified implementation and deployment.
Practical experience securing industrial networks, remote access, and interfaces between OT and connected digital, edge, or cloud systems, including brownfield and lifecycle constraints.
Experience leading cross-functional architecture decisions, working with product and system engineering teams, and engaging customers, suppliers, and cybersecurity stakeholders in global organizations.
Threat modeling, industrial cyber risk assessment, attack-surface analysis, security requirements engineering, and risk-based selection of architectural controls.
Practical application of the IEC 62443 series to secure development, component and system requirements, and system security design; familiarity with other relevant industrial security frameworks
Secure development lifecycles, software supply-chain assurance, SBOMs, vulnerability management, security verification, signed releases, and industrial patch and update strategies.
OT asset visibility, security logging and monitoring, incident response interfaces, backup and recovery, and operational resilience for long-lived industrial installations.
Security architecture for OT-connected edge platforms, APIs, messaging, containers, hybrid and cloud services, and industrial data platforms, with clear isolation of control-system trust boundaries.
Ability to produce clear architecture models, data-flow and trust-boundary diagrams, security specifications, and assurance evidence. Experience in power systems or energy-sector automation is an advantage.
More about us:
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.

This role combines deep expertise in video technologies, streaming protocols, multimedia processing, and software engineering to enable seamless, high-quality video experiences for global customers.

Your Role
5-12 years of experience in Video Engineering, Telecom, Broadband, Multimedia Software Development.
Strong programming expertise in C++, Java, and related technologies.
Hands-on experience with IPTV, OTT, Broadcast TV, and Video Streaming platforms.
Good understanding of video codecs:
H.264/AVC
H.265/HEVC
MPEG standards Experience with streaming protocols
HLS

RTP
RTSP

Strong exposure to Linux-based development environments.
Knowledge of Video Processing, Encoding, Transcoding, Packaging, and Content Delivery workflows.
Experience in debugging, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and optimization.
Familiarity with Cloud Technologies, Microservices Architecture, and Distributed Systems.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Automation Frameworks.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, operators, cross-functional teams, and global engineering teams.

Preferred Domains :
Video Engineering, IPTV OTT Platforms, Broadband Telecom, Multimedia Solutions, Digital Media, Broadcast Networks, Streaming Platforms, Media Technology Solutions

Your Profile
Design, develop, and maintain video processing and content delivery applications.
Develop solutions for video streaming, encoding, transcoding, packaging, and media distribution.
Work on IPTV, OTT, Broadcast TV, and Video-on-Demand (VoD) platforms.
Integrate and support industry-standard streaming protocols and video delivery technologies.
Troubleshoot customer, integration, and production issues related to video platforms.
Participate in architecture discussions, software design reviews, and performance optimization initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout development, testing, deployment, and support phases.
Build scalable and reliable software solutions following engineering best practices and coding standards.
Support software lifecycle activities including debugging, automation, deployment, and maintenance.
Contribute to Agile delivery practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
Mandatory Skills
10+ years of experience in Video Engineering, Telecom, Broadband, Multimedia, or Streaming Platform development.
Strong programming skills in C++, Java, or related technologies.
Hands-on experience with IPTV, OTT, Broadcast TV, or Video Streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of video codecs including H.264, H.265/HEVC, MPEG, and related technologies.
Knowledge of streaming protocols such as HLS, MPEG-DASH, RTP, RTSP, and MPEG-TS.
Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
Good understanding of content delivery, video processing, media workflows, and streaming architectures.
Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization skills.
Experience with CI/CD tools, DevOps practices, and software automation.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
Exposure to Broadband and Telecom video delivery platforms.
Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CDN, content delivery networks, and media distribution systems.
Familiarity with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understanding of video analytics, monitoring, and observability solutions.

Video Engineering
IPTV OTT Platforms
Broadband Networks
Telecom Service Providers
Digital Media Entertainment
Broadcast Networks
Streaming Platforms

What You'll Love About Working Here

Gain exposure to cutting-edge streaming technologies, cloud-native architectures, and video engineering ecosystems.

About the Role:
We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Vendor Management Executive to oversee
vendor-related activities and support the sourcing process. This role involves managing documentation,
tracking deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring smooth operational flow.

What Youll Be Owning
1. Vendor Management
Identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors for Recruitment services (India and US), US SME
sourcing, freelancer talent pools, and project-based outsourcing
Manage contract negotiations, rate finalizations, and Service Level Agreement (SLA)
definitions.
Track vendor performance, quality of submissions, and fulfillment timelines.
Maintain a live vendor database, contract repository, rate cards, and engagement trackers.
Coordinate closely with the US Sourcing Team to align on talent needs.
Support pricing discussions, RFP/RFQ processes, and build scalable sourcing pipelines.
Present regular vendor performance reports, dashboards, and procurement health metrics
to leadership

2. Invoicing & Financial Coordination
Manage vendor invoices, verify accuracy, and ensure timely processing.
Maintain invoice trackers and reconcile discrepancies.
Coordinate with Finance for approvals and payment follow-ups.
Statement of Work (SOW) Management
Create, review, and maintain Statements of Work and related documentation.
Track SOW timelines, extensions, renewals, and closures.
Ensure compliance with internal policies and governance standards.

3. Tracking & Reporting
Maintain trackers for vendor activity, deliverables, and project status.
Generate periodic reports (weekly/monthly) for leadership and sourcing teams.
Monitor contract expiration dates, project progress, and resource utilization.

4. Database & Documentation Maintenance
Maintain accurate databases related to vendors, agreements, and project records.
Ensure data integrity and timely updates in internal systems/tools.
Organize and store documents for audit readiness

5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Act as a liaison between the Outsourcing team and the Sourcing team.
Support sourcing activities by providing required data and documentation.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for smooth process execution.
Handle vendor communication where needed

Success in This Role
8-10 years of experience in vendor management, procurement, or sourcing operations.
Previous experience with managing a team.
Strong experience in US sourcing and vendor ecosystems (mandatory).
Solid negotiation, contract management, and vendor relationship-building skills.
Proficiency in Excel, vendor management platforms, Zoho Recruit, or similar systems.
Exposure to freelance workforce models, SME staffing, and project outsourcing
management
