At Xoriant we are expanding our AI Engineer practice with one of our esteemed clients. We are eagerly seeking candidates with 7+ years of experience for the role of Lead AI Delivery Engineer – Data Science to join our dynamic team. In this position, you will be responsible for delivering end-to-end AI/ML solutions, including predictive and agentic AI models. You will work closely with project managers, engineering teams, data scientists, and clients to design, develop, deploy, and optimize AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
• Role: AI Engineer
• Location: Bangalore/Chennai/Pune
• Experience: 7+ years
• Job type: Full time
• Work type: Hybrid
Impact you will realize: Job Responsibilities
• Work closely with project leads and managers to understand business requirements and objectives and propose tailored predictive and agentic AI models/solutions that deliver measurable value.
• Manage the end-to-end AI modeling lifecycle, including data contextualization, exploratory data analysis, AI/ML model development and deployment, and UI integration, ensuring seamless integration with client systems and platforms.
• Ensure high standards of quality through rigorous testing, validation, and performance evaluation of AI models prior to deployment.
• Develop scripts and tools to ensure high levels of automation and scalability in model building and deployment processes.
• Support clients post-deployment through ongoing engagement, issue resolution, knowledge transfer, and change management activities.
• Monitor and optimize deployed AI solutions, ensuring long-term reliability and continuous performance improvements.
Key skills you will require:
Primary Skills
• 7+ years of experience in AI/ML-based project delivery and customer success, with 3+ years of experience in data analysis and AI model development/deployment.
• Strong experience in Python-based data science tools and libraries, including Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.
• Hands-on experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies and solutions.
• Strong understanding of the end-to-end AI/ML model development and deployment lifecycle.
• Experience in data visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Plotly, and Seaborn.
• Experience with dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Metabase, or similar platforms.
• Experience working in industrial and manufacturing domains with prior successful AI solution deployments.
• Proven ability to collaborate with engineering, data science, and product development teams on AI model development and deployment.
• Experience in ROI/value tracking and change management to drive successful client outcomes.
• Strong experience engaging and collaborating with US and European clients, demonstrating excellent communication and cultural adaptability.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical stakeholders.
• Self-driven, quick learner, and adaptable to the latest AI technologies and tools, with the ability to innovate at speed.
Secondary Skills:
• Exposure to advanced Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks and tools – Desired.
• Experience in AI solution integration with client systems, platforms, and user interfaces – Desired.
• Experience in automation and scalability of AI model development and deployment processes – Desired.
• Exposure to AI solution monitoring, optimization, and performance management – Desired.
Qualification you must require:
• Bachelors or Master’s with Computer Science or related field
Why should you join Xoriant?
Xoriant is a trusted provider of digital engineering services, renowned for building and operating complex platforms and products at scale. With three decades of software engineering excellence, we combine modern technology expertise in Data & AI (GenAI), cloud & security, domain and process consulting to solve complex technology challenges. We serve over 100 Fortune 500 companies and tech startups on their journey to becoming unicorns and beyond.

Description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

Description:
Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst
Location- Bangalore/ Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune
Exp- 8+ Yrs
Mandatory Skills- Oracle Payroll, E-Business Suite (EBS), SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formualas
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst to support, maintain and enhance Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll within a complex, multi-country payroll environment.
Working as part of a specialist team of analysts and developers, this role combines deep Oracle Payroll functional knowledge with strong technical expertise to deliver payroll system enhancements, support legislative compliance, maintain platform stability and ensure the successful delivery of business-critical change.
The successful candidate will possess advanced technical skills in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formula, Oracle E-Business Suite architecture, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), integrations and application lifecycle management. They will also have practical and demonstrable experience supporting payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions, translating country-specific legislative and regulatory requirements into compliant system configurations, calculations, controls and technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Payroll Support & Administration
Support, maintain and enhance Oracle EBS Payroll and associated HRMS modules.
Investigate and resolve complex payroll, application and integration issues.
Ensure system reliability, availability, performance and security.
Support payroll operations across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local payroll legislation, statutory requirements, regulatory controls and reporting obligations.
Provide technical and functional expertise in payroll processing, balancing, reconciliation and issue resolution.
Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.
Technical Development
Develop, maintain and support:
SQL and PL/SQL solutions
Oracle Fast Formulas
Payroll configurations
Custom developments
Interfaces and integrations
Reports and data extracts
Analyse business requirements and translate them into scalable, supportable technical solutions.
Ensure developments comply with established development standards, security requirements and best practices.
Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
Support data migration and transformation activities where required.
Solution Delivery & Change Management
Manage the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for payroll enhancements and projects.
Support requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing and deployment activities.
Ensure technical solutions are documented, supportable and aligned with business and architectural standards.
Collaborate with Payroll, HR, Finance and project teams to deliver business-critical change.
Support release management, deployment planning and environment management activities.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and system optimisation opportunities.
Architecture & Technical Support
Maintain a strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and supporting technologies.
Support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
Work with infrastructure teams and third-party support providers to resolve technical issues and implement system changes.
Support resilience, performance optimisation and capacity planning activities.
Contribute to technical roadmaps and platform improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of Oracle product strategy, security recommendations and industry best practices.
Upgrades, Patching & Release Management
Support the planning and execution of:
Oracle application upgrades
Security patching
Legislative updates
Environment refreshes
Release deployments
Participate in testing, validation and deployment activities.
Conduct impact assessments, support regression testing activities and deployment planning.
Ensure upgrades and patches are implemented in accordance with governance and operational requirements.
Assess Oracle legislative updates and country-specific regulatory changes and determine their impact on payroll configurations, calculations, interfaces and reporting.
Coordinate testing and implementation activities with Payroll and relevant subject matter experts.
Stakeholder Engagement
Communicate complex technical concepts and solution options clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and Compliance teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Work with in-country Payroll specialists to ensure local legislative requirements are accurately reflected within Oracle Payroll.
Support business stakeholders in understanding system capabilities, risks, limitations and solution options.
Build effective relationships across all levels of the organisation.
Provide clear and practical technical recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Vendor & Partner Management
Work closely with third-party infrastructure and application support providers.
Manage supplier performance against agreed service levels and operational standards.
Collaborate with vendors to resolve incidents, implement enhancements and deliver technical improvements.
Support supplier governance processes and periodic service reviews.
Escalate risks and service concerns appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
Audit, Controls & Compliance
Support and maintain a robust controls framework across the Oracle Payroll landscape.
Ensure payroll system processes, configurations and integrations operate in accordance with internal controls, audit standards and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Security and Compliance teams to support periodic reviews and audits.
Provide system expertise and evidence for audit requests, including documentation of system controls, processes, workflows and technical configurations.
Identify and mitigate operational, security and compliance risks relating to payroll systems and processes.
Support the design and ongoing monitoring of application controls, segregation of duties and access management processes.
Ensure development, change management and release management activities comply with governance standards.
Lead or support remediation activities arising from audit findings, control assessments and compliance reviews.
Maintain accurate technical and functional documentation to support compliance, operational effectiveness and knowledge management.
Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience testing activities.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll within multi-country environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience assessing, configuring, testing and implementing country-specific legislative and regulatory payroll changes.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements and translate them into effective Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of payroll balancing, reconciliation and validation processes.
Experience supporting complex payroll operations within large corporate environments.
Technical Expertise
Advanced SQL skills.
Strong PL/SQL development experience.
Extensive Oracle Fast Formula experience.
Strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and underlying technologies.
Experience supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Experience with:
Integrations and interfaces
Data migration activities
Troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Batch processing and concurrent programmes
Payroll calculations and reconciliation
Security and access controls
Enterprise Command Centre (ECC)
Oracle workflow technologies
Oracle development standards and best practices
Experience managing application upgrades, patching and environment management activities.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGCs), application controls and audit requirements.
Experience supporting internal and external audits.
Knowledge of segregation of duties, access governance and security controls.
Experience working within regulated and compliance-driven environments.
Ability to assess technical and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation actions.
Understanding of change management, release governance and compliance frameworks.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll across multiple countries or jurisdictions, including the assessment, configuration, testing and implementation of country-specific legislative and regulatory changes.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.

Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll delivery processes and controls, including payroll calculations, balancing, reconciliation, validation, General Ledger, statutory reporting, audit requirements and legislative compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Collaborative team player with a proactive approach.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability and customer focus.
Excellent documentation and knowledge-sharing skills.
Continuous improvement mindset focused on operational excellence and resilience.

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Systems or a related discipline.

Experience working within large, international or highly regulated organisations.

About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Position Summary:
If you are a Project Pursuit professional Iooking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, or Chennai, India, you will play a pivotal role in shaping early-stage project success by engaging with Global Engineering Centers (GECs) and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) organizations. This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emersons Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. You will contribute directly to business growth by influencing project design decisions, strengthening customer partnerships, and enabling innovative, value-driven solutions across industries.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.

Practice / Domain: P&C Insurance Digital Transformation & Quality Engineering

Role Overview
We are seeking a forward-thinking Quality Engineering (QE) Lead to architect and drive end-to-end quality assurance across large-scale Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance transformation programs and emerging generative AI initiatives.
In this high-impact delivery role, you will lead global testing teams across complex Guidewire InsuranceSuite (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter) implementations while spearheading modern test automation using Playwright and establishing robust evaluation frameworks for AI Agents and LLM-powered workflows. You will act as the technical and operational bridge between client stakeholders, onshore/offshore engineering pods, and release management teams.

1. Core Insurance & Guidewire Quality Delivery
Lead End-to-End Guidewire Testing: Own the test strategy, planning, and execution for Guidewire InsuranceSuite (Cloud / On-Prem) across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter, including complex rating engines, underwriting rules, forms validation, and downstream integrations.
Integration: Drive rigorous testing of REST/SOAP APIs, messaging queues, batch jobs, and third-party rating/pricing or document management integrations.

Experience: 4+ years
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai

Looking for experienced QA Tester with hands on expertise in EV Charging domain testing, OCPP 1.6J protocol validation, and end to end charger lifecycle testing. Skilled in charger onboarding, transaction validation, API testing, database verification, and troubleshooting across CPMS platforms and charging infrastructure.
Key Skills & Responsibilities:
. Experience in Functional, Integration, Regression, and End to End Testing of EV charging applications and web platforms.
. Hands on experience onboarding and configuring chargers in SKY and Driivz CPMS.
. Strong knowledge of OCPP 1.6J message flows and charger to CPMS communication.
. Perform live testing on EV chargers including Alpitronic, STAR, and charger simulators.
. Design, develop, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business requirements.
. Validate EV charging sessions including kWh consumption, meter values, tariffs, charging costs, session status, connector status, and transaction data in CPMS.
. Perform API and integration testing across chargers, CPMS, mobile applications, payment systems, and backend services.
. Validate end to end payment and transaction flows within the EV charging ecosystem.
. Conduct Web Application Testing for CPMS portals, dashboards, and customer facing applications.
. Execute charging transactions using physical chargers, simulators.
. Perform backend validation using SQL and Databricks.
. Analyz logs and troubleshot production issues using Dynatrace.
. Experience in bug logging, defect tracking, retesting, and defect lifecycle management.
. Strong understanding of EV charging operations, user journeys, charger troubleshooting, and production support.

. Experience with AI model serving/inference platforms and APIs.

Description:
We are seeking an experienced Zuora Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue implementations across the complete Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Zuora Billing and Revenue solutions, with extensive experience in subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will lead business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs across diverse industries.
The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, enterprise architecture, business process design, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, Zuora configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts (POCs), testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and driving successful project milestones while ensuring delivery excellence.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a strategic role in practice growth by leading pre-sales engagements, solution demonstrations, estimations, client workshops, AI-enabled delivery initiatives, capability development, mentoring, reusable solution accelerators, and thought leadership. The individual will collaborate closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, enterprise architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Zuora Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, accelerate digital transformation, and support long-term business growth.
Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture and design for enterprise Zuora Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs across Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations.
Lead large-scale Zuora implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution architecture, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and post-production support while ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate discovery workshops, define solution roadmaps, recommend industry best practices, and provide strategic guidance for enterprise Q2C transformation initiatives.
Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, integration strategy, and implementation roadmaps while ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and business objectives.
Lead the design and implementation of Zuora Billing, CPQ, and Revenue capabilities, including product catalog, subscription lifecycle management, pricing models, billing schedules, invoice generation, taxation, payment processing, collections, revenue recognition, and accounting integrations.
Design and oversee integrations between Zuora and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, Workday, payment gateways, tax engines (Avalara, Vertex), CRM platforms, middleware, and data warehouse solutions, leveraging Zuora APIs, Workflow, Events, and integration frameworks.
Provide technical leadership and solution governance by reviewing architecture, configurations, customizations, integrations, code quality, and delivery artifacts while ensuring adherence to best practices, security standards, and scalable design principles.
Lead business discussions with clients to discover requirements, define problem statements, facilitate solution workshops, evaluate solution alternatives, and drive executive-level architecture decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
Establish delivery governance by managing project risks, dependencies, quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and milestone tracking while ensuring teams follow defined delivery methodologies, documentation standards, and implementation best practices.
Mentor and lead multidisciplinary teams of solution architects, functional consultants, technical consultants, and developers by providing technical guidance, conducting design and code reviews, supporting capability development, and fostering delivery excellence.
Drive innovation and practice growth by contributing to pre-sales, solution demonstrations, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, reusable solution assets, capability building, thought leadership, and go-to-market initiatives that enhance delivery efficiency and business growth.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, Liquid, HTML

Zuora Billing Solution Architect
Zuora Revenue Solution Architect
Zuora Implementation Manager

If you thrive in industrial automation or high-velocity B2B sales and want to partner with leading manufacturers across the Food, Pharma, Beverage, Dairy, and Electronics sectors, we want to hear from you!

Locations: Kolkata | Delhi | Pune | Mumbai | Hyderabad | Chennai | Bangalore | Punjab

Openings: 15 Positions

Compensation: Competitive & Negotiable (Based on experience, location & industry standards)

What You’ll Do:
Drive Growth: Develop new business within your assigned territory and crush sales targets.

Pitch & Demonstrate: Conduct on-site client visits, technical presentations, and live product demos.

Nurture Accounts: Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to maximize retention.

Collaborate: Work alongside our service engineers to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support.

Represent & Report: Attend industry trade shows/exhibitions, track market intelligence, and share weekly/monthly pipeline reports with management.

What We’re Looking For:
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics preferred) OR MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Skills: Solid technical aptitude for machinery, strong negotiation skills, and a self-starter attitude.

Mobility: Extensive regional travel is mandatory; owning a 2-wheeler or 4-wheeler is an added advantage.

We are a highly energetic team passionate about supporting business by providing high quality products and services which helps in reducing overheads and costs.

Knowledge of ELK Stack, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Role: Consultant - Functional Production Planning and Quality Management
Skill Set: SAP PP/QM

EXP: 6 To 8 Years,

Skills: SAP PPQM, Functional, S4Hana, End to End Implementation, Brownfield, Greenfield Implementation.

Job Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) consultant with hands-on implementation experience. You will design, configure and deliver manufacturing and quality solutions for discrete and process industry clients. You will work directly with business stakeholders across the project lifecycle, from requirement gathering to go-live and hypercare, on S/4HANA transformation programs.
Key Responsibilities
Production Planning (PP)
Lead requirement workshops with production, planning and supply chain teams, and translate business needs into PP solution designs.
Configure PP master data: material master (MRP views), BOMs, work centres / resources, routings and master recipes, production versions.
Configure and deliver planning processes:
Demand management, planned independent requirements and planning strategies (MTS, MTO, ATO)
MRP Live (MD01N), MRP areas, lot sizing, safety stock and scheduling
Capacity planning and levelling
Configure execution processes: discrete manufacturing (production orders), process manufacturing (process orders, PI sheets) and/or repetitive manufacturing.
Set up order types, scheduling, availability checks, goods issue/receipt, backflush, confirmations and order settlement.
Handle batch management, batch determination and batch classification.
Support subcontracting, co-products/by-products, rework and scrap processes.
Quality Management (QM)
Lead workshops with quality and compliance teams and translate requirements into QM solution designs.
Configure QM master data: master inspection characteristics, inspection methods, catalogs, code groups, selected sets, sampling procedures and dynamic modification rules.
Configure inspection types and inspection plans for goods receipt, in-process, final, stock transfer, recurring and customer returns inspections.
Configure quality notifications (customer complaints, vendor complaints, internal problems) and follow-up actions.
Set up the full inspection lot process: results recording, defects recording, usage decision and stock postings.
Configure quality info records, vendor certificates, certificates of analysis (CoA) and quality certificates.
Support calibration inspections integrated with PM, and stability studies where applicable.
Across Both Modules
Prepare fit-gap analysis, solution design documents, functional specifications and configuration documents.
Handle integration with MM, SD, PM, FI/CO and EWM/WM.
Support data migration: define templates, cleanse and validate master data, and load via S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
Work with technical teams on RICEFW objects: write functional specs and test enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms and workflows.
Drive SIT and UAT: write test scripts, coordinate defect resolution, and obtain business sign-off.
Prepare training material, conduct key-user and end-user training, and support cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Configure and demonstrate relevant SAP Fiori apps for planners, production supervisors and quality inspectors.
Must-Have Skills
6 - 8 years of SAP PP and QM functional experience to manage the implementation projects and product development on BTP, with strong hands-on configuration in both modules
At least 1 end-to-end S/4HANA implementation (greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition) as a PP/QM consultant.
Strong knowledge of MRP Live, production/process order lifecycle and QM inspection processes.
Working knowledge of S/4HANA simplification items in manufacturing and quality, and of the related Fiori apps.
Good understanding of PP/QM integration with MM, SD, PM and FI/CO, including product costing touchpoints.
Experience with SAP Activate methodology.
Ability to write clear functional specifications and to debug basic issues with technical teams.
Good-to-Have Skills
Exposure to SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM) / SAP ME / MII or other MES integration.
PP/DS (embedded in S/4HANA) or advanced planning experience.
Statistical process control (SPC), control charts and quality analytics.
Experience in regulated industries (pharma, life sciences, food and beverage, chemicals), including GMP, audit trail and electronic signature requirements.
Industry exposure to CPG, automotive, industrial manufacturing or textiles.
SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing and/or Quality Management certification.
Basic ABAP understanding for debugging and analysis.
Education
B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Chemical or related), or equivalent degree.
An MBA in operations or a background in manufacturing or quality industry roles is an advantage.
Soft Skills
Strong client-facing communication and workshop facilitation.
Ability to work independently on a module stream and mentor junior consultants.
Willingness to travel to client locations, including onsite assignments.
Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/ M.Tech/MBA

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Maximo Developer - Senior Associate, you will engage in business application consulting within our Technology Consulting network, focusing on Maximo Consulting. You will work directly with clients to modernize field service and operations, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful solutions. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate complex situations, build meaningful client relationships, and mentor junior team members. You will utilize your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to analyze complex concepts and anticipate client needs, contributing to the delivery of quality work.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team within our Technology Consulting practice. You will have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills while managing and inspiring others. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to develop self-awareness and enhance your strengths. Your work will fit into the broader objectives of the firm, and you will uphold professional standards, guiding and mentoring others to deliver value to our clients.
Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing Maximo solutions to enhance asset management capabilities
- Integrating Maximo with other enterprise systems to streamline operations and data flow
- Collaborating with clients to understand their business needs and tailor Maximo functionalities accordingly
- Utilizing analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve Maximo-related issues efficiently
- Leading the design and architecture of Maximo applications to support field service and operations modernization
- Applying knowledge of middleware architecture to facilitate seamless application integrations
- Supporting the deployment of emerging technologies within Maximo environments to drive innovation
- Managing project timelines and deliverables to align with client expectations and industry standards
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members in Maximo development and integration
- Engaging with stakeholders to gather feedback and continuously improve Maximo solutions
What You Must Have
- App Designer and DB Config: design and implement UI changes, custom Maximo applications, and schema extensions including custom objects and relationships
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Strong hands-on expertise in IBM Maximo 7.6.x and IBM MAS Manage (8.x / 9.x) across multiple functional modules
– Advanced Automation Script development: complex multi-object scripts, launch-in-context extensions, custom MBO validation, integration event framework, and field-level scripting in JavaScript (Rhino) and Jython
– Deep Integration Framework expertise: design of object structures, bidirectional ERP/GIS/SCADA integration, error handling, JMS queue management, and enterprise messaging patterns
What Sets You Apart
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
- Developing solutions using IBM Maximo Asset Management
- Integrating Maximo with enterprise systems for seamless operations
- Navigating complex middleware architecture for application integrations
- Embracing emerging technologies in energy and utilities sectors
- Managing field service mobility projects with FSM expertise
- Excelling in analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

Analyze treasury operations and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
Advise global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness across treasury processes.

Kyriba

GTreasury

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Technical consultant Manager (10-15 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool and data connectivity.
Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.
Required Skills
2-6 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and autonomous AI agents.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration and AI tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:
LangGraph
LangChain
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
LlamaIndex
Experience with Vector Databases:
Pinecone
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
FAISS
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.

Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.

Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Title: Recruiter
Location: Noida / Chandigarh
Experience Required: Graduate with minimum 6 months of recruitment experience
Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. The ideal candidate should have a bachelor's degree and at least 6 months of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition. The recruiter will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates for various open positions while ensuring a positive candidate experience.
Key Responsibilities
Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and stakeholders.
Maintain candidate databases and ATS records with accurate information.
Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
Support offer rollout and onboarding activities.
Meet hiring targets and maintain recruitment TAT.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Minimum 6 months of recruitment experience (IT, Non-IT, BPO, or volume hiring).
Good understanding of sourcing techniques and recruitment processes.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, or similar job portals.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple requirements.
Preferred Skills
Knowledge of end-to-end recruitment lifecycle.
Strong stakeholder and candidate management skills.
What We Offer
Competitive salary package.
Learning and growth opportunities within Talent Acquisition.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at jm00550792@techmahindra.com with the subject line: "Application for Recruiter"

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
Every room has to be perfect. We re searching for Assistant Housekeeping Manager to make sure our standards never slip - supporting in managing all aspects of our housekeeping and laundry operations to deliver memorable and unique guest experiences.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Supporting and developing a team dedicated to exceptional housekeeping and laundry standards
Assisting in maintaining and ordering supplies and equipment - while minimising waste - in support of our green initiatives
Helping to refine and prepare budgets that help us maximise profitability
Addressing special requests for guests, VIPs, repeat visitors and VIP Club members
Assisting with deep cleaning projects and occasionally assisting your team during busy periods
Educating all team members on the importance of remaining compliant with federal, state, and local laws and safety standards

What We need from you:
Bachelors Degree/higher education qualification/equivalent in hospitality or related field
3+ years total experience in a catering setting or related field
Direct supervisory experience or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
Must speak local language(s)

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing
framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Circle Business Head is responsible for the overall Business operations of the Circle according to Brands operational standards and run profitable business as an SBU. Majority of time is invested leading/guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives, in line with the principles of Brands Vision and Mission.
As a Business Head, you are accountable for overall annual business plan execution and achievement of the same by aligning the available resources in the best possible manner and takes regional/corporate support as and when required to achieve the job context.

Key Accountabilities
Leads Operational Excellence and the Guest Experience:
Role models expected behavior and coach teams on hospitality standards
Ensures all the restaurant meets safety, sanitation and cleanliness standards as per expectations
Sets the standards to ensure team handles all Guest concerns in a timely and sustainable manner
Empowers the team to satisfy Guest needs and resolve concerns 5. Removes barriers to delivering Hospitality behaviours during shift.
Drives Sales Growth:
Takes accountability for understanding all in store marketing promotions of the circle and provides inputs for national marketing on circle digital/print and other medium of marketing elements
Executes new product rollouts
Responsible for system growth as well new store sales
Responsible and drive Bottom Line:
Have a complete eye on each cost line and monitor each line restaurant wise, to maintain the annual business plan lines
Constant monitoring and reviewing the same with all direct reports and prepare the GAP analysis, guide them to maintain the lines
Ensure that all restaurants in the circle maintain these lines and facilitate them to earn bottom line incentive
Builds Team Talent:
Treats all team members fairly and with respect.
Supports the training of new team members
Recognizes team members for team contributions
Holds team members accountable for their behaviour and performance
Provides coaching to team members to improve performance
Provides communication to team about goals and performance
Expands the footprint:
Identify the new locations for the business expansion in line with the business strategy
Responsible for new restaurant operating days and prepare the propose the capex calculation
Understand and observe the completion closely and update stakeholders and plan to tackle the competition
Flexibility and Adaptability:
Acts quickly to solve problems in area of responsibility
Provides feedback and suggestions to improve performance
Is flexible with work schedule as business needs
Understands and complies with all procedures and policies
Provide action plans to address issues and opportunities and effective execution of the same
Seeks to understand goals and results and how they personally contribute to them
Plans and Communicates:
Discusses issues with other support functions of the circle and prepares the action plan
Discusses the business plan and brings out the alignment
Involves entire team by communicating goals, results, and action plans

Preferred candidate profile
Any Graduate/Post Graduate from a recognised university with 12+ years of relevant experience

Personal Attributes
Assertiveness: has the ability to articulate and hold their own in pressured conversations and to manage the expectations of others whilst working under pressure
Initiative: requires little or no supervision but will seek support from Head of Business Support if necessary. Understands the necessity to forward plan and think through potential complications. Identifies appropriate solutions to problems and acts accordingly. Able to make sense of issues; Identify and solve problems. Proactively suggests ideas for improvements around working practices
Credibility: has gained the respect from all members of the business, both seen as reliable, trustworthy and capable of performing the role; leads by example
Adaptability: maintains good performance and quality of work under pressure and is prepared to manage change at the last minute
Professionalism and confidentiality: confident individual who can deal with people at all levels both internally and externally. Demonstrates credibility and appropriate verbal and non-verbal behaviour
Teamwork: actively fosters a good working environment: builds effective team relationships
Team effectiveness: creates conditions to enable the team to perform at it best; acts to build a team setting clear direction, providing appropriate structure, recruitment of the right people. Provides the support needed to the team in respect of personal development and coaching, as required.
Organisation and planning: aptitude to prioritise, plan and organise workloads placed upon them and the ability to manage expectations and deadlines

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Title: FIREMAN
Role: To ensure immediate and effective response to fire and emergency situations at the client premises, assist in the prevention of fire hazards, and support the client’s overall safety and security operations through regular inspections, drills, and fire safety compliance.   Key Responsibilities: 1. Fire Prevention and Risk Mitigation Conduct routine fire safety inspections across the premises, especially high-risk areas.  Identify and report fire hazards, unsafe practices, and recommend corrective actions.  Ensure proper storage and usage of flammable materials as per safety guidelines.  Check availability, functionality, and accessibility of fire extinguishers, hydrants, hoses, sprinklers, alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency lights.  2. Fire Response and Emergency Handling Respond promptly to fire alarms and emergency calls.  Operate firefighting equipment such as fire extinguishers, hose reels, hydrants, foam, and breathing apparatus.  Evacuate personnel from affected areas and guide them to safe assembly zones.  Administer first-aid and support paramedical teams during emergencies.  Assist the firefighting team, civil authorities, and local fire brigade in containment and post-incident recovery.  3. Compliance and Documentation Maintain detailed incident logs and fire safety inspection records.  Assist in ensuring compliance with local Fire Safety Norms, NBC (National Building Code), and client-specific fire regulations.  Support internal audits and third-party fire inspections.  4. Training & Drills Conduct or participate in fire drills, evacuation exercises, and mock emergency simulations.  Educate on-site personnel on fire safety protocols and emergency procedures.  Provide demonstrations on the usage of fire safety equipment.  5. Maintenance & Housekeeping Inspect fire equipment daily and maintain logs for servicing schedules.  Ensure that escape routes, fire exits, and emergency doors are not blocked.  Liaise with facility teams for maintenance of fire panels, sprinklers, pumps, and water tanks.    Qualifications & Experience: Education: Minimum 10th Pass. Diploma or Certificate in Fire Safety or Industrial Firefighting from a recognized institute is mandatory.  Preferred Certifications:  Fireman Training from State Fire Services Civil Defence Government-recognized institutes  Basic First Aid and CPR Certification  Experience: 2–5 years in industrial, commercial, or institutional firefighting roles. Freshers with formal fireman training can also be considered.    Skills & Competencies Required: Thorough knowledge of fire detection and suppression systems.  Ability to work calmly under pressure and respond quickly in emergencies.  Physically fit, alert, and able to carry firefighting equipment.  Clear communication skills and basic understanding of HindiEnglishregional language.  Team player with a disciplined and responsible attitude.    Work Environment & Physical Requirements: Rotational shifts (daynight) including weekends and holidays.  High-risk environment requiring PPE usage.  Need to remain alert and mobile throughout the shift.  May require climbing, lifting, and operating in confined or high areas during fire events.    Employment Terms: Employer: G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.  Deployment: At client’s site (industrial, corporate, hospital, mall, warehouse, etc.)  Uniform & Equipment: Provided by G4S  Remuneration: As per industry standards and location norms  Contract Type: Full-Time Contractual based on client agreement    Growth Path: Fireman Senior Fireman Fire & Safety Supervisor Fire & Safety Officer Fire Safety Manager    Additional Notes: Background verification and medical fitness check are mandatory prior to deployment.  Strict adherence to G4S Code of Conduct and client site rules is expected at all times.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include participating on sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Assists with managing and developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.
